en.s: The Battle of Montemaggiore (or Monte Maggiore) was fought on 4 May 1041, on the river Ofanto near Cannae in Byzantine Italy, between Lombard-Norman rebel forces and the Byzantine Empire. The Norman William Iron Arm led the offence, which was part of a greater revolt, against Michael Dokeianos, the Byzantine Catepan of Italy. Suffering heavy losses in the battle, the Byzantines were eventually defeated, and the remaining forces retreated to Bari.

zh.s: 1041年5月4日，伦巴第—诺曼叛军与拜占庭帝国在拜占庭治下的意大利作战，战场位于坎内附近的奥凡托河一带。诺曼人铁臂威廉率军进攻拜占庭意大利总督迈克尔·多凯亚诺斯。这场战斗是更大规模叛乱的一部分。拜占庭军伤亡惨重，最终战败，残部撤往巴里。

en.t: The Augustinian monastic order is constituted at the Lecceto Monastery when Pope Alexander IV issues a papal bull Licet ecclesiae catholicae
en.s: The Monastery of the Holy Saviour at Lecceto in Tuscany, was the principal House of the order of the Hermit Friars of Saint Augustine (not to be confused with the Augustinian Canons Regular) in 1256, when Pope Alexander IV constituted the Augustinian order internationally. It was dedicated to Jesus as Saviour.

zh.t: 教宗亚历山大四世颁布《Licet ecclesiae catholicae》诏书，在莱切托修道院成立奥斯定修会
zh.s: 1256年，托斯卡纳的圣救世主修道院是圣奥斯定隐修士会的主要修院。教宗亚历山大四世当年确立了国际性的奥斯定修会。该修道院奉耶稣为救世主。这里所说的奥斯定会不同于奥斯定会司铎团。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; dated Events calendar entry and linked subject introduction

en.t: Assassination of the Swedish rebel (later national hero) Engelbrekt Engelbrektsson (27 April O.S.)
en.s: Engelbrekt Engelbrektsson (1390s – 4 May 1436) was a Swedish nobleman, rebel leader and military leader of German ancestry. He was the leader of the Engelbrekt rebellion in 1434 against Eric of Pomerania, king of the Kalmar Union.

zh.t: 瑞典叛乱领袖恩格尔布雷克特·恩格尔布雷克特松遇刺（儒略历 4 月 27 日）
zh.s: 恩格尔布雷克特·恩格尔布雷克特松（1390 年代—1436 年 5 月 4 日）是瑞典贵族、叛乱领袖和军事领袖，具有德国血统。1434 年，他领导了反抗卡尔马联盟国王波美拉尼亚的埃里克的恩格尔布雷克特叛乱。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; dated Events calendar entry and linked subject introduction

en.s: The Battle of Tewkesbury, which took place on 4 May 1471, was one of the decisive battles of the Wars of the Roses. The forces loyal to the House of Lancaster were completely defeated by those of the rival House of York under their monarch, King Edward IV. The Lancastrian heir to the throne, Edward, Prince of Wales, and many prominent Lancastrian nobles were killed during the battle or were dragged from sanctuary two days later and immediately executed. The Lancastrian king, Henry VI, who was a prisoner in the Tower of London, died or was murdered shortly after the battle.

zh.s: 蒂克斯伯里战役发生于1471年5月4日，是玫瑰战争中的决定性战役之一。支持兰开斯特家族的军队被由国王爱德华四世率领的约克家族军队彻底击败。兰开斯特王位继承人威尔士亲王爱德华和许多兰开斯特贵族在战斗中阵亡；两天后，一些人被从避难所拖出并立即处决。被囚禁在伦敦塔的兰开斯特国王亨利六世不久后去世，死因可能是病逝，也可能是遭谋杀。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The Acehnese launched their invasion of Johor between 1613 and 1615 to subjugate and vassalise the Johor Sultanate, as part of the Acehenese expansion in the Malay peninsula under Iskandar Muda reign.

zh.s: 亚齐人在 1613 至 1615 年间入侵柔佛，企图征服柔佛苏丹国并使其成为附庸。这是依斯干达·慕达统治时期亚齐势力向马来半岛扩张的一部分。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.t: Having been appointed the director-general of New Netherland, Dutch explorer Peter Minuit arrives in present day Manhattan Island aboard the See Meeuw
en.s: New Netherland (Dutch: Nieuw Nederland) was a colony of the Dutch Republic located on the East Coast of what is now the United States. The claimed territories extended from the Delmarva Peninsula to Cape Cod. Settlements were established in what became the states of New York, New Jersey, Delaware, and Connecticut, with small outposts in Pennsylvania and Rhode Island.

zh.t: 荷兰探险家彼得·米纽伊特受命出任新尼德兰总督后，乘坐“海鸥号”抵达今日的曼哈顿岛
zh.s: 新尼德兰（荷兰语：Nieuw Nederland）是荷兰共和国位于今美国东海岸的殖民地，宣称拥有从德尔马瓦半岛至科德角的领土。荷兰人在今纽约州、新泽西州、特拉华州和康涅狄格州建立了定居点，并在宾夕法尼亚州和罗得岛州设立了少数前哨。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; dated Events calendar entry and linked subject introduction

en.s: The Battle of Tangier, also known as the Battle of Jew's Hill, took place between a detachment of the English Tangier Garrison under the command of governor of Tangier Lord Teviot by a Moroccan force commanded by Khadir Ghaïlan on 4 May 1664. Successfully ambushing the 500-strong English force, Ghaïlan's men killed all but thirty of them, including Teviot.

zh.s: 1664年5月4日，丹吉尔总督特维奥特勋爵率领的一支英军驻军分队，在丹吉尔附近遭到由哈迪尔·盖兰指挥的摩洛哥军队袭击。这场战役也称“犹太山战役”。盖兰的部队成功伏击了这支500人的英军，除30人外其余全部阵亡，特维奥特也在其中。

en.t: Ilagan is formally accepted as a Dominican mission
en.s: On May 4, 1686, the Dominican Provincial Chapter formally accepted Ilagan, in present-day Philippines, as an ecclesiastical mission. It was named San Fernando de Ilagan in honor of Saint Ferdinand of Castile.

zh.t: 伊拉甘正式获接纳为多明我会传教站
zh.s: 1686年5月4日，多明我会省级会议正式接纳今菲律宾的伊拉甘为传教站。该地以主保圣人卡斯蒂利亚的斐迪南命名为圣费尔南多·伊拉甘。

en.t: The Imperial Theatrical School, the first ballet school in Russia, is founded
en.s: The Vaganova Academy of Russian Ballet is a school of classical ballet in St Petersburg, Russia. Established in 1738 during the reign of Empress Anna, the academy was known as the Imperial Ballet School until the Soviet era, when, after a brief hiatus, the school was re-established as the Leningrad State Choreographic Institute.

zh.t: 俄罗斯第一所芭蕾舞学校帝国戏剧学校成立
zh.s: 瓦岗诺娃俄罗斯芭蕾舞学院位于俄罗斯圣彼得堡，是一所古典芭蕾学校。学院于1738年安娜女皇统治时期成立，苏联时期前一直称为帝国芭蕾舞学校；学校曾短暂停办，之后以列宁格勒国立舞蹈学院的名称重新成立。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; dated Events calendar entry and linked subject introduction

en.s: The siege of Alorna in 1746 was a military engagement that took place in India, between Portuguese forces under the command of the Viceroy of India, Dom Pedro Miguel de Almeida Portugal, and those of the Sawantwadi State then part of the Maratha Confederacy, which were defeated.

zh.s: 1746年的阿尔奥尔纳围城战发生在印度，交战双方是由印度总督佩德罗·米格尔·德·阿尔梅达·葡萄牙伯爵指挥的葡萄牙军队，以及当时属于马拉塔邦联的萨旺特瓦迪邦军队。后者战败。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.t: Rhode Island becomes the first American colony to renounce allegiance to King George III
en.s: The Colony of Rhode Island and Providence Plantations was an English colony on the eastern coast of North America, founded in 1636 on former land of the Narragansett tribe by Puritan minister Roger Williams, at a settlement he originally called Providence Plantations, after his exile from the Massachusetts Bay Colony. Joined by three other settlements soon founded on Narragansett Bay, the colony became a haven for religious dissenters and was known for its commitment to religious freedom and self-governance.

zh.t: 罗得岛成为首个宣布脱离乔治三世国王的美洲殖民地
zh.s: 罗得岛与普罗维登斯庄园殖民地是英格兰在北美东海岸建立的殖民地，1636 年由清教徒牧师罗杰·威廉姆斯在纳拉甘西特部族的原有土地上创建。威廉姆斯被马萨诸塞湾殖民地驱逐后，在此建立定居点，并以“普罗维登斯庄园”命名，以表达对神意指引的感激。该殖民地后来获得 1663 年查理二世颁发的皇家特许状，确立了其政府并保障宗教自由。殖民地保持自治，直至 1776 年在美国革命期间宣布脱离英国独立，成为罗得岛州。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; dated Events calendar entry and linked subject introduction

en.t: Fourth Anglo-Mysore War: The Battle of Seringapatam: The siege of Seringapatam ends when the city is invaded and Tipu Sultan killed by the besieging British army, under the command of General George Harris
en.s: The siege of Seringapatam (5 April – 4 May 1799) was the final confrontation of the Fourth Anglo-Mysore War between the British East India Company and the Kingdom of Mysore led by Tipu Sultan who ruled after the death of his father. The British, with the allied Nizam Ali Khan, 2nd Nizam of Hyderabad and Maratha Empire, achieved a decisive victory after breaching the walls of the fortress at Seringapatam and storming the citadel.

zh.t: 第四次英迈战争：塞林伽巴丹围城战
zh.s: 塞林伽巴丹围城战于1799年4月5日至5月4日进行，是第四次英迈战争的最后一场冲突。战争双方为英国东印度公司和迈索尔王国；迈索尔国王蒂普苏丹在其父亲去世后继位。英国军队与海得拉巴第二任尼扎姆阿里汗及马拉塔帝国结盟，突破塞林伽巴丹要塞城墙并攻入城堡，取得决定性胜利。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; dated Events calendar entry and linked subject introduction

en.s: The Fourth Anglo-Mysore War was a conflict in South India during which the Mysore State fought against the East India Company, Maratha Empire and the Hyderabad State (under the suzerainty of Marathas) in 1798–99. This was the last of the Anglo-Mysore Wars. Although the Marathas had promised the land of Uttara Kannada to Mysore, they sided with the Company at the last moment which led to the capture of the capital city Mysore by the Company and the death of the ruler Tipu Sultan in the battle.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 第四次英迈战争于1798至1799年在印度南部爆发，迈索尔王国与东印度公司、马拉塔帝国和海得拉巴邦交战；海得拉巴邦处于马拉塔帝国的宗主权之下。这是英迈战争的最后一场。马拉塔人曾承诺将北卡纳达地区交给迈索尔，但最后关头转而支持东印度公司。东印度公司因此攻占迈索尔首都，迈索尔统治者蒂普苏丹在战斗中阵亡。
zh.n: 本条采用源信息框所列的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Political Constitution of the Spanish Monarchy (Spanish: Constitución Política de la Monarquía Española), also known as the Constitution of Cádiz (Spanish: Constitución de Cádiz) and nicknamed La Pepa, was the first Constitution of Spain and one of the earliest codified constitutions in world history. The Constitution was ratified on 19 March 1812 by the Cortes of Cádiz, the first Spanish legislature that included delegates from the entire nation and its possessions, including Spanish America and the Philippines.
en.n: King Ferdinand VII abolishes the Spanish Constitution of 1812, returning Spain to absolutism.

zh.s: 《西班牙君主国政治宪法》（西班牙语：Constitución Política de la Monarquía Española），又称《加的斯宪法》（西班牙语：Constitución de Cádiz），绰号“La Pepa”，是西班牙第一部宪法，也是世界上最早成文的宪法之一。1812年3月19日，《加的斯议会》批准了这部宪法。该议会是西班牙第一个由全国及其领地代表组成的立法机构，代表包括来自西班牙美洲和菲律宾的人士。
zh.n: 费尔南多七世国王废除了1812年西班牙宪法，使西班牙恢复专制统治。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained event introduction and exact dated calendar entry

en.s: The siege of Antwerp took place from 14 January 1814 to 4 May 1814, during the War of the Sixth Coalition. Led by Governor Lazare Carnot, Antwerp, then a French city, resisted an Allied siege until Napoleon's abdication and the signing of an armistice.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 安特卫普围城战发生于1814年1月14日至5月4日，是第六次反法同盟战争的一部分。安特卫普当时属于法国，在总督拉扎尔·卡诺率领下抵抗盟军围城，直到拿破仑退位并签署停战协定。
zh.n: 本条采用源信息框所列的事件结束日期。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The siege of Mainz (3 January – 4 May 1814) saw an Imperial French corps under Charles Antoine Morand besieged in Mainz Fortress by an Imperial Russian corps led by Louis Alexandre Andrault de Langeron. When the Russians left in February 1814, they were replaced by the V German Corps, led by Duke Ernest of Saxe-Coburg and made up of the soldiers from the County of Nassau, the Duchy of Berg and several other minor German states.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1814年1月3日至5月4日的美因茨围城战中，查尔斯·安托万·莫朗率领的法兰西帝国军团被路易·亚历山大·安德罗·德·朗热龙率领的俄罗斯帝国军团围困在美因茨要塞。1814年2月俄军撤离后，由第五军团接替围城，该军团由萨克森-科堡公爵统领，成员来自拿骚伯国、贝格公国和其他几个规模较小的德意志邦国。
zh.n: 本条采用源信息框所列的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Battle of 4 May was fought in open sea near Salvador, Bahia, on 4 May 1823, between the Imperial Brazilian Navy, under the command of British admiral Thomas Cochrane, and the Portuguese Navy during the Brazilian War of Independence.

zh.s: 1823年5月4日，巴西独立战争期间，巴西帝国海军与葡萄牙海军在巴伊亚州萨尔瓦多附近的公海交战。巴西舰队由英国海军上将托马斯·科克伦指挥。

en.t: Brazilian War of Independence: A Brazilian squadron led by Lord Cochrane engages a Portuguese squadron under João de Campos off Salvador, Bahia
en.s: The Brazilian War of Independence (Portuguese: Guerra de Independência do Brasil) was an armed conflict that led to the separation of Brazil from the United Kingdom of Portugal, Brazil and the Algarves. The war was fought across various regions of Brazil, including Bahia, Maranhão, Pará, Piauí, and Cisplatina (present-day Uruguay), with naval battles occurring along the Atlantic coast.

zh.t: 巴西独立战争：科克伦勋爵率领的巴西舰队在巴伊亚州萨尔瓦多附近与若昂·德·坎波斯率领的葡萄牙舰队交战
zh.s: 巴西独立战争（葡萄牙语：Guerra de Independência do Brasil）是一场促使巴西脱离葡萄牙、巴西和阿尔加维联合王国的武装冲突。战争在巴西多个地区展开，包括巴伊亚、马拉尼昂、帕拉、皮奥伊和西斯普拉蒂纳（今乌拉圭），大西洋沿岸也发生过海战。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; dated Events calendar entry and linked subject introduction

en.s: Indirect presidential elections were held in Gran Colombia on 4 May 1830 following the resignation of incumbent President Simón Bolívar. Joaquín Mosquera was elected President, whilst Domingo Caycedo was elected Vice President.

zh.s: 大哥伦比亚于1830年5月4日举行间接总统选举，此前现任总统西蒙·玻利瓦尔辞职。华金·莫斯克拉当选总统，多明戈·卡耶塞多当选副总统。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The Battle of Ramkani was fought on 4 May 1835 by the Sikh forces led by Maharaja Ranjit Singh and Barakzai forces including Ghazis.

zh.s: 1835年5月4日，兰吉特·辛格大君率领的锡克军队与包括圣战者在内的巴拉克宰军队发生拉姆卡尼战役。

en.s: The siege of Buda took place at Buda castle (called Festung Ofen in German), part of the twin capital cities of the Kingdom of Hungary. The Hungarian revolutionary army was led by General Artúr Görgei during the Hungarian War of Independence. Part of the Spring Campaign, the siege began on 4 May 1849, ending with the Hungarian capture of the castle by assault on 21 May.

zh.s: 布达围城战发生在布达城堡（德语称Festung Ofen），这里是匈牙利王国双子首都的一部分。匈牙利革命军由阿尔图尔·格尔盖伊将军率领，参加匈牙利独立战争。围城战是春季战役的一部分，于1849年5月4日开始；匈牙利军于5月21日突袭并攻占城堡，围城战结束。

en.t: The Cornwall Railway opens across the Royal Albert Bridge linking Devon and Cornwall in England
en.s: The Cornwall Railway was a 7 ft 1⁄4 in (2,140 mm) broad gauge railway between Plymouth in Devon to Falmouth in Cornwall, England. It was built in the second half of the 19th century. It was constantly beset with shortage of capital for the construction and was eventually forced to sell its line to the dominant Great Western Railway.

zh.t: 康沃尔铁路开通，途经皇家阿尔伯特桥，连接英格兰德文郡和康沃尔郡
zh.s: 康沃尔铁路是一条采用7英尺1/4英寸（2,140毫米）宽轨的铁路，连接英格兰德文郡的普利茅斯和康沃尔郡的法尔茅斯。铁路建于19世纪下半叶，建设过程中一直资金短缺，最终被迫将线路出售给实力更强的西部大铁路公司。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; dated Events calendar entry and linked subject introduction

en.s: The Battle of Atlixco was fought on May 4, 1862 between the French invasion force and their Mexican imperial allies on one side and the Mexican republican forces on the other. The republicans were commanded by Tomas O'Horan, who later defected and was executed at the end of the war. The imperials were commanded by Leonardo Marquez, a veteran of the Mexican-American War and supporter of Miguel Miramón known as the "Tiger of Tacubaya". The two sides were evenly matched with 1,000 soldiers each. The republicans were victorious.

zh.s: 阿特利斯科战役于1862年5月4日爆发，交战双方分别是法国入侵军及其墨西哥帝国派盟友，以及墨西哥共和军。共和军由托马斯·奥霍兰指挥；他后来叛变，并在战争结束时被处决。帝国派军队由莱昂纳多·马尔克斯指挥。他曾参加美墨战争，支持米格尔·米拉蒙，人称“塔库巴亚之虎”。双方兵力相当，各有1,000人。最终共和军获胜。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The Battle of Yorktown or Siege of Yorktown was fought from April 5 to May 4, 1862, as part of the Peninsula campaign of the American Civil War. Marching from Fort Monroe, Union Maj. Gen. George B. McClellan's Army of the Potomac encountered Maj. Gen. John B. Magruder's small Confederate force at Yorktown behind the Warwick Line. McClellan suspended his march up the Peninsula toward Richmond and settled in for siege operations.
en.n: The Battle of Yorktown or Siege of Yorktown was fought from April 5 to May 4, 1862, as part of the Peninsula campaign of the American Civil War.

zh.s: 约克镇战役或约克镇围城战于1862年4月5日至5月4日进行，是美国南北战争半岛战役的一部分。联邦少将乔治·B·麦克莱伦率领波托马克军团从门罗堡出发，行进至约克镇时，遭遇约翰·B·马格鲁德少将指挥的一支规模较小的邦联部队。马格鲁德的部队驻守在沃里克防线后方。麦克莱伦暂停了沿半岛向里士满推进的计划，转而展开围城行动。
zh.n: 约克镇战役或约克镇围城战于1862年4月5日至5月4日进行，是美国南北战争半岛战役的一部分。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The Battle of Salem Church, took place on May 4 respectively, 1863, in Spotsylvania County, Virginia, as part of the Chancellorsville Campaign of the American Civil War.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 塞勒姆教堂战役于1863年5月4日在弗吉尼亚州斯波茨尔韦尼亚县发生，是南北战争钱斯勒斯维尔战役的一部分。
zh.n: 本条采用源信息框所列的事件结束日期。

en.s: The siege of Suffolk, also known as the Battle of Suffolk, took place from April 11 to May 4, 1863, near Suffolk, Virginia during the American Civil War.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 萨福克围城战又称萨福克战役，于1863年4月11日至5月4日在弗吉尼亚州萨福克附近发生，是美国南北战争的一部分。
zh.n: 本条采用源信息框所列的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Battle of Sabana Burro (Spanish: Batalla de Sabana Burro) was a major battle of the Dominican Restoration War. It was fought in Hato Mayor, at the junction of the Iguamo and Guamira rivers. Genaro Díaz was in charge of this battle, entering at dawn on May 4, 1864. The restorers sent a column to the center of the savannah to bombard the Spanish.

zh.s: 萨瓦纳布罗战役（西班牙语：Batalla de Sabana Burro）是多米尼加复国战争中的一场重要战役，发生在哈托马约尔、伊瓜莫河与瓜米拉河交汇处。1864年5月4日黎明时，赫纳罗·迪亚斯将军率军投入战斗。复国军派出一支纵队前往草原中央炮击西班牙军队。

en.s: The Overland Campaign, also known as Grant's Overland Campaign, the Virginia Campaign, and the Wilderness Campaign, was a series of battles fought in Virginia during May and June 1864, towards the end of the American Civil War. Lt. Gen. Ulysses S. Grant, general-in-chief of all Union armies, directed the actions of the Army of the Potomac, commanded by Maj. Gen. George G.
en.n: The Overland Campaign began as Grant's forces crossed the Rapidan River on May 4, 1864.

zh.s: 陆上战役又称格兰特陆上战役、弗吉尼亚战役和荒野战役，是 1864 年 5 月和 6 月间在弗吉尼亚州进行的一系列战斗，发生于美国内战后期。联邦军总司令尤利西斯·S·格兰特中将指挥由乔治·G·米德少将率领的波托马克军团作战。
zh.n: 格兰特的部队于 1864 年 5 月 4 日渡过拉皮丹河，标志着陆上战役开始。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 1868 Florida gubernatorial election was held on May 4, 1868. Republican nominee Harrison Reed defeated the Democratic nominee George W. Scott in a landslide. This stood as the best Republican gubernatorial performance, in terms of total percentage of the vote, in state history until 2022.

zh.s: 1868年佛罗里达州州长选举于5月4日举行。共和党候选人哈里森·里德以压倒性优势击败民主党候选人乔治·W·斯科特。按总得票率计算，这也是共和党在该州历史上表现最好的一次州长选举，直到2022年才被刷新。

en.s: General elections were held in Liberia in May 1869. The presidential election resulted in a victory for Edward James Roye of the True Whig Party, who defeated incumbent President James Spriggs Payne. The election was very close, with the House of Representatives required to decide the final outcome. Roye took office on 3 January 1870.

zh.s: 利比里亚于 1869 年 5 月举行大选。总统选举由真实辉格党候选人爱德华·詹姆斯·罗伊获胜，他击败了时任总统詹姆斯·斯普里格斯·佩恩。选情十分接近，最终结果需由众议院裁定。罗伊于 1870 年 1 月 3 日就任。

en.s: The Naval Battle of Hakodate (函館湾海戦, Hakodatewan Kaisen) was fought from 4 to 10 May 1869, between the remnants of the Tokugawa shogunate navy, consolidated into the armed forces of the rebel Ezo Republic, and the newly formed Imperial Japanese Navy. It was one of the last stages of the Battle of Hakodate during the Boshin War, and occurred near Hakodate in the northern Japanese island of Hokkaido.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 函馆湾海战（函館湾海戦，Hakodatewan Kaisen）于1869年5月4日至10日爆发，交战双方是并入叛军虾夷共和国武装力量的德川幕府残余海军，以及新成立的大日本帝国海军。这是戊辰战争期间函馆战役的最后阶段之一，战斗发生在日本北部北海道函馆附近。
zh.n: 本条采用源信息框所列的事件开始日期。

en.t: The National Association, the first professional baseball league, opens its first season in Fort Wayne, Indiana
en.s: The National Association of Professional Base Ball Players (NAPBBP), often known simply as the National Association (NA), was the first fully-professional sports league in baseball. The National Association was founded in 1871 and continued through the 1875 season. Whether it should be considered a "major league" continues to be a matter of differing opinion between baseball writers, historians, and others.

zh.t: 首个职业棒球联赛全国协会在印第安纳州韦恩堡开启首个赛季
zh.s: 全国职业棒球运动员协会（NAPBBP）常简称为全国协会（NA），是棒球史上第一个完全职业化的体育联盟。协会成立于1871年，持续运作至1875赛季。棒球作家、历史学家等人士至今仍对它是否应被视为“大联盟”存在不同看法。

en.s: The Battle of Mouzaki (Greek: Mάχη του Μουζακίου) occurred on 4 May 1878 between Greek irregulars with the cover support of the Greek Army against the Ottoman Army. It is one of the main events of the Greek revolts that erupted in Thessaly and Epirus during the Russo-Turkish War of 1877–1878.

zh.s: 穆扎基战役（希腊语：Mάχη του Μουζακίου）于1878年5月4日爆发，交战双方是得到希腊正规军掩护的希腊非正规武装和奥斯曼军队。这是1877—1878年俄土战争期间，色萨利和伊庇鲁斯发生希腊起义的重要事件之一。

en.s: The Bruce by-election, 1892 was a by-election held on 4 May 1892 during the 11th New Zealand Parliament in the rural lower South Island electorate of Bruce.

zh.s: 1892年布鲁斯补选于5月4日举行。当时新西兰第11届议会在任，补选涉及南岛南部的乡村选区布鲁斯。

en.s: The Battle of Santo Tomas (Filipino: Labanan sa Santo Tomas, Spanish: Batalla de Santo Tomás) was fought on May 4, 1899, in Santo Tomas, Pampanga, during the Philippine–American War. During this battle, General Antonio Luna, the commander of the Filipino forces, was wounded. The Battle of Santo Tomas followed the Battle of Calumpit, wherein Luna's main force had fought that of General Arthur MacArthur, Jr.

zh.s: 圣托马斯战役（菲律宾语：Labanan sa Santo Tomas；西班牙语：Batalla de Santo Tomás）于1899年5月4日在邦板牙省圣托马斯爆发，是菲律宾—美国战争的一场战斗。菲律宾军队指挥官安东尼奥·卢纳将军在战斗中受伤。此前，卢纳的主力部队曾在卡卢姆皮特战役中与小阿瑟·麦克阿瑟将军的部队交战。

en.s: A by-election was held for the British House of Commons constituency of Sheffield Attercliffe on 4 May 1909.

zh.t: 1909年谢菲尔德阿特克利夫补选
zh.s: 1909年5月4日，英国下议院谢菲尔德阿特克利夫选区举行补选。

en.s: The Battle of Rhodes or Invasion of Rhodes was fought in May 1912 as part of the Italo-Turkish War. Italian troops under Lieutenant General Giovanni Ameglio landed on the Turkish-held island and took control after 13 days of fighting, ending nearly 400 years of Ottoman rule. The battle became the major engagement during the Italian operations in the Aegean Sea.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 罗得岛战役又称罗得岛入侵，是1912年意土战争期间的一场战斗。乔瓦尼·阿梅利奥中将率领意大利军队在奥斯曼帝国控制的罗得岛登陆，经过13天战斗后夺取该岛，结束了奥斯曼帝国近400年的统治。这场战役是意大利在爱琴海军事行动中的主要战斗。
zh.n: 本条采用源信息框所列的事件开始日期。

en.s: The 1912 Football Association Charity Shield was played on 4 May 1912. The game was played at White Hart Lane, home of Tottenham Hotspur, and was contested by the Football League champions Blackburn Rovers and the winners of the Southern League championship, Queens Park Rangers. The game ended in a 2–1 win for Blackburn Rovers, and the proceeds of the match were donated to the Titanic Relief Fund.

zh.s: 1912年足球总会慈善盾杯赛于1912年5月4日举行。比赛在托特纳姆热刺主场白鹿巷球场进行，参赛双方为足球联赛冠军布莱克本流浪者和南部联赛冠军女王公园巡游者。布莱克本流浪者以2比1获胜，比赛收入捐给“泰坦尼克号救援基金”。

en.s: The 1915 Los Angeles mayoral election took place on May 4, 1915, with a run-off election on June 1, 1915. Charles E. Sebastian was elected.

zh.s: 1915年5月4日举行洛杉矶市长选举，6月1日进行第二轮投票。查尔斯·E·塞巴斯蒂安当选。

en.s: The 1915 Baltimore mayoral election saw the reelection of James H. Preston.

zh.s: 1915年巴尔的摩市长选举中，詹姆斯·H·普雷斯顿再次当选。

en.s: The action of 4 May 1917 was a naval and air engagement of the First World War in the North Sea. The action took place between the German Zeppelin LZ 92 (tactical name, L.43), several German submarines and a naval force led by the Australian light cruiser HMAS Sydney. The action was inconclusive with no casualties on either side, concluding when the Zeppelin had dropped all of its bombs and the cruisers had expended all of their anti-aircraft ammunition.

zh.s: 1917年5月4日，第一次世界大战期间，北海发生海军与空军交战。德军齐柏林飞艇LZ 92（战术编号L.43）和数艘德国潜艇，与澳大利亚轻巡洋舰“悉尼”号率领的一支海军部队交战。战斗没有明显结果，双方均无人员伤亡；齐柏林飞艇投完所有炸弹，巡洋舰也打光了全部防空弹药后，交战结束。

en.s: The Second Transjordan attack on Shunet Nimrin and Es Salt, officially known by the British as the Second action of Es Salt and by others as the Second Battle of the Jordan, was fought east of the Jordan River between 30 April and 4 May 1918, during the Sinai and Palestine Campaign of the First World War.

zh.s: 1918年4月30日至5月4日，第一次世界大战西奈及巴勒斯坦战役期间，英军再次进攻约旦河以东的舒奈特尼姆林和埃斯盐。英国方面正式称之为“埃斯盐第二次作战”，其他人则称“约旦河第二次战役”。

en.s: The siege of Najaf was an engagement between the British Army and Iraqi rebels in the city of Najaf during the First World War. The city had fallen under the control of four sheikhs in 1915 after an anti-Ottoman uprising, and was put under British control in 1917. In 1918, as it became clear that the British were aiming to occupy rather than liberate Iraq, an anti-British movement named Jam'iya al-Nahda al-Islamiya was formed in Najaf to oppose British rule. The uprising began on 19 March when a British officer, William M. Marshall was assassinated in the citadel of Najaf. The British subsequently laid siege to the city on 23 March, cutting all supply routes to the city before it ultimately surrendered on 4 May 1918.

zh.s: 第一次世界大战期间，英国陆军与伊拉克反抗者在纳杰夫发生战斗。1915年反奥斯曼起义后，这座城市落入四名谢赫控制，1917年转由英国控制。1918年，随着英国意图占领而非解放伊拉克逐渐明朗，纳杰夫成立了名为“伊斯兰复兴协会”（Jam'iya al-Nahda al-Islamiya）的反英组织。3月19日，英国军官威廉·M·马歇尔在纳杰夫城堡被刺杀，起义由此爆发。英国随后于3月23日围困该城，切断所有补给线。1918年5月4日，纳杰夫最终投降。

en.s: The Hastings by-election of 1921 was held on 4 May 1921. The by-election was held due to the resignation of the incumbent Coalition Conservative MP, Laurance Lyon. It was won by the Coalition Conservative candidate Lord Eustace Percy.

zh.s: 1921年黑斯廷斯补选于5月4日举行。此次补选因联合政府保守党议员劳伦斯·莱昂辞职而举行，最终由联合政府保守党候选人尤斯塔斯·珀西勋爵胜出。

en.s: The 1921 Auckland City mayoral election was part of the New Zealand local elections held that same year. In 1921, elections were held for the Mayor of Auckland plus other local government positions including twenty-one city councillors. The polling was conducted using the standard first-past-the-post electoral method. Incumbent mayor James Gunson was again declared re-elected unopposed, with no other candidates emerging.

zh.s: 1921年奥克兰市长选举是新西兰当年地方选举的一部分。当年，选民除选出奥克兰市长外，还选举其他地方政府职位，包括21名市议员。投票采用简单多数制。现任市长詹姆斯·冈森再次在没有对手的情况下当选。

en.s: The 1924 Copa del Rey final was the 24th final of the Spanish cup competition, the Copa del Rey. The final was played at Atotxa Stadium, in San Sebastián, on 4 May 1924. Real Unión beat Real Madrid 1–0, winning their second title (third title counting the trophy won by Racing de Irun in 1913). The only goal was scored by José Echeveste.

zh.s: 1924年国王杯决赛是西班牙足球杯赛“国王杯”的第24届决赛。比赛于1924年5月4日在圣塞瓦斯蒂安的阿托查球场举行。皇家联合以1比0击败皇家马德里，赢得第二座冠军奖杯；若计入伊伦竞技于1913年赢得的奖杯，则是该队第三冠。何塞·埃切维斯特打入全场唯一进球。

en.s: A federal election for the second Reichstag of the Weimar Republic was held in Germany on 4 May 1924. It took place following a series of national crises in 1923, most notably the occupation of the Ruhr by French and Belgian troops and the resulting period of hyperinflation. The election campaign was marked by strong ideological differences over how the government had handled the problems.

zh.s: 魏玛共和国第二届帝国议会选举于1924年5月4日在德国举行。此前德国在1923年经历了一系列全国性危机，最突出的是法国和比利时军队占领鲁尔区，以及由此引发的恶性通货膨胀。竞选期间，各党围绕政府如何处理这些问题展现出强烈的意识形态分歧。

en.s: The 1926 general strike in the United Kingdom was a general strike that lasted 9 days, from 4 May 1926 to 13 May 1926. It was called by the General Council of the Trades Union Congress (TUC) in an unsuccessful attempt to force the British government to act to prevent wage reduction and worsening conditions for 1.2 million locked-out coal miners. Some 1.7 million workers went out, especially in transport and heavy industry. The government was prepared and enlisted middle class volunteers to maintain essential services. There was little violence and the TUC gave up in defeat.

zh.s: 英国1926年总罢工持续9天，从1926年5月4日到13日。英国职工大会总理事会发起罢工，试图迫使英国政府阻止煤矿工人的工资降低和工作条件恶化；当时有120万矿工被停工在家。罢工未能达到目的。约170万名工人停工，尤以交通和重工业为主。政府事先作了准备，并招募中产阶级志愿者维持基本公共服务。罢工期间暴力事件不多，职工大会最终认输，结束罢工。

en.s: The 1931 Turkish presidential election is the presidential election held in the Grand National Assembly of Turkey on 4 May 1931. 289 MPs participated in the elections. The current President Mustafa Kemal Atatürk was unanimously re-elected President in the first round.

zh.s: 1931年5月4日，土耳其大国民议会举行总统选举，共有289名议员参加投票。时任总统穆斯塔法·凯末尔·阿塔图尔克在第一轮投票中全票连任。

en.s: The 1933 Dunedin mayoral election was part of the New Zealand local elections held that same year. In 1933, elections were held for the Mayor of Dunedin plus other local government positions including twelve city councillors. The polling was conducted using the standard first-past-the-post electoral method. Robert Black, the incumbent Mayor, sought re-election but was defeated by Edwin Cox, a clergyman who had the backing of the Labour movement.

zh.s: 1933年达尼丁市长选举是新西兰当年地方选举的一部分。当年，选民除选出达尼丁市长外，还选举其他地方政府职位，包括12名市议员。投票采用简单多数制。现任市长罗伯特·布莱克寻求连任，但败给了得到工运支持的牧师埃德温·考克斯。

In 1933, elections were held for the Mayor of Auckland plus other local government positions including twenty-one city councillors. The polling was conducted using the standard first-past-the-post electoral method.

zh.s: 1933年奥克兰市长选举是新西兰当年地方选举的一部分。当年，选民除选出奥克兰市长外，还选举其他地方政府职位，包括21名市议员。投票采用简单多数制。

en.s: The 1933 Wellington mayoral election was part of the New Zealand local elections held that same year. In 1933, elections were held for the Mayor of Wellington plus other local government positions including the fifteen city councillors, also elected biannually. Thomas Hislop, the incumbent Mayor sought re-election and retained office unopposed with no other candidates emerging. The polling was conducted using the standard first-past-the-post electoral method.

zh.s: 1933年惠灵顿市长选举是新西兰当年地方选举的一部分。当年，选民除选出惠灵顿市长外，还选举其他地方政府职位，包括每两年改选一次的15名市议员。现任市长托马斯·希斯洛普寻求连任，并在没有对手的情况下继续任职。投票采用简单多数制。

en.s: The 1937 Los Angeles mayoral election took place on April 6, 1937, with a runoff election on May 4, 1937. Incumbent Frank L. Shaw was reelected over Supervisor John Anson Ford in the runoff election. Municipal elections in California, including Mayor of Los Angeles, are officially nonpartisan; candidates' party affiliations do not appear on the ballot.
en.n: This entry records the listed event date, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1937年洛杉矶市长选举于4月6日举行，5月4日举行决选。现任市长弗兰克·L·肖在决选中击败监察委员约翰·安森·福特，成功连任。加利福尼亚州包括洛杉矶市长在内的市政选举均不分党派，候选人的党派不会印在选票上。
zh.n: 本条采用源信息框所列的事件日期。

en.s: The 1941 Football League War Cup final was contested by Arsenal and Preston North End. The first tie, played at Wembley Stadium on 4 May 1941, was drawn 1–1, McLaren scoring for Preston before Denis Compton equalised for Arsenal. The replay took place three weeks later, on 31 May 1941, at Ewood Park. Preston took the lead through Bobby Beattie, but Arsenal equalised late in the game courtesy of an own goal by Frank Gallimore.

zh.s: 1941年足球联赛战时杯决赛由阿森纳对阵普雷斯顿北区。首场比赛于1941年5月4日在温布利球场举行，双方1比1战平：麦克拉伦为普雷斯顿进球，丹尼斯·康普顿随后为阿森纳扳平。三周后的5月31日，双方在埃伍德公园球场重赛。鲍比·比蒂先为普雷斯顿取得领先，阿森纳则凭弗兰克·加利莫尔的乌龙球在比赛后段扳平。

en.s: The Battle of the Coral Sea, fought during 4–8 May 1942, was a major naval battle in the Pacific Theater of World War II between the Imperial Japanese Navy and naval and air forces from the United States and Australia. The battle was the first action in which aircraft carriers engaged each other, as well as the first in which neither side's ships sighted or fired directly upon the other. In an attempt to strengthen their defensive positioning for their empire in the South Pacific, Japanese forces decided to invade and occupy Port Moresby in New Guinea and Tulagi in the southeastern Solomon Islands.

zh.s: 珊瑚海海战于1942年5月4日至8日进行，是第二次世界大战太平洋战区的一场重要海战，交战双方为日本帝国海军，以及美国和澳大利亚的海空军。这是首次由航空母舰舰载机交战的战役，也是首次双方军舰没有直接发现或向对方开火的海战。为巩固其在南太平洋的防御部署，日军决定入侵并占领新几内亚的莫尔兹比港和所罗门群岛东南部的图拉吉岛。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The invasion of Tulagi, on 3–4 May 1942, was part of Operation Mo, the Empire of Japan's strategy in the South Pacific and South West Pacific Area in 1942. The plan called for Imperial Japanese Navy troops to capture Tulagi and nearby islands in the British Solomon Islands Protectorate.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 图拉吉岛登陆战发生于1942年5月3日至4日，是日本帝国在1942年南太平洋和西南太平洋地区战略“莫行动”的一部分。计划由日本帝国海军部队占领图拉吉岛及邻近岛屿，这些岛屿当时属于英国所辖的所罗门群岛保护领。
zh.n: 本条采用源信息框所列的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Battle of the Campobasso Convoy was a naval engagement between three British destroyers and the Regia Marina (Italian Royal Navy) Spica-class torpedo boat Perseo that took place off Cape Bon in the Mediterranean Sea on the night of 3/4 May 1943. The Italians were escorting the 3,566-gross register ton (GRT) freighter Campobasso to Tunisia.

zh.s: 坎波巴索号船队海战于1943年5月3日至4日夜间在地中海博恩角外海发生，交战双方为三艘英国驱逐舰和意大利皇家海军“斯皮卡”级鱼雷艇“佩尔塞奥”号。当时意大利海军正护送总吨位3,566吨的货船“坎波巴索”号前往突尼斯。

en.s: The 1943 Baltimore mayoral election saw the election of Theodore McKeldin.

zh.s: 西奥多·麦凯尔丁在1943年巴尔的摩市长选举中当选。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The Bombardment of Mailly-le-Camp was an RAF raid against a German panzer training center located in northern France undertaken during the night of 3/4 May 1944. The mission was a part of the "softening up" campaign Bomber Command conducted prior to the D-Day invasion. The operation was assigned to No. 5 Group, which was joined by No. 1 Group.

zh.s: 梅利勒营轰炸是英国皇家空军于1944年5月3日至4日夜间对法国北部一处德国装甲兵训练中心发动的空袭。这次任务是轰炸机司令部在诺曼底登陆前开展的“削弱敌方”行动的一部分，由第5大队执行，第1大队也参加了行动。

en.s: Operation Bielany (Polish: [bjɛˈlanɘ̟]; Polish: Akcja Bielany) was a sabotage operation during the Second World War, organized by the Directorate of Diversion of the Home Army. At night of 3 and 4 May 1944, a small partisan division had set explosives at the Bielany Aerodrome, then used as a Luftwaffe base, successfully destroying eight aircraft, and retreating without suffering casualties.

zh.s: 比耶拉尼行动（波兰语：Akcja Bielany）是第二次世界大战期间由波兰家乡军破坏行动局组织的一次破坏行动。1944年5月3日至4日夜间，一支小型游击队在当时用作德国空军基地的比耶拉尼机场布置炸药，成功摧毁8架飞机，撤离时无人伤亡。

en.s: The Landing at Aitape (code-named Operation Persecution) was a battle of the Western New Guinea campaign of World War II. American and Allied forces undertook an amphibious landing on 22 April 1944 at Aitape on the northern coast of Papua New Guinea. The amphibious landing was undertaken simultaneously with the landings at Humboldt and Tanahmerah Bays to secure Hollandia to isolate the Japanese 18th Army at Wewak.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 艾塔佩登陆战（代号“迫害行动”）是第二次世界大战西新几内亚战役的一部分。美军及盟军于 1944 年 4 月 22 日在巴布亚新几内亚北岸的艾塔佩实施两栖登陆，并同时在洪堡湾和塔纳梅拉湾登陆，以夺取荷兰迪亚、孤立驻扎在韦瓦克的日军第十八军。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: Operation Judgement was an operation carried out at the end of World War II by the Home Fleet of the Royal Navy in North Norway on 4 May 1945, when 44 aircraft of the Fleet Air Arm attacked a U-boat base 5 miles (8.0 km) south of the town and port of Harstad. The attack was directed at vessels in the natural harbour at Kilbotn. It lasted seven minutes and left two ships and a U-boat sunk. No Norwegians in the village of Kilbotn were injured during or after the attack. Operation Judgement was the last air raid of World War II in Europe.

zh.s: 第二次世界大战末期，英国皇家海军本土舰队于1945年5月4日在挪威北部执行“裁决行动”。舰队航空兵出动44架飞机，袭击哈斯塔德镇和港口以南5英里（8.0公里）处的德国潜艇基地，目标是基尔博特恩天然港湾内的船只。空袭持续7分钟，击沉两艘舰船和一艘潜艇。基尔博特恩村没有挪威人因此受伤。“裁决行动”是二战期间欧洲最后一次空袭。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: On 4 May 1945, at 18:30 British Double Summer Time, at Lüneburg Heath, south of Hamburg, British Field Marshal Sir Bernard Montgomery accepted the unconditional surrender of the German forces in the Netherlands, northwest Germany including all islands, in Denmark and all naval ships in those areas. The surrender preceded the end of World War II in Europe and was signed in a carpeted tent at Montgomery's headquarters on the Timeloberg hill at Wendisch Evern.

zh.t: 德国在吕讷堡荒原投降
zh.s: 1945年5月4日18时30分（英国双重夏令时），英国陆军元帅伯纳德·蒙哥马利爵士在汉堡以南的吕讷堡荒原接受德军无条件投降。投降范围包括荷兰、德国西北部及当地所有岛屿、丹麦，以及这些地区的全部海军舰艇。此事发生在欧洲第二次世界大战结束之前。投降文件在蒙哥马利位于文迪施埃弗恩蒂梅洛山总部的一顶铺有地毯的帐篷内签署。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: Bjørn West was one out of many Milorg bases in German-occupied Norway, located in the Matrefjella mountains near Matre in Masfjorden Municipality, Norway. The base was under the direct command of the Norwegian High Command in London. The purpose of the base was to set up a force that could operate behind German lines in case of an allied invasion of Norway.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 比约恩·韦斯特是挪威抵抗运动 Milorg 在德军占领时期设立的众多基地之一，位于马特尔附近、马斯峡湾市镇境内的马特雷山脉。该基地直接受伦敦的挪威最高司令部指挥，目的是在盟军入侵挪威时组织一支能够在德军战线后方行动的部队。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The Battle of Alcatraz, which lasted from May 2 to 4, 1946, was the result of an escape attempt at Alcatraz Federal Penitentiary by armed convicts. Two Federal Bureau of Prisons officers—William A. Miller and Harold Stites—were killed. Miller was killed by Joseph Cretzer, an inmate who attempted escape, and Stites by friendly fire. Three inmates were killed during the incident.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 阿尔卡特拉斯之战持续于1946年5月2日至4日，起因是阿尔卡特拉斯联邦监狱内的武装囚犯试图越狱。美国联邦监狱管理局两名警员威廉·A·米勒和哈罗德·斯泰茨遇害。越狱囚犯约瑟夫·克雷策杀害了米勒，斯泰茨则死于友军误伤。事件中还有3名囚犯死亡。
zh.n: 本条采用源信息框所列的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Superga air disaster (Italian: Tragedia di Superga, "Tragedy of Superga") occurred on 4 May 1949, when a Fiat G.212 airliner of Avio Linee Italiane, carrying the entire Torino football team (popularly known as the Grande Torino), crashed into the retaining wall at the back of the Basilica of Superga, which stands on a hilltop near Turin, Italy. All thirty-one people on board were killed.

zh.s: 苏佩尔加空难（意大利语：Tragedia di Superga，即“苏佩尔加惨剧”）发生于1949年5月4日。一架意大利航空航线公司的菲亚特G.212客机载着都灵足球队全体成员（该队以“伟大的都灵队”闻名），在意大利都灵附近山顶的苏佩尔加圣殿后方撞上挡土墙。机上31人全部遇难。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; current lead via MediaWiki API

en.s: The 1952 Coupe de France final was a football match held at Stade Olympique Yves-du-Manoir, Colombes on May 4, 1952, that saw OGC Nice defeat FC Girondins de Bordeaux 5–3 with goals by Victor Nuremberg, Luis Carniglia, Jean Belver, Abdelaziz Ben Tifour and Georges Césari.

zh.s: 1952年5月4日，法国杯决赛在科隆布的伊夫·迪马努瓦尔奥林匹克体育场举行。尼斯以5比3击败波尔多，进球者为维克托·努伦贝格、路易斯·卡尔尼利亚、让·贝尔韦尔、阿卜杜勒阿齐兹·本·蒂福尔和乔治·塞萨里。

en.s: An election to the Aberdeen Corporation was held on 4 May 1954, alongside municipal elections across Scotland. 13 of the corporation's 37 seats were up for election, although only 8 were contested. This election marked a general disinterest from local voters, as turnout fell to the lowest amount that had ever been recorded in Aberdeen council elections.

zh.s: 阿伯丁市政公司选举于1954年5月4日举行，与苏格兰各地的市政选举同日。市政公司37个席位中有13席改选，但只有8席有竞争。当地选民对选举普遍兴趣不高，投票率降至阿伯丁市议会选举有记录以来的最低水平。

en.s: 1955 Emperor's Cup Final was the 35th final of the Emperor's Cup competition. The final was played at Nishinomiya Stadium in Hyōgo on May 4, 1955. All Kwangaku won the championship.

zh.s: 1955年天皇杯决赛是第35届天皇杯决赛，于1955年5月4日在兵库县西宫体育场举行。关西学院大学夺得冠军。

en.s: The Battle of Saigon was a week-long battle in South Vietnam (State of Vietnam) between the army of Diệm's government and the private army of the Bình Xuyên organised crime syndicate. At the time, the Bình Xuyên was licensed with controlling the national police by the Chief of State Bảo Đại, and Prime Minister Ngô Đình Diệm issued an ultimatum for them to surrender and come under state control.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 西贡战役是越南国军（越南国时期）与平川派犯罪集团私人武装之间持续一周的战斗。当时，国家元首保大授权平川派控制国家警察，总理吴廷琰则向该组织发出最后通牒，要求其投降并接受政府管辖。
zh.n: 本条采用源信息框所列的事件结束日期。

en.s: The 1957 FA Cup final was a football match played on 4 May 1957 at Wembley Stadium between Aston Villa and Manchester United. Villa won 2–1, with both of their goals scored by Peter McParland. Tommy Taylor scored United's goal. It was Villa's first major trophy for 37 years and prevented United from doing The Double, Matt Busbys' side having been crowned Football League champions having won the First Division.

zh.s: 1957年5月4日，阿斯顿维拉与曼联在温布利球场进行英格兰足总杯决赛。维拉以2比1获胜，彼得·麦克帕兰包办本队两粒进球，曼联由汤米·泰勒进球。这是维拉37年来首次赢得重要奖杯，也让马特·巴斯比率领的曼联未能实现双冠王；曼联当时已赢得英格兰足球联赛甲级联赛冠军。

en.s: The Grammy Awards, stylized as GRAMMY, and often referred to as the Grammys, are awards presented by the Recording Academy of the United States to recognize outstanding achievements in music. The trophy depicts a gilded gramophone, and the original idea was to call them the "Gramophone Awards".
en.n: The first Grammy Awards ceremony was held on May 4, 1959, to honor the musical accomplishments of performers for the year 1958.

zh.t: 首届格莱美奖颁奖典礼举行
zh.s: 格莱美奖（标志写法为GRAMMY，常称Grammy）由美国唱片学院颁发，表彰音乐领域的杰出成就。奖杯造型是一台镀金留声机。最初有人提议将奖项命名为“留声机奖”。
zh.n: 首届格莱美奖颁奖典礼于1959年5月4日举行，表彰1958年的音乐成就。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 13th Cannes Film Festival took place from 4 to 20 May 1960. Belgian writer Georges Simenon served as Jury President for the main competition. The Palme d'Or, the festival's top prize, was awarded to La Dolce Vita by Federico Fellini. The festival opened with Ben-Hur by William Wyler.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 第13届戛纳电影节于1960年5月4日至20日举行。比利时作家乔治·西默农担任主竞赛单元评审团主席。电影节最高奖金棕榈奖颁给费德里科·费里尼的《甜蜜的生活》。电影节以威廉·惠勒执导的《宾虚》开幕。
zh.n: 本条采用源信息框所列的事件开始日期。

en.s: Freedom Riders were civil rights activists who rode interstate buses into the segregated Southern United States in 1961 and subsequent years to challenge the non-enforcement of the United States Supreme Court decisions Morgan v. Virginia (1946) and Boynton v. Virginia (1960), which ruled that segregated public buses were unconstitutional. The Southern states had ignored the rulings and the federal government had done nothing to enforce them.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 自由乘车者是民权活动人士，他们于 1961 年及之后几年乘坐跨州巴士进入实行种族隔离的美国南部，抗议美国最高法院在“摩根诉弗吉尼亚州案”（1946 年）和“博因顿诉弗吉尼亚州案”（1960 年）中的裁决未获执行。最高法院裁定，公共巴士实行种族隔离违宪，但南方各州无视裁决，联邦政府也未采取行动。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件开始日期。

en.s: El Carupanazo was a short-lived military rebellion against the government of Rómulo Betancourt, in which rebel military officers commanding the Third Marine Infantry Battalion and the 77th National Guard Detachment took over the city of Carúpano in May 1962. The rebellion was followed a month later by another in Puerto Cabello, El Porteñazo.

zh.s: 卡鲁帕诺起义是1962年5月发生的一场短暂军事叛乱，反对罗慕洛·贝当古政府。叛军军官指挥第三海军步兵营和国民警卫队第77分队，占领了卡鲁帕诺市。一个月后，波多卡韦略又发生了另一场叛乱，即波多卡韦略起义。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: An election to the Edinburgh Corporation was held on 4 May 1965, alongside municipal elections across Scotland. Of the councils 69 seats, 23 were up for election. After the election Edinburgh Corporation was composed of 35 Progressives, 33 Labour councillors, and 2 Liberal. The Progressives gained control of the council, which had previously been under no overall control.

zh.s: 爱丁堡市政公司选举于1965年5月4日举行，与苏格兰各地的市政选举同日。市政公司69个席位中有23席改选。选后，爱丁堡市政公司的席位分布为进步党35席、工党33席、自由党2席。进步党取得议会控制权，此前议会没有任何政党占多数。

en.s: The Kent State shootings (also known as the Kent State massacre) were the killing of four and wounding of nine unarmed college students by the Ohio National Guard on the Kent State University campus in Kent, Ohio, United States. The shootings took place on May 4, 1970, during a rally opposing the expanding involvement of the Vietnam War into Cambodia by United States military forces, as well as protesting the National Guard presence on campus and the draft.

zh.t: 肯特州立大学枪击事件
zh.s: 肯特州立大学枪击事件也称肯特州立大学惨案。1970年5月4日，美国俄亥俄州国民警卫队在肯特州立大学校园内开枪，造成4名手无寸铁的大学生死亡、9人受伤。当时学生正在集会，反对美国扩大越战、将军事行动推进柬埔寨，也抗议国民警卫队进驻校园和征兵制度。

en.s: General elections were held in Liberia on 4 May 1971. In the presidential election, incumbent William Tubman of the True Whig Party was the only candidate, and was re-elected unopposed. In the legislative elections, the True Whig Party won all 52 seats in the House of Representatives.

zh.s: 利比里亚于1971年5月4日举行大选。总统选举中，现任总统、真辉格党候选人威廉·塔布曼是唯一候选人，未经竞争再次当选。议会选举中，真辉格党赢得众议院全部52席。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: An election to Edinburgh Corporation was held on 4 May 1971, alongside municipal elections across Scotland. Of the council's 68 seats, 23 were up for election. Following the election, Edinburgh Corporation was composed of 28 Labour councillors, 27 Progressives, 9 Conservatives, 3 Liberals, and 2 independents. The SNP was wiped off the council after it lost all five of the seats it was defending.

zh.s: 爱丁堡市政公司选举于1971年5月4日举行，与苏格兰各地的市政选举同日。市政公司68个席位中有23席改选。选后，工党有28席，进步党27席，保守党9席，自由党3席，独立议员2席。苏格兰民族党失去所有正在改选的5席，退出了市政公司。

en.s: The 25th Cannes Film Festival was held on May 4–19, 1972. The Palme d'Or went to the La classe operaia va in paradiso by Elio Petri and Il Caso Mattei by Francesco Rosi. The festival opened with Malpertuis, directed by Harry Kümel and closed with Frenzy, directed by Alfred Hitchcock.

zh.s: 第25届戛纳电影节于1972年5月4日至19日举行。埃利奥·佩特里的《工人阶级上天堂》和弗朗切斯科·罗西的《马泰事件》共同获得金棕榈奖。电影节以哈里·库梅尔执导的《马尔佩图斯》开幕，以阿尔弗雷德·希区柯克执导的《狂凶记》闭幕。

en.s: Elections to Stretford Council were held on Thursday, 4 May 1972. One third of the councillors were up for election, with each successful candidate to serve a two-year term of office. These were the final elections held in Stretford before it became part of Trafford. The Labour Party gained overall control of the council from the Conservative Party.

zh.t: 1972年斯特雷特福德市自治市议会选举
zh.s: 斯特雷特福德议会选举于1972年5月4日星期四举行，改选三分之一议员，当选者任期两年。这是斯特雷特福德并入特拉福德之前举行的最后一次选举。工党从保守党手中赢得议会控制权。

en.s: Elections to Altrincham Council were held on Thursday, 4 May 1972. One third of the councillors were up for election, with each successful candidate to serve a two-year term of office. These were the final elections held in Altrincham before it became part of Trafford. The Conservative Party lost overall control of the council.

zh.t: 1972年奥尔特林厄姆市自治市议会选举
zh.s: 奥尔特林厄姆议会选举于1972年5月4日星期四举行，改选三分之一议员，当选者任期两年。这是奥尔特林厄姆并入特拉福德之前举行的最后一次选举。保守党失去对议会的整体控制。

en.s: Elections to Manchester City Council were held on Thursday, 4 May 1972. One third of the councillors were up for election, with each successful candidate to serve a two-year term of office. These were the final elections held in Manchester before the Local Government Act 1972 abolished the city corporation and reformed it as a metropolitan borough. The Labour Party retained overall control of the council.

zh.s: 曼彻斯特市议会选举于1972年5月4日星期四举行，改选三分之一议员，当选者任期两年。这是《1972年地方政府法》撤销曼彻斯特市政公司并将其改组为都市自治市之前举行的最后一次选举。工党继续控制议会。

en.s: Elections to Sale Council were held on Thursday, 4 May 1972. One third of the councillors were up for election, with each successful candidate to serve a two-year term of office. These were the final elections held in Sale before it became part of Trafford. The Conservative Party retained overall control of the council.

zh.s: 塞尔议会选举于1972年5月4日星期四举行，改选三分之一议员，当选者任期两年。这是塞尔并入特拉福德之前举行的最后一次选举。保守党继续控制议会。

en.s: The 1974 FA Cup final was an association football match between Liverpool and Newcastle United on Saturday, 4 May 1974 at Wembley Stadium, London. It was the final match of the 1973–74 FA Cup, the 93rd season of England's primary cup competition, the Football Association Challenge Cup, better known as the FA Cup. Liverpool were appearing in their fifth final and Newcastle in their eleventh, which was a record at the time.

zh.s: 1974年5月4日（星期六），利物浦与纽卡斯尔联在伦敦温布利球场进行英格兰足总杯决赛。这是1973—74赛季足总杯、也是英格兰主要杯赛英格兰足球总会挑战杯（通常称为足总杯）的最后一场比赛。利物浦当时第五次闯入决赛，纽卡斯尔第十一次进入决赛，这在当时创下纪录。

en.s: The 1974 Scottish Cup Final was played on 4 May 1974 at Hampden Park in Glasgow and was the final of the 89th Scottish Cup. Celtic and Dundee United contested the match, Celtic won the match 3–0 with goals from Harry Hood, Steve Murray and Dixie Deans. The game was Celtic's sixth successive appearance in the final, and Dundee United's first cup final appearance.

zh.s: 1974年5月4日，苏格兰杯第89届决赛在格拉斯哥汉普顿公园球场举行，由凯尔特人对阵邓迪联。凯尔特人以3比0获胜，进球者是哈里·胡德、史蒂夫·默里和迪克西·迪恩斯。这是凯尔特人连续第六次进入决赛，也是邓迪联首次闯入杯赛决赛。

loc: 德国北莱茵-威斯特法伦州

en.s: The 1975 North Rhine-Westphalia state election was held on 4 May 1975 to elect the 8th Landtag of North Rhine-Westphalia. The outgoing government was a coalition of the Social Democratic Party (SPD) and Free Democratic Party (FDP) led by Minister-President Heinz Kühn. The opposition Christian Democratic Union (CDU) remained the largest party and improved its lead over the SPD, but failed to win an overall majority.

zh.t: 1975年北莱茵-威斯特法伦州选举
zh.s: 北莱茵-威斯特法伦州选举于1975年5月4日举行，选出该州第八届州议会。由州长海因茨·屈恩领导的社民党与自民党联合政府任期届满。反对党基民盟仍是第一大党，并扩大了对社民党的领先优势，但未能取得绝对多数。

en.s: The 1975 WFA Cup Final was the fifth final of the FA Women's Cup, England's primary cup competition for women's football teams. It was the fifth final to be held under the direct control of Women's Football Association (WFA). Southampton Women's F.C. and Warminster L.F.C. contested the match at Brewers Hill, the home of Dunstable Town on 4 May 1975. The match ended 4–2 in favour of Southampton Women.

zh.s: 1975年女子足总杯决赛是该赛事第五届决赛，也是英格兰女子足球队主要杯赛的决赛。女子足球协会直接管理下举行的决赛也已是第五届。1975年5月4日，南安普敦女足与沃敏斯特女足在邓斯特布尔镇足球俱乐部旧主场布鲁尔斯希尔球场交锋，南安普敦女足以4比2获胜。

en.s: A presidential primary was held in the U.S. state of Alabama on May 4, 1976, with runoff elections on May 25 to elect delegates representing Alabama to the 1976 Democratic National Convention. In order to choose the state's thirty-five delegates, the state was divided up into twenty-seven delegate districts based on state house lines.

zh.t: 1976年阿拉巴马州民主党总统初选
zh.s: 美国阿拉巴马州于1976年5月4日举行总统初选，5月25日举行决选，以选出代表该州参加1976年民主党全国代表大会的代表。为选出该州35名代表，阿拉巴马按州众议院选区划分为27个代表选区。

en.s: The Battle of Cassinga, Cassinga Raid or Kassinga Massacre was a controversial South African airborne attack on a South West Africa People's Organization (SWAPO) military base at the former town of Cassinga, Angola on 4 May 1978. Conducted as one of the three major actions of Operation Reindeer during the South African Border War, it was the South African Army’s first major air assault. Claims continue that Cassinga was a refugee camp, rather than a military camp, and that consequently the raid was a massacre of civilians rather than a highly successful military operation.

zh.s: 卡辛加战役也称卡辛加空袭或卡辛加屠杀，是南非于1978年5月4日对安哥拉旧城卡辛加的一处西南非洲人民组织（SWAPO）军事基地发动的一次争议颇大的空降攻击。这是“驯鹿行动”三项主要行动之一，也是南非边境战争期间南非军队首次大规模空袭。关于卡辛加是难民营而非军事基地的说法至今仍有争议；因此，这次袭击也被指是针对平民的屠杀，而非一次成功的军事行动。

en.s: The 1978 Camden Council election took place on 4 May 1978 to elect members of Camden London Borough Council in London, the United Kingdom. The whole council was up for election, using new ward boundaries, with one less councillor than had been elected at the 1974 election. Labour were re-elected with an outright majority, but the Conservatives made gains across the borough, after losing heavily in the 1971 and 1974 elections. The Conservatives gained from Labour three seats in the southern Holborn and St Pancras South parliamentary constituency and eleven in the north (three in the Highgate ward and eight across the Hampstead parliamentary constituency).

zh.s: 1978年卡姆登自治市议会选举于5月4日举行，选出伦敦卡姆登自治市议会议员。由于使用新的选区边界，本次改选全部议席，席位数比1974年选举少1席。工党再次赢得绝对多数，但保守党在全区都有所斩获，此前该党在1971年和1974年选举中均遭遇惨败。在霍尔本和圣潘克拉斯南选区，保守党从工党手中赢得3席；在北部地区，保守党又赢得11席，其中海格特选区3席、汉普斯特德选区所属各选区共8席。

A third of the total seats were up for election, one for each ward plus an additional seat in the wards for Hatfield East and Peartree.

en.s: Local government elections took place in London, and some other parts of the United Kingdom on Thursday 4 May 1978. Ward changes took place in every borough (except Enfield) which increased the total number of councillors by 41 from 1,867 to 1,908. All London borough council seats were up for election. The previous Borough elections in London were in 1974.

zh.s: 1978年5月4日（星期四），伦敦及英国其他部分地区举行地方政府选举。除恩菲尔德外，伦敦每个自治市的选区均有调整，议员总数因此增加41人，从1,867人增至1,908人。伦敦各自治市议会的所有席位均参加改选。上一次伦敦自治市选举于1974年举行。

en.s: Elections to Liverpool City Council were held on 4 May 1978. One third of the council was up for election and John Hamilton of the Labour Party became Leader of the Council albeit without overall control.

zh.s: 1978年5月4日举行利物浦市议会选举，改选议会三分之一席位。工党约翰·汉密尔顿成为议会领袖，但没有任何政党取得过半席位。

en.t: 1978 Tower Hamlets London Borough Council election
en.s: Elections to Tower Hamlets London Borough Council were held on Thursday 4 May 1978. Ward boundary changes came into effect at this election, which reduced the number of councillors from 60 to 50. The whole council was up for election. The Labour Party retained overall control of the council.

zh.s: 1978年5月4日（星期四），塔村伦敦自治市举行议会选举。新选区边界在本次选举中生效，议员人数从60人减至50人。全体议员均参加改选，工党保住了议会控制权。

en.s: Elections to Southwark Council were held in May 1978. The whole council was up for election with a 28.7% turnout. There were 25 wards rather than the previous 23 and 64 councillors rather than 70.

zh.s: 萨瑟克议会选举于1978年5月举行，全部席位改选，投票率为28.7%。选区数从此前的23个增至25个，议员人数则从70人减至64人。

en.t: The South African Defence Force attacks a SWAPO base at Cassinga in southern Angola, killing about 600 people
en.s: The South African Defence Force (SADF) (Afrikaans: Suid-Afrikaanse Weermag) comprised the armed forces of South Africa from 1957 until 1994. Shortly before the state reconstituted itself as a republic in 1961, the former Union Defence Force was officially succeeded by the SADF, which was established by the Defence Act (No. 44) of 1957. The SADF, in turn, was superseded by the South African National Defence Force in 1994.

zh.t: 南非国防军袭击安哥拉南部卡辛加的西南非洲人民组织基地，造成约 600 人死亡
zh.s: 南非国防军（南非语：Suid-Afrikaanse Weermag）是南非 1957 至 1994 年间的武装部队。1961 年南非重组为共和国前不久，旧南非联邦国防军依 1957 年《国防法》（第 44 号）正式改组为南非国防军。1994 年，南非国防军又由南非国防军取代。

en.s: Margaret Hilda Thatcher, Baroness Thatcher (née Roberts; 13 October 1925 – 8 April 2013) was a British stateswoman who served as Prime Minister of the United Kingdom from 1979 to 1990 and Leader of the Conservative Party from 1975 to 1990. She was the longest-serving British prime minister of the 20th century and the first woman to hold the office.

zh.t: 玛格丽特·撒切尔就任英国首相
zh.s: 玛格丽特·希尔达·撒切尔（娘家姓罗伯茨；1925 年 10 月 13 日—2013 年 4 月 8 日）是英国政治家，1979 至 1990 年担任英国首相，1975 至 1990 年担任保守党领袖。她是 20 世纪任期最长的英国首相，也是首位担任这一职务的女性。

en.s: The 1980 WFA Cup Final was the 10th final of the FA Women's Cup, England's primary cup competition for women's football teams. It was the tenth final to be held under the direct control of Women's Football Association (WFA). St Helens and Preston North End contested the match at Southbury Road, the former home stadium of Enfield F.C. on 4 May 1980.

zh.s: 1980年女子足总杯决赛是该赛事第10届决赛，也是英格兰女子足球队主要杯赛的决赛。本届比赛由女子足球协会直接管理。1980年5月4日，圣海伦斯与普雷斯顿北区在南伯里路球场交锋；该球场曾是恩菲尔德足球俱乐部的主场。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Kiribati on 4 May 1982. The result was a victory for incumbent Ieremia Tabai, who won 48.7% of the vote. Voter turnout was 82.4%.

en.s: The 1982 Orkney Islands Council election, the third election to Orkney Islands Council, was held on 4 May 1982 as part of the wider 1982 Scottish regional elections. The election saw the Independents take all save one of the seats on the council as the pro-autonomy Orkney Movement contested its first election, winning one seat. Two other Orkney Movement members, Billy Dass and Chris Soames, were elected as independent candidates.

zh.s: 奥克尼群岛议会第三届选举于1982年5月4日举行，是1982年苏格兰地区选举的一部分。独立候选人几乎赢得全部席位；支持自治的奥克尼运动首次参选并赢得1席。该运动另外两名成员比利·达斯和克里斯·索姆斯则以独立候选人身份当选。

en.s: Legislative elections were held in Indonesia on 4 May 1982. They were the fourth legislative elections since independence and the third under the New Order regime There were three participants; the two political parties, the United Development Party (PPP), the Indonesian Democratic Party (PDI) and the "functional group" Golkar. As with all elections during the New Order regime, the government-backed Golkar organization won an absolute majority.

zh.s: 1982年5月4日，印度尼西亚举行立法选举。这是该国独立后的第四次立法选举，也是“新秩序”政权下的第三次选举。共有三个参选组织：建设统一党（PPP）、印度尼西亚民主党（PDI）和“功能团体”戈尔卡尔党。与新秩序时期历次选举一样，得到政府支持的戈尔卡尔党赢得绝对多数。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Austria on 4 May 1986 with a second round on 8 June 1986. Kurt Waldheim, former Secretary-General of the United Nations, endorsed by the Austrian People's Party was elected. Following Waldheim's victory, Chancellor Fred Sinowatz and other government members of the defeated Socialist Party stepped down, including the Minister of Foreign Affairs Leopold Gratz, who said he refused to "direct the Austrian foreign service in the defense of President Waldheim."

zh.s: 奥地利于1986年5月4日举行总统选举，第二轮投票于6月8日举行。由奥地利人民党支持的前联合国秘书长库尔特·瓦尔德海姆当选。瓦尔德海姆胜选后，总理弗雷德·西诺瓦茨和其他社会党政府成员辞职，其中包括外交部长利奥波德·格拉茨。格拉茨表示，他拒绝“代表奥地利外交部门为瓦尔德海姆总统辩护”。

en.s: The 1986 WFA Cup Final was the 16th final of the WFA Cup, England's primary cup competition for women's football teams. The showpiece event was played under the auspices of the Women's Football Association (WFA). Norwich City and Doncaster Belles contested the match at Carrow Road in Norwich on 4 May 1986. Norwich City won the match 4–3.

zh.s: 1986年女子足球协会杯决赛是该赛事第16届决赛，也是英格兰女子足球队主要杯赛的决赛。比赛由女子足球协会主办。1986年5月4日，诺里奇城与唐卡斯特贝尔斯在诺里奇卡罗路球场交锋，诺里奇城以4比3获胜。

en.s: The PEPCON disaster was an industrial disaster that occurred in Henderson, Nevada on May 4, 1988 at the Pacific Engineering and Production Company of Nevada (PEPCON) plant. The conflagration and subsequent explosions killed two people, injured 372 others, and caused an estimated US$100 million of damage. A large portion of the Las Vegas Valley within a 10-mile (16 km) radius of the plant was affected, and several agencies activated disaster plans.

zh.s: PEPCON事故是一起工业灾难，1988年5月4日发生在美国内华达州亨德森市内华达太平洋工程与生产公司（PEPCON）工厂。大火及随后的爆炸造成2人死亡、372人受伤，估计损失达1亿美元。工厂周围10英里（16公里）范围内的拉斯维加斯谷大部分地区受到影响，多家机构启动了灾害应对预案。

en.s: A by-election was held for the British House of Commons constituency of Vale of Glamorgan on 4 May 1989 following the death of Conservative MP Sir Raymond Gower. Eleven candidates stood, which remains the most in any Welsh by-election. The result was a Labour gain, the party's first by-election gain of this parliamentary term, which came at a time when it was starting to match and even overtake the Conservative government in the opinion polls, just after the controversial poll tax was announced. Neil Kinnock believed the result, which was reported as 'a massive victory' for Labour, showed a change in the Labour Party's fortunes, and stated "the tide has turned".

zh.s: 1989年5月4日，英国下议院格拉摩根谷选区举行补选，此前保守党议员雷蒙德·高尔爵士去世。共有11名候选人参选，至今仍是威尔士补选中候选人数最多的一次。工党赢得该席位，这是本届议会任期内工党首次在补选中获胜。当时，民调显示工党支持率已开始接近甚至超过保守党政府；这场选举发生在备受争议的人头税公布后不久。尼尔·金诺克认为，媒体所称的工党“大胜”显示该党形势正在好转，并表示“风向已经变了”。

en.s: The 1989 Nottinghamshire County Council election was held on Thursday, 4 May 1989. The whole council of eighty-eight members was up for election and the result was that the Labour Party retained control of the Council, winning fifty seats. The Conservatives won thirty-four councillors and the Social and Liberal Democrats won four seats. Minor boundary changes took place for this election, with the parish of Broadholme being transferred to Lincolnshire and the division of Newstead was enlarged by the addition of Ravenshead which had been transferred to Gedling from Newark and Sherwood in 1987.

zh.s: 1989年诺丁汉郡议会选举于5月4日星期四举行，议会全部88个席位改选。工党赢得50席，继续执政；保守党赢得34席，社会自由民主党赢得4席。本次选举前进行了一些小幅选区调整：布罗德霍姆教区划归林肯郡，纽斯特德选区则因拉文斯黑德并入而扩大。拉文斯黑德于1987年从纽瓦克和舍伍德划入盖德灵。

The whole council of 76 members was up for election and the election resulted in the Conservative Party retaining control of the council and winning the same number of seats as the previous election in 1985, with 39 seats.

en.s: The 1989 United Kingdom local elections were held on Thursday 4 May 1989 in England and Wales, and Wednesday 17 May 1989 in Northern Ireland. The Labour Party had the highest projected national vote share, but the Conservative Party, in power at Westminster, gained the most seats. On the same day, there was a parliamentary by-election in the Vale of Glamorgan constituency in Wales; Labour won the seat from the Conservatives.

zh.s: 1989年英国地方选举于5月4日星期四在英格兰和威尔士举行，北爱尔兰则于5月17日星期三举行。工党的预计全国得票率最高，但当时执政的保守党赢得更多议席。同一天，威尔士格拉摩根谷选区举行下议院补选，工党从保守党手中赢得该席位。

en.s: Local elections to Northumberland County Council, a county council in the north east of England, were held on 4 May 1989, resulting in a council with Labour members forming a majority.

en.s: The 1989 Essex County Council election took place on 4 May 1989 to elect members of Essex County Council in Essex, England. It was held on the same day as other local elections. 98 councillors were elected from various electoral divisions, which returned either one or two county councillors each by first-past-the-post voting for a four-year term of office.

en.s: The 1989 Suffolk County Council election took place on 4 May 1989 to elect members of Suffolk County Council in Suffolk, England. It was held on the same day as other local elections.

en.s: STS-30 was the 29th NASA Space Shuttle mission and the fourth mission for Space Shuttle Atlantis. It was the fourth shuttle launch since the Challenger disaster and the first shuttle mission since the disaster to have a female astronaut on board. The mission launched from Kennedy Space Center, Florida, on May 4, 1989, and landed four days later on May 8, 1989.

zh.s: STS-30是美国国家航空航天局（NASA）的第29次航天飞机任务，也是“亚特兰蒂斯”号航天飞机的第四次任务。这是“挑战者”号事故后第四次航天飞机发射，也是事故后首次有女性宇航员参加的航天飞机任务。任务于1989年5月4日从佛罗里达州肯尼迪航天中心发射，四天后于5月8日着陆。

en.s: The Declaration "On the Restoration of Independence of the Republic of Latvia" (Latvian: Deklarācija par Latvijas Republikas neatkarības atjaunošanu) was adopted on 4 May 1990 by the Supreme Soviet of the Latvian SSR in which Latvia declared the re-instatement of its sovereignty and its independence from the Soviet Union.

en.t: On 4 May 1990, the Supreme Council adopted the Declaration on the Restoration of Independence of the Republic of Latvia, and the Latvian SSR was renamed Republic of Latvia
en.s: Latvia, officially the Republic of Latvia, is a country in the Baltic region of northern Europe. It is one of the three Baltic states, along with Estonia to the north and Lithuania to the south. It borders Russia to the east and Belarus to the southeast and shares a maritime border with Sweden to the west. Latvia covers an area of 64,573 km2 (24,932 sq mi), with a population of 1.83 million.

zh.t: 拉脱维亚最高委员会通过《恢复拉脱维亚共和国独立宣言》，并将拉脱维亚苏维埃社会主义共和国更名为拉脱维亚共和国
zh.s: 拉脱维亚正式名称为拉脱维亚共和国，是北欧波罗的海地区的国家。它与爱沙尼亚、立陶宛并称波罗的海三国，东邻俄罗斯，东南邻白俄罗斯，西隔海与瑞典相望。拉脱维亚面积为 64,573 平方公里（24,932 平方英里），人口 183 万。

en.s: The siege of Goražde (Bosnian: Opsada Goražda; Serbian Cyrillic: Опсада Горажда) refers to engagements during the Bosnian War (1992–95) in and around the town of Goražde in eastern Bosnia. On 4 May 1992, Goražde was besieged by the Army of Republika Srpska (VRS). It was attacked from three sides - from the north, the south and the east.

zh.s: 戈拉日代围城战（波斯尼亚语：Opsada Goražda；塞尔维亚语西里尔字母：Опсада Горажда）指波斯尼亚战争（1992—1995年）期间在波斯尼亚东部戈拉日代镇内及周边发生的一系列战斗。1992年5月4日，塞族共和国军开始围攻戈拉日代，并从北、南、东三个方向发动攻击。

en.s: The 1994 European Cup Winners' Cup final was a football match on 4 May 1994 contested between Arsenal of England and title holders Parma of Italy. It was the final match of the 1993–94 European Cup Winners' Cup and the 34th European Cup Winners' Cup final. The final was held at the Parken Stadium in Copenhagen, and Arsenal won 1–0 with the goal coming from Alan Smith.

zh.s: 1994年5月4日，英格兰阿森纳与意大利卫冕冠军帕尔马进行欧洲优胜者杯决赛。这是1993—94赛季欧洲优胜者杯的最后一场比赛，也是该赛事第34届决赛。比赛在哥本哈根帕肯球场举行，阿森纳凭借艾伦·史密斯的进球以1比0获胜。

en.s: The 1994 Bulgarian Cup final was the 54th final of the Bulgarian Cup, and was contested between Pirin Blagoevgrad and Levski Sofia on 4 May 1994 at Vasil Levski National Stadium in Sofia. Levski won the final 1–0.

zh.s: 1994年保加利亚杯决赛是该赛事第54届决赛，于1994年5月4日在索非亚瓦西尔·列夫斯基国家体育场举行，由布拉戈耶夫格勒皮林对阵索非亚列夫斯基。列夫斯基以1比0获胜。

en.s: The 1995 United Kingdom local elections took place on 4 May 1995. The Conservative Party lost over 2,000 councillors in the election, while the Labour Party won 48% of the vote, a record high for the party in local elections. The elections were the first to be contested under Labour's new leadership of Tony Blair, who had been elected the previous year following the sudden death of his predecessor John Smith. This was also the first election of 22 Welsh and 14 English unitary authorities, creating shadow authorities which ran in parallel with existing councils until taking power in April 1996, except for the new Isle of Wight Council which took power immediately.

zh.s: 1995年英国地方选举于5月4日举行。保守党失去了2,000多个议席，工党获得48%的选票，创下该党在地方选举中的最高得票率。这是工党新任领袖托尼·布莱尔领导下的首次选举；他于前一年在前任约翰·史密斯突然去世后当选党魁。本次选举还涉及22个威尔士和14个英格兰单一管理区的首次选举。新议会先以影子机构形式与原有地方政府并行，直到1996年4月正式接管；新怀特岛议会则立即开始运作。

en.s: The 1995 Bristol City Council election took place on 4 May 1995 with all seats being up for election, in preparation for Bristol City Council becoming a Unitary Authority following the abolition of Avon County Council. The same ward boundaries were used, however these are elections to a new authority and cannot be considered gains or losses compared to previously held seats. The election saw national issues, such as the unpopularity of the national Conservative government and the state of the economy, being the major issues in the election. The Conservative candidates branded themselves as 'Bristol Conservatives', which was seen as an attempt to distance themselves from the national government.

zh.s: 1995年布里斯托尔市议会选举于5月4日举行，所有席位均改选，为布里斯托尔市议会在埃文郡议会撤销后成为单一管理区做准备。选举采用的选区边界与此前相同，但这是新地方当局的选举，因此不能与旧议会的席位增减直接比较。全国政治议题是竞选焦点之一，包括保守党政府不受欢迎以及经济状况。保守党候选人以“布里斯托尔保守党人”为名参选，被认为是为了与中央政府保持距离。

en.s: Elections to the new City of York unitary authority were held on 4 May 1995. All 53 council seats in the city were up for election and the Labour Party won overall control of the council. Labour had controlled the 1973-1995 York City Council as a majority group since 1986 but following the creation of an expanded City of York unitary authority 22 councillors were returned to represent parished areas previously part of the more rural district council areas of Ryedale (14 councillors), Selby (6) and Harrogate (2). These areas were generally considered to be less fertile territory for Labour.

zh.s: 新设立的约克市单一管理区议会选举于1995年5月4日举行，53个议席全部改选，工党取得议会整体控制权。自1986年以来，工党一直以多数党身份控制1973至1995年的约克市议会。但扩大的约克市单一管理区成立后，有22名议员代表原属较偏远地区议会的教区选区：赖代尔选区14人、塞尔比选区6人、哈罗盖特选区2人。这些地区通常被认为不太容易成为工党的优势选区。

en.s: The 1995 Braintree District Council election took place on 4 May 1995 to elect members of Braintree District Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.s: 1995年布伦特里区议会选举于5月4日举行，选出英格兰布伦特里区议会议员，与其他地方选举同日举行。

en.s: The 1995 Wirral Metropolitan Borough Council election took place on 4 May 1995 to elect members of Wirral Metropolitan Borough Council in England. This election was held on the same day as other local elections.

zh.t: 1995年威勒尔都市自治市议会选举
zh.s: 1995年威勒尔都市自治市议会选举于5月4日举行，选出英格兰威勒尔都市自治市议会议员，与其他地方选举同日举行。

en.t: 1995 Bath and North East Somerset Council election
en.s: The 1995 Bath and North East Somerset Council election was held on Thursday 4 May 1995 to elect councillors to the newly formed Bath and North East Somerset Council in England. It took place on the same day as other district council elections in the United Kingdom. These were the first elections to the new unitary council, which would come into effect on 1 April 1996.

zh.t: 1995年巴斯和东北萨默塞特议会选举
zh.s: 巴斯和东北萨默塞特议会选举于1995年5月4日星期四举行，选出新成立的英格兰巴斯和东北萨默塞特议会议员，与英国其他区议会选举同日。这是新单一管理区议会的首次选举，该议会将于1996年4月1日正式成立。

en.s: Elections to Rochford District Council, in Essex, England, were held on 4 May 1995. One third of the council was up for election.

zh.s: 英格兰埃塞克斯郡罗奇福德区议会选举于1995年5月4日举行，改选三分之一席位。

en.t: 1995 King's Lynn and West Norfolk Borough Council election
en.s: The 1995 King's Lynn & West Norfolk Borough Council election took place on 4 May 1995 to elect members of King's Lynn & West Norfolk Borough Council in Norfolk, England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.t: 1995年西诺福克与金斯林自治市议会选举
zh.s: 1995年西诺福克与金斯林自治市议会选举于5月4日举行，选出英格兰诺福克郡西诺福克与金斯林自治市议会议员，与其他地方选举同日举行。

en.s: The 1995 Horsham District Council election took place on 4 May 1995 to elect members of Horsham District Council in England. It was held on the same day as other local elections. The Liberal Democrats gained control of the council from the Conservatives with a 3 seat majority. This was the first time ever the Conservative Party lost control of Horsham District Council since they first won overall control in 1976.

zh.s: 1995年霍舍姆区议会选举于5月4日举行，选出英格兰霍舍姆区议会议员，与其他地方选举同日举行。自由民主党以3席多数从保守党手中取得议会控制权。这是保守党自1976年首次赢得霍舍姆区议会多数以来，第一次失去控制权。

en.s: The 1995 Exeter City Council election took place on 4 May 1995 to elect members of Exeter City Council in Devon, England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.s: 1995年埃克塞特市议会选举于5月4日举行，选出英格兰德文郡埃克塞特市议会议员，与其他地方选举同日举行。

en.s: Local elections in Wales were held on 4 May 1995 to elect members to the twenty-two newly created local authorities. They were held alongside other local elections in the United Kingdom. The previous elections were held in 1993.

zh.s: 威尔士地方选举于1995年5月4日举行，选出新设立的22个地方当局议员。选举与英国其他地方选举同期举行。上一届选举于1993年举行。

en.s: The 1995 Uttlesford District Council election took place on 4 May 1995 to elect members of Uttlesford District Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

en.s: The 1995 Bournemouth Borough Council election was held on 4 May 1995 to elect members to Bournemouth Borough Council in Dorset, England. This was on the same day as other local elections. The council stayed in No overall control, with the Liberal Democrats remaining the largest party.

en.s: The 1995 St. Edmundsbury Borough Council election took place on 4 May 1995 to elect members of St Edmundsbury Borough Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.t: 1995年圣埃德蒙兹伯里自治市议会选举
zh.s: 1995年圣埃德蒙兹伯里自治市议会选举于5月4日举行，选出英格兰圣埃德蒙兹伯里自治市议会议员，与其他地方选举同日举行。

en.s: The 1995 Southend-on-Sea Council election took place on 4 May 1995 to elect members of Southend-on-Sea Borough Council in Essex, England. One third of the council was up for election.

zh.t: 1995年滨海绍森德自治市议会选举
zh.s: 1995年滨海绍森德议会选举于5月4日举行，选出英格兰埃塞克斯郡滨海绍森德自治市议会议员，改选三分之一席位。

en.s: The 1995 West Dorset District Council election was held on Thursday 4 May 1995 to elect councillors to West Dorset District Council in England. It took place on the same day as other district council elections in the United Kingdom. The entire council was up for election. The 1995 election saw the council remain in no overall control, with Independent councillors and the Conservatives each electing 18 councillors.

zh.s: 西多塞特区议会选举于1995年5月4日星期四举行，选出英格兰西多塞特区议会议员，与英国其他区议会选举同日。全部议席改选。选后议会仍无多数党控制，独立议员和保守党各赢得18席。

en.s: The 1995 Breckland District Council election took place on 4 May 1995 to elect members of Breckland District Council in Norfolk, England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.s: 1995年布雷克兰区议会选举于5月4日举行，选出英格兰诺福克郡布雷克兰区议会议员，与其他地方选举同日举行。

en.s: The 1995 Harlow District Council election took place on 4 May 1995 to elect members of Harlow District Council in Essex, England. This was on the same day as other local elections. The Labour Party retained control of the council, which it had held continuously since the council's creation in 1973.

zh.s: 1995年哈洛区议会选举于5月4日举行，选出英格兰埃塞克斯郡哈洛区议会议员，与其他地方选举同日举行。工党继续控制议会；自1973年该议会成立以来，该党一直执政。

en.s: The 1995 Chelmsford Borough Council election took place on 4 May 1995 to elect members of Chelmsford Borough Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.t: 1995年切姆斯福德自治市议会选举
zh.s: 1995年切姆斯福德自治市议会选举于5月4日举行，选出英格兰切姆斯福德自治市议会议员，与其他地方选举同日举行。

en.s: The 1995 Stevenage Borough Council election took place on 4 May 1995. This was on the same day as other local elections. One third of the council was up for election; the seats which were last contested in 1991. There was also a second seat up for election in Martins Wood ward. The Labour Party retained control of the council, which it had held continuously since its creation in 1973.

zh.t: 1995年史蒂夫尼奇自治市议会选举
zh.s: 1995年史蒂夫尼奇自治市议会选举于5月4日举行，与其他地方选举同日。改选三分之一席位，上一轮改选这些席位是在1991年；马丁斯伍德选区另有一个席位同时改选。工党继续控制议会；自1973年该议会成立以来，该党一直执政。

en.s: The 1995 Brighton Borough Council election took place on 4 May 1995 to elect members of Brighton Borough Council in East Sussex, England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.s: 1995年布莱顿自治市议会选举于5月4日举行，选出英格兰东萨塞克斯郡布莱顿自治市议会议员，与其他地方选举同日举行。

en.s: The 1995 Reading Borough Council election was held on 4 May 1995, at the same time as other local elections across Britain. Sixteen of the 45 seats on Reading Borough Council were up for election, being the usual third of the council (15 seats) plus a by-election in Redlands ward, where Labour councillor Robert Sulley had resigned. Labour increased its majority on the council.

zh.s: 雷丁自治市议会选举于1995年5月4日举行，与英国各地其他地方选举同期进行。雷丁自治市议会45个席位中有16席改选，包括按惯例改选的三分之一席位（15席），以及雷德兰兹选区的一席补选。该补选因工党议员罗伯特·萨利辞职而举行。工党扩大了在议会中的多数优势。

en.s: The 1995 Tendring District Council election was held on 4 May 1995. This was on the same day as other local elections across the United Kingdom.

zh.s: 1995年滕德林区议会选举于5月4日举行，与英国各地其他地方选举同日举行。

en.s: The 1995 Colchester Borough Council election took place on 4 May 1995 to elect members of Colchester Borough Council in Essex, England. This was on the same day as other local elections across the United Kingdom.

zh.t: 1995年科尔切斯特自治市议会选举
zh.s: 1995年科尔切斯特自治市议会选举于5月4日举行，选出英格兰埃塞克斯郡科尔切斯特自治市议会议员，与英国各地其他地方选举同日举行。

en.s: The 1995 Basildon District Council election took place on 4 May 1995 to elect members of Basildon District Council in Essex, England. This was on the same day as other local elections. One third of the council was up for election; the seats which were last contested in 1991. The council remained under no overall control.

zh.s: 1995年巴西尔登区议会选举于5月4日举行，选出英格兰埃塞克斯郡巴西尔登区议会议员，与其他地方选举同日举行。改选三分之一席位，上次改选这些席位是在1991年。选后议会仍无多数党控制。

en.s: An election was held on 4 May 1995 to elect all 34 members of the North Warwickshire Borough Council in the English Midlands. It resulted in the Labour Party retaining control of the council. This election saw Labour making significant gains, winning nine more seats than the last election from eight Conservative councillors and an independent. The Conservatives only retained four of the twelve seats they held.

zh.t: 1995年北沃里克郡自治市议会选举
zh.s: 1995年5月4日，英格兰中部举行北沃里克郡自治市议会选举，改选全部34名议员。工党保住了议会控制权，并比上次选举多赢得9席，这些席位来自8名保守党议员和一名独立议员。保守党此前拥有的12席中仅保住4席。

en.s: Elections to Liverpool City Council were held on 4 May 1995. One third of the council was up for election and although the election resulted in the continuation of no overall control, the Labour Party continued to lead a minority administration.

zh.s: 1995年5月4日举行利物浦市议会选举，改选议会三分之一席位。选举后议会仍没有任何政党取得过半席位，工党继续领导少数派政府。

en.s: Elections to Mid Bedfordshire District Council were held on 4 May 1995. All 53 seats were up for election.

zh.t: 1995年中贝德福德郡区议会选举
zh.s: 1995年5月4日举行中贝德福德郡区议会选举，全部53席均参加改选。

en.s: Operation Steel (Turkish: Çelik Harekâtı) was a cross-border operation by the Turkish Armed Forces into northern Iraq between 20 March and 4 May 1995 against the Kurdistan Workers' Party (PKK). The invasion of Iraqi Kurdistan was a short term military operation and ended with both sides losing heavy casualties .

zh.s: 钢铁行动（土耳其语：Çelik Harekâtı）是土耳其武装部队于1995年3月20日至5月4日在伊拉克北部发起的越境行动，目标是库尔德工人党。此次对伊拉克库尔德斯坦的军事行动时间较短，双方都伤亡惨重。

en.s: The 1995 North Hertfordshire District Council election was held on 4 May 1995, at the same time as other local elections across England and Wales. There were 17 out of 50 seats on North Hertfordshire District Council up for election, being the usual third of the council. The council remained under no overall control.

zh.t: 1995年北赫特福德郡区议会选举
zh.s: 1995年5月4日，北赫特福德郡区议会选举与英格兰和威尔士其他地方选举同日举行。议会50席中的17席参加改选，按常规为三分之一席位。选举后，议会仍没有任何政党取得过半席位。

en.s: The 1995 City of Lincoln Council election took place on 4 May 1995. This was on the same day as other local elections. One third of the council was up for election: the seats of which were last contested in 1991. The Labour Party retained control of the council.

zh.s: 1995年5月4日举行林肯市议会选举，与其他地方选举同日进行。议会三分之一席位参加改选，这些席位上次于1991年改选。工党保住了议会控制权。

en.s: The 1995 Ipswich Borough Council election was an election to the Ipswich Borough Council under the arrangement, whereby a third of the councillors were to stand for election, each time. It took place as part of the 1995 United Kingdom local elections. There were 16 wards each returning one councillor plus one bye-election for Sprites Ward. The Labour Party retained control of the Council.

zh.t: 1995年伊普斯威奇自治市议会选举
zh.s: 1995年伊普斯威奇自治市议会选举是英国1995年地方选举的一部分，按三分之一议员轮流改选的安排举行。伊普斯威奇有16个选区，每区选出一名议员；斯普赖茨选区另举行一场补选。工党继续控制议会。

en.s: The 1996 Coupe de France final was a football match held at the Parc des Princes in Paris on 4 May 1996, that saw Auxerre defeat Nîmes 2–1 thanks to goals by Laurent Blanc and Lilian Laslandes.

zh.s: 1996年5月4日，欧塞尔与尼姆在巴黎王子公园球场进行法国杯决赛。欧塞尔凭借洛朗·布兰克和利利安·拉斯兰的进球，以2比1获胜。

en.s: The 1997 FA Women's Cup Final was the 27th final of the FA Women's Cup, England's primary cup competition for women's football teams. The showpiece event was the fourth to be played directly under the auspices of the Football Association (FA) and was known as the UK Living FA Women's Cup Final for sponsorship reasons. Millwall Lionesses and Wembley contested the match at West Ham United's Upton Park in London on 4 May 1997.

zh.s: 1997年英格兰足总女子杯决赛是该赛事第27届决赛，也是英格兰女子足球队主要杯赛的决赛。本届是英格兰足球总会直接主办的第四届决赛，因赞助原因称为UK Living英格兰足总女子杯决赛。1997年5月4日，米尔沃尔女足与温布利女足在伦敦西汉姆联队的厄普顿公园球场交锋。

en.s: The 1998 FA Women's Cup final was the 27th final of the FA Women's Cup, England's primary cup competition for women's football teams. It was the fifth final to be held under the direct control of the Football Association (FA). It was contested between Arsenal and Croydon Women at The New Den, home of Millwall. The final ended 3–2 in favour of Arsenal.

zh.s: 1998年英格兰足总女子杯决赛是该项女子足球主要杯赛的第27届决赛，也是英格兰足球总会直接管理下的第5届决赛。阿森纳与克罗伊登女子队在米尔沃尔主场新丹球场展开决赛，阿森纳最终以3比2获胜。

en.s: The 1999 St. Edmundsbury Borough Council election took place on 4 May 1999 to elect members of St Edmundsbury Borough Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.s: 1999年圣埃德蒙兹伯里自治市议会选举于5月4日举行，选出英格兰圣埃德蒙兹伯里自治市议会议员，与其他地方选举同日举行。

en.s: The 1999 Lincoln, Nebraska mayoral election took place on May 4, 1999, following a primary election April 6, 1999. Mayor Mike Johanns was elected Governor in 1998 and resigned as Mayor on November 30, 1998. City Councilman Dale Young was selected to serve out the remainder of his term, and declined to run for a full term.

zh.t: 1999年内布拉斯加州林肯市市长选举
zh.s: 1999年5月4日举行内布拉斯加州林肯市市长选举，此前已于4月6日举行初选。市长迈克·约翰纳斯在1998年当选州长，并于同年11月30日辞去市长职务。市议员戴尔·扬受任完成其剩余任期，但决定不竞选完整任期。

en.s: The 1999 Las Vegas mayoral election took place on May 4 and June 8, 1999 to elect the mayor of Las Vegas, Nevada. The election was held concurrently with various other local elections, and was officially nonpartisan. It saw the election of criminal defense attorney Oscar Goodman. The incumbent mayor Jan Jones, had decided against running for a third term.

zh.s: 1999年拉斯维加斯市长选举于5月4日和6月8日举行，选出内华达州拉斯维加斯市长。选举与其他地方选举同期举行，且不分党派。刑事辩护律师奥斯卡·古德曼当选。现任市长珍·琼斯决定不竞选第三个任期。

en.s: Elections to Sheffield City Council were held on 4 May 2000. One third of the council was up for election. Previous to this election, two Liberal Democrats – Robert Watson and Trefor Morgan – became Independents. Similarly there were two Labour defections, long-time Labour councillor Dorothy Walton went to the Liberal Democrats and Michael Smith became an Independent. The election saw the Liberal Democrats extend their majority through a couple of gains from Labour, with both parties recouping seats where aforementioned defections had taken place. Vote wise, the Liberal Democrat vote notably fell back from their previous elections' consistent increases, whereas the Conservatives managed their best vote share since 1992.

zh.s: 谢菲尔德市议会选举于2000年5月4日举行，改选三分之一席位。选举前，两名自由民主党议员罗伯特·沃森和特雷弗·摩根转为独立议员；工党也有两人转党：资深议员多萝西·沃尔顿加入自由民主党，迈克尔·史密斯成为独立议员。选举中，自由民主党从工党手中赢得少数席位，扩大了多数优势；两党也都在上述议员转党影响的选区重新赢回席位。自由民主党的得票率较前几届连续上升的趋势明显回落，而保守党的得票率则创下1992年以来新高。
