en.s: The 2000 Reading Borough Council election was held on 4 May 2000, at the same time as other local elections across England. Sixteen of the 45 seats on Reading Borough Council were up for election, being the usual third of the council (15 seats) plus a by-election in Kentwood ward, caused by the death of Labour councillor Doris Lawrence.

zh.s: 雷丁自治市议会选举于2000年5月4日举行，与英格兰各地其他地方选举同期进行。雷丁自治市议会45个席位中有16席改选，包括按惯例改选的三分之一席位（15席），以及肯特伍德选区的一席补选。该补选因工党议员多丽丝·劳伦斯去世而举行。

en.s: The 2000 Slough Borough Council election was held on 4 May 2000, at the same time as other local elections across England. Fourteen of the 41 seats on Slough Borough Council were up for election, being the usual third of the council.

zh.s: 斯劳自治市议会选举于2000年5月4日举行，与英格兰各地其他地方选举同期进行。斯劳自治市议会41个席位中有14席改选，约为议会席位的三分之一。

en.s: The 2000 Exeter City Council election took place on 4 May 2000, to elect members of Exeter City Council in England. The entire council was up for election following boundary changes, which increased the number of seats from 36 to 40. The election was held concurrently with other local elections in England. The Labour Party retained control of the council, which it had held since 1995.

zh.s: 2000年埃克塞特市议会选举于5月4日举行，选出英格兰埃克塞特市议会议员。由于选区边界调整，全部议席改选，席位数从36席增至40席。选举与英格兰其他地方选举同期举行。工党继续控制议会；该党自1995年以来一直执政。

en.s: The 2000 Plymouth City Council election was held on 4 May 2000 to elect members of Plymouth City Council in England. This was on the same day as the other local elections. The entire council was up for election and the Conservative Party gained control of the council from the Labour Party.

zh.s: 2000年普利茅斯市议会选举于5月4日举行，选出英格兰普利茅斯市议会议员，与其他地方选举同日举行。全部议席改选，保守党从工党手中取得议会控制权。

en.s: The 2000 Cambridge City Council election took place on 4 May 2000 to elect members of Cambridge City Council in Cambridge, Cambridgeshire, England. This was on the same day as other local elections across England.

zh.s: 2000年剑桥市议会选举于5月4日举行，选出英格兰剑桥郡剑桥市议会议员，与英格兰各地其他地方选举同日举行。

en.s: The 2000 Bracknell Forest Borough Council election took place on 4 May 2000, to elect all 40 members in 19 wards for Bracknell Forest Borough Council in England. The election was held on the same day as other local elections in England as part of the 2000 United Kingdom local elections. The Conservative Party secured a second term in office, increasing its majority.

zh.t: 2000年布拉克内尔森林自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2000年布拉克内尔森林自治市议会选举于5月4日举行，选出英格兰布拉克内尔森林自治市议会40名议员，涉及19个选区。选举与英格兰其他地方选举同日举行，属于2000年英国地方选举的一部分。保守党继续执政，并扩大了多数优势。

en.s: A by-election for the United Kingdom parliamentary constituency of Romsey was held on 4 May 2000, triggered by the death of incumbent Conservative Party Member of Parliament (MP) Michael Colvin. It was won by Sandra Gidley of the Liberal Democrats, who gained the seat from the Conservatives. Colvin and his wife Nichola died in a fire at their home, Tangley House in Tangley, Hampshire, on 24 February 2000.

zh.s: 英国议会罗姆西选区于2000年5月4日举行补选，起因是现任保守党议员迈克尔·科尔文去世。自由民主党候选人桑德拉·吉德利赢得该席位，击败保守党。2000年2月24日，科尔文和妻子妮古拉在汉普郡坦格利的家中发生火灾，两人均在火灾中丧生。

en.s: The 2000 Bassetlaw District Council election took place on 4 May 2000 to elect one third of the members of Bassetlaw District Council in Nottinghamshire, England as part of the 2000 United Kingdom local elections.

zh.s: 2000年巴塞特洛区议会选举于5月4日举行，选出英格兰诺丁汉郡巴塞特洛区议会三分之一议员，是2000年英国地方选举的一部分。

en.s: Elections to Liverpool City Council were held on 4 May 2000. One third of the council was up for election and the Liberal Democrat party kept overall control of the council.

en.s: The first elections for members of the London Assembly were held on 4 May 2000, alongside the first mayoral election. The assembly elections used the additional member system, a form of mixed member proportional representation, with 14 directly elected constituencies and 11 London-wide top-up seats.

zh.s: 2000年5月4日举行首届伦敦议会议员选举，并与首届伦敦市长选举同期举行。议会选举采用附加成员制，这是一种混合成员比例代表制，包括14个直选选区席位和11个全伦敦范围的补充席位。

en.s: The 2000 North Hertfordshire District Council election was held on 4 May 2000, at the same time as other local elections across England. 17 of the 49 seats on North Hertfordshire District Council were up for election, being the usual third plus a by-election in Hitchin Walsworth ward.

en.s: Elections to Croydon Council in London, England were held on 4 May 2002. The whole council was up for election for the first time since the 1998 election. The Labour Party managed to keep control of the council which it had done since 1994 when it took power away from the Conservative Party. This year Labour held Croydon with a smaller majority, only clinging onto power through a tiny amount of votes in its marginal wards - one councillor won by just eight votes. 37 Labour councillors, 32 Conservative councillors and 1 Liberal Democrat councillor were elected, maintaining Labour control of the Council.

zh.t: 2002年克罗伊登自治市议会选举
zh.s: 伦敦克罗伊登议会选举于2002年5月4日举行，全部席位首次自1998年选举以来一并改选。工党继续执政；该党自1994年从保守党手中夺得控制权以来一直掌控克罗伊登。本次选举后，工党优势缩小，在若干边缘选区仅以微弱票数保住席位，其中一名工党议员只以8票之差当选。最终工党赢得37席，保守党32席，自由民主党1席，工党继续控制议会。

en.s: EAS Airlines Flight 4226 was a scheduled domestic passenger flight from Kano to Lagos, Nigeria. On 4 May 2002, the aircraft operating the flight overran the runway on its' takeoff roll and crashed into Gwammaja Quarters, a primarily Muslim densely populated residential area, located approximately three kilometres (1.9 mi; 1.6 nmi) from the airport. The aircraft burst into flames, resulting in the deaths of 71 occupants, with 6 surviving.

zh.s: EAS航空4226号班机是从尼日利亚卡诺飞往拉各斯的定期国内客运航班。2002年5月4日，执行该航班的飞机在起飞滑跑时冲出跑道，坠入距机场约3公里（1.9英里；1.6海里）的瓜马贾居民区。该区人口稠密，居民以穆斯林为主。飞机起火，机上71人死亡，6人幸存。

en.s: The 2002 Insurrextion was a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by the American promotion World Wrestling Federation (WWF, now WWE) and broadcast exclusively in the United Kingdom. It was the third annual Insurrextion and took place on May 4, 2002, at the Wembley Arena in London, England, held exclusively for wrestlers from the promotion's Raw brand division.

zh.s: 2002年“起义”（Insurrextion）是由美国职业摔角联盟世界摔角联合会（WWF，现WWE）制作的付费电视赛事，只在英国播出。这是该赛事第三届，于2002年5月4日在英格兰伦敦的温布利竞技场举行，仅有联盟Raw品牌旗下的摔角选手参加。

en.s: The 2002 Scottish Cup Final was played on 4 May 2002 at Hampden Park in Glasgow and was the final of the 117th Scottish Cup. Celtic and Rangers contested the match, Rangers won the match 3–2, thanks to Peter Løvenkrands's last-minute goal. This was the last Old Firm Scottish Cup final for 22 years until 2024.

zh.s: 2002年5月4日，苏格兰杯第117届决赛在格拉斯哥汉普顿公园球场举行，由凯尔特人对阵流浪者。流浪者凭借彼得·洛文克兰兹在比赛最后时刻的进球，以3比2获胜。这是两队时隔22年再次在苏格兰杯决赛相遇，下一次是在2024年。

en.s: The 2002 FA Cup final was a football match between Arsenal and Chelsea on 4 May 2002 at the Millennium Stadium, Cardiff. It was the final match of the 2001–02 FA Cup, the 121st season of the world's oldest football knockout competition, the FA Cup. Arsenal were appearing in their fifteenth final to Chelsea's seventh.

zh.s: 2002年5月4日，阿森纳与切尔西在卡迪夫千禧球场进行英格兰足总杯决赛。这是2001—02赛季足总杯的最后一场比赛，也是这项世界最古老足球淘汰赛第121个赛季的决赛。阿森纳第15次闯入决赛，切尔西则是第7次。

en.s: The 2004 Indiana Democratic presidential primary was held on May 4 in the U.S. state of Indiana as one of the Democratic Party's statewide nomination contests ahead of the 2004 presidential election. The winner of the state's primary, Kerry, would go on to be the Democratic Party's nominee for the national election. On Election Day, George W. Bush would defeat Kerry handily in Indiana and would ultimately be re-elected as president.

zh.t: 2004年印第安纳州民主党总统初选
zh.s: 美国印第安纳州于2004年5月4日举行民主党总统初选，是该党在总统大选前举行的各州提名竞选之一。州初选由约翰·克里胜出，他后来成为民主党总统候选人。大选日当天，乔治·W·布什在印第安纳州以明显优势击败克里，并最终连任总统。

en.s: Elections to Coventry City Council were held on 4 May 2006. One third of the council was up for election and the Conservative party took overall control of the council. After the election, the composition of the council was * Conservative 29 * Labour 19 * Socialist Alternative 3 * Liberal Democrat 2 * Independent 1 On 25 October 2006 Kate Hunter, a Councillor for Radford Ward, moved from the Labour Party to the Conservative Party. On 17 January 2007 Val Stone, a former Councillor for Longford Ward, moved from being an Independent to the Conservative Party.

zh.s: 考文垂市议会选举于2006年5月4日举行，改选三分之一席位，保守党取得议会整体控制权。选举后，议会席位分布为：保守党29席、工党19席、社会主义替代党3席、自由民主党2席、独立议员1席。2006年10月25日，拉德福德选区议员凯特·亨特从工党转投保守党。2007年1月17日，朗福德选区前议员瓦尔·斯通从独立阵营转投保守党。

en.s: The 2006 Worthing Borough Council election took place on 4 May 2006 to elect members of Worthing Borough Council in West Sussex, England. One third of the council was up for election and the Conservative party stayed in overall control of the council. The results saw the Conservatives suffer a net loss of three seats to the Liberal Democrats although they remained in control of the council. The Liberal Democrats gained a seat in Gaisford and Northbrook wards and both seats in Durrington, with the winner in Northbrook, Diane Jones, becoming the youngest female councillor in Worthing at the age of 22.

zh.s: 2006年沃辛自治市议会选举于5月4日举行，选出英格兰西萨塞克斯郡沃辛自治市议会议员，改选三分之一席位。保守党继续控制议会，但净失去3席给自由民主党。自由民主党赢得盖斯福德和北布鲁克选区各一席，并拿下达灵顿选区两席。北布鲁克选区当选者黛安·琼斯年仅22岁，成为沃辛最年轻的女性议员。

en.s: The 2006 Gateshead Council election was held on Thursday 4 May 2006 to elect members of Gateshead Metropolitan Borough Council, in England. It was held on the same day as other English local elections. One third of the council was up for election, with the poll coming two years after boundary changes in the previous election which had necessitated the whole council facing voters at once. The Labour Party retained control, and a Liberal Democrat gain from Labour in Winlaton and High Spen was the only change in the level of party representation on the council.

zh.s: 盖茨黑德议会选举于2006年5月4日星期四举行，选出英格兰盖茨黑德都市自治市议会议员，与其他英格兰地方选举同日举行。由于上届选举进行过选区调整，本次改选三分之一席位；两年前的上届选举曾因此改选全部议席。工党继续执政。自由民主党从温拉顿和海恩斯潘选区赢得一席，这是议会党派席位分布的唯一变化。

en.s: Elections to Calderdale Metropolitan Borough Council were held on 4 May 2006. One third of the council was up for election and the council stayed under no overall control. 17 of the 51 seats were up for re-election. Although these are the results after the election, the number of seats per party changed later that year. Councillor Paul Rogan was returned by the Rastrick ward in this election for four years as a Conservative councillor and is included in the twenty Conservative seats shown below. However, after the 2006 election, he left the party and joined the English Democrats Party.

en.s: Local government elections took place in England (only) on Thursday 4 May 2006. Polling stations were open between 7:00 and 22:00. All London borough council seats were up for election, as well as a third of the seats on each of the metropolitan borough councils, and a third of some unitary authorities and shire districts. Several councils elected half of their seats: these were Adur, Cheltenham, Fareham, Gosport, Hastings, Nuneaton and Bedworth, and Oxford City. Local elections follow a four-year cycle, and the 2006 election was the follow-on from the 2002 elections.

zh.t: 2006年斯托克波特都市自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2006年斯托克波特都市自治市议会选举于5月4日举行，选出英格兰斯托克波特都市自治市议会议员，与其他地方选举同日举行。改选三分之一席位，当选议员任期四年，到2010年届满。自由民主党继续控制议会。

en.s: The 2006 Crawley Borough Council election took place on 4 May 2006 to elect members of Crawley Borough Council in West Sussex, England. One third of the council was up for election. The Conservatives gained overall control of the council from the Labour Party, albeit with a majority of just one seat.

zh.s: 2006年克劳利自治市议会选举于5月4日举行，选出英格兰西萨塞克斯郡克劳利自治市议会议员，改选三分之一席位。保守党从工党手中取得议会控制权，但多数优势只有1席。

en.s: The 2006 Hillingdon Council election took place on 4 May 2006 to elect members of Hillingdon London Borough Council in London, England. The whole council was up for election and the Conservative Party gained control of the council after gaining 14 seats overall, 9 from Labour and 5 from the Liberal Democrats.

zh.s: 2006年希灵登议会选举于5月4日举行，选出英格兰伦敦希灵登自治市议会议员。全部议席改选，保守党净增14席，取得议会控制权；其中9席来自工党，5席来自自由民主党。

en.t: 2006 City of Bradford Metropolitan District Council election
en.s: The 2006 City of Bradford Metropolitan District Council elections took place on 4 May 2006.

zh.t: 2006年布拉德福德市都市区议会选举
zh.s: 布拉德福德市都市区议会选举于2006年5月4日举行。

en.s: The 2006 Reading Borough Council election was held on 4 May 2006, at the same time as other local elections across England. Seventeen of the 46 seats on Reading Borough Council were up for election, being the usual third of the council plus two by-elections.

zh.s: 雷丁自治市议会选举于2006年5月4日举行，与英格兰各地其他地方选举同期进行。雷丁自治市议会46个席位中有17席改选，包括按惯例改选的三分之一席位，以及两场补选。

en.s: The 2006 Westminster City Council election took place on 4 May 2006 to elect members of Westminster City Council in London, England. The whole council was up for election and the Conservative Party remained in control of the council with no seat changes between the Conservatives and Labour.

zh.s: 2006年威斯敏斯特市议会选举于5月4日举行，选出英格兰伦敦威斯敏斯特市议会议员。全部议席改选，保守党继续控制议会，保守党与工党之间没有席位变化。

en.s: Elections to City of Lincoln Council in Lincolnshire, England, were held on 4 May 2006. One third of the Council was up for election and the Labour Party stayed in overall control of the Council.

zh.s: 英格兰林肯郡林肯市议会选举于2006年5月4日举行，改选三分之一席位。工党继续控制议会。

en.s: Elections to Newcastle City Council were held on 4 May 2006. One third of the council was up for election, with each successful candidate to serve a four-year term of office, expiring in 2010. The council stayed under Liberal Democrat control, with the party gaining one seat overall.

zh.s: 纽卡斯尔市议会选举于2006年5月4日举行，改选三分之一席位，当选议员任期四年，到2010年届满。自由民主党继续控制议会，并净增1席。

en.s: The 2006 Chester City Council election took place on 4 May 2006 to elect members of Chester City Council in Cheshire, England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.s: 2006年切斯特市议会选举于5月4日举行，选出英格兰柴郡切斯特市议会议员，与其他地方选举同日举行。

en.s: The 2006 Birmingham City Council election took place on 4 May 2006 to elect members of Birmingham City Council in West Midlands, England. One third of the council was up for election, with an extra vacancy in Kingstanding due to pending legal proceedings. The result for Kingstanding was the subject of an election petition after errors at the count led to Sharon Ebanks (BNP) being wrongly declared elected.

zh.s: 2006年伯明翰市议会选举于5月4日举行，选出英格兰西米德兰兹郡伯明翰市议会议员，改选三分之一席位。金斯坦丁选区另有一个待补席位，原因是相关法律程序尚未结束。计票出现错误，导致英国国家党候选人莎伦·伊班克斯被错误宣布当选，因此金斯坦丁选举结果受到选举诉讼挑战。

en.s: The 2006 Exeter City Council election took place on 4 May 2006, to elect members of Exeter City Council in Devon, England. The election was held concurrently with other local elections in England. One third of the council was up for election and the council remained under no overall control.

zh.s: 2006年埃克塞特市议会选举于5月4日举行，选出英格兰德文郡埃克塞特市议会议员，与英格兰其他地方选举同期进行。改选三分之一席位，选后议会仍无多数党控制。

en.s: The 2006 Sutton Council election took place on 4 May 2006 to elect members of Sutton London Borough Council in London, England. The whole council was up for election and the Liberal Democrats maintained control of the council, despite losing 11 seats to the Conservatives.

zh.s: 2006年萨顿议会选举于5月4日举行，选出英格兰伦敦萨顿自治市议会议员。全部议席改选。尽管自由民主党失去11席给保守党，该党仍继续控制议会。

en.s: The 2006 Harrow Council election took place on 4 May 2006 to elect members of Harrow London Borough Council in London, England. The whole council was up for election and the Conservative Party gained control of the council after there being no overall control.

zh.s: 2006年哈罗议会选举于5月4日举行，选出英格兰伦敦哈罗自治市议会议员。全部议席改选，保守党从原本无多数党控制的议会手中取得控制权。

en.s: The 2006 Hounslow Council election took place on 4 May 2006 to elect members of Hounslow London Borough Council in London, England. The whole council was up for election and the Labour Party lost control of the council, but remained the largest party. Meanwhile, the Conservatives gained 8 seats from Labour, with the Community Group gaining 3 seats and Hounslow Independent Alliance gaining 2.

zh.t: 2006年豪恩斯洛自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2006年豪恩斯洛议会选举于5月4日举行，选出英格兰伦敦豪恩斯洛自治市议会议员。全部议席改选。工党失去议会控制权，但仍是第一大党。保守党从工党手中赢得8席，社区团体赢得3席，豪恩斯洛独立联盟赢得2席。

en.s: The 2006 Gloucester City Council election took place on 4 May 2006 to elect members of Gloucester City Council in England. Fifteen of the 36 seats on the council were up for election, representing a nominal "third" of the council. No seats changed party at the election, and the council remainder under no overall control.

zh.s: 2006年格洛斯特市议会选举于5月4日举行，选出英格兰格洛斯特市议会议员。议会36席中有15席改选，名义上相当于三分之一席位。所有席位都由原政党保住，选后议会仍无多数党控制。

en.s: The 2006 Doncaster Metropolitan Borough Council elections took place on 4 May 2006. One third of the council was up for election, with the council remaining in no overall control. The Labour Party remained the largest party on the council, picking up two seats overall.

zh.t: 2006年唐卡斯特都市自治市议会选举
zh.s: 唐卡斯特都市自治市议会选举于2006年5月4日举行，改选三分之一席位。选后议会仍无多数党控制，工党继续是第一大党，并净增2席。

en.s: Elections to Dudley Metropolitan Borough Council were held on 4 May 2006. One third of the council was up for election and the Conservatives retained control of the council, while Labour gained one seat and the Liberal Democrats lost one seat.

zh.t: 2006年达德利都市自治市议会选举
zh.s: 达德利都市自治市议会选举于2006年5月4日举行，改选三分之一席位。保守党继续控制议会；工党增加1席，自由民主党失去1席。

en.s: The 2006 Bexley Council election took place on 4 May 2006 to elect members of Bexley London Borough Council in London, England. The whole council was up for election and the Conservative Party gained control of the council from the Labour Party.

zh.t: 2006年贝克斯利自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2006年贝克斯利议会选举于5月4日举行，选出英格兰伦敦贝克斯利自治市议会议员。全部议席改选，保守党从工党手中取得议会控制权。

en.s: The 2006 Plymouth City Council election was held on 4 May 2006 to elect members of Plymouth City Council in England. One third of the council was up for election on the day, with an additional seat in Southway Ward remaining vacant until a by-election on 22 June. After the election, Labour were reduced to 28 out of the 56 filled seats, thus temporarily losing control of the council to No Overall Control.

zh.s: 2006年普利茅斯市议会选举于5月4日举行，选出英格兰普利茅斯市议会议员，改选三分之一席位。南威选区另有一席空缺，直到6月22日补选后才填补。选后工党在56个已填补席位中有28席，暂时失去议会控制权，议会转为无多数党控制。

en.s: Elections for Ealing Council in London were held on 4 May 2006. The 2006 United Kingdom local elections took place on the same day. The Conservatives gained control of the borough from the Labour Party, who themselves had been in control since 1994.

zh.t: 2006年伊灵伦敦自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2006年5月4日，伦敦伊灵自治市举行议会选举。2006年英国地方选举也在同一天举行。保守党从工党手中取得该自治市的控制权；此前工党自1994年以来一直执政。

en.s: Local government elections took place in London, and some other parts of the United Kingdom on Thursday 4 May 2006. Polling stations were open between 7am and 10pm. All London borough council seats were up for election. Mayoral contests were held in the London Boroughs of Hackney, Lewisham, and Newham.

zh.s: 2006年5月4日（星期四），伦敦及英国其他部分地区举行地方政府选举。投票站从上午7时开放至晚上10时。伦敦各自治市议会的所有席位均参加改选，哈克尼、刘易舍姆和纽汉三个伦敦自治市也举行市长选举。

en.s: The 2006 North Hertfordshire District Council election was held on 4 May 2006, at the same time as other local elections across England. 18 of the 49 seats on North Hertfordshire District Council were up for election, being the usual third of the council plus a by-election in Knebworth ward. The Conservatives made a net increase of five seats on the council, increasing their majority.

zh.t: 2006年北赫特福德郡区议会选举
zh.s: 2006年5月4日，北赫特福德郡区议会选举与英格兰其他地方选举同日举行。议会49席中的18席参加改选，包括常规改选的三分之一席位，以及克内布沃思选区的一场补选。保守党净增5席，扩大了在议会的多数。

en.s: Elections to Hyndburn Borough Council were held on 4 May 2006. One third of the council was up for election and the Conservative party stayed in overall control of the council. Two seats had been lost to Labour in by elections in 2005 (Rishton and Overton) but both these were won back at this election. However the Conservatives did lose one seat to Labour, Immanuel Ward reducing their majority to 19.

zh.s: 2006年5月4日举行亨德本自治市议会选举，改选议会三分之一席位。保守党继续控制议会。该党在2005年的两场补选中失去里什顿和奥弗顿两席，但在本次选举中都赢了回来。保守党同时在伊曼纽尔选区失去一席给工党，多数席位减至19席。

en.t: 2006 Barking and Dagenham London Borough Council election
en.s: Elections for Barking and Dagenham London Borough Council were held on Thursday 4 May 2006. The whole council was up for election. Barking and Dagenham is split up into 17 wards, each electing 3 councillors, so a total of 51 seats were up for election. The Labour Party retained control of the council winning 38 seats and 41% of the popular vote.

zh.t: 2006年巴金和达格纳姆伦敦自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2006年5月4日（星期四），巴金和达格纳姆伦敦自治市举行议会选举，全体议员均参加改选。该自治市分为17个选区，每个选区选出3名议员，共有51席。工党赢得38席及41%的普选票，保住了议会控制权。

en.t: 2006 Tower Hamlets London Borough Council election
en.s: Elections to Tower Hamlets London Borough Council were held on 4 May 2006. The entire council stood for election, and the Labour party retained control.

zh.t: 2006年塔村伦敦自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2006年5月4日举行塔村伦敦自治市议会选举，全体议员参加改选。工党保住了议会控制权。

en.t: 2006 Shrewsbury and Atcham Borough Council election
en.s: Elections to Shrewsbury and Atcham Borough Council took place on 4 May 2006. One third of the council was up for election and the Conservative Party stayed in overall control of the council.

zh.t: 2006年什鲁斯伯里和阿查姆自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2006年5月4日举行什鲁斯伯里和阿查姆自治市议会选举，改选议会三分之一席位。保守党继续控制议会。

en.s: Elections for the London Borough of Merton were held on 4 May 2006. This was on the same day as other local elections in England. The Conservatives became the largest party in Merton, forming a minority administration. The incumbent Labour majority administration was defeated.

zh.s: 伦敦默顿自治市议会选举于2006年5月4日举行，与英格兰其他地方选举同日。保守党成为默顿第一大党，并组成少数派政府。工党原本占多数的政府在选举中落败。

en.s: Elections for London Borough of Hackney Council were held on Thursday 4 May 2006. The whole council was up for election. Hackney is divided into 19 wards, each electing three councillors, so a total of 57 seats were up for election.

zh.s: 伦敦哈克尼自治市议会选举于2006年5月4日星期四举行，全部议席改选。哈克尼分为19个选区，每个选区选出3名议员，共改选57席。

en.t: 2006 Kingston upon Thames London Borough Council election
en.s: Elections to Kingston upon Thames London Borough Council were held on 4 May 2006. The whole council was up for election and the Liberal Democrats held overall control, the first time any political party has retained control of the council since 1982.

zh.t: 2006年泰晤士河畔金斯顿自治市议会选举
zh.s: 泰晤士河畔金斯顿自治市议会选举于2006年5月4日举行，全部议席改选。自由民主党继续控制议会，这是自1982年以来首次有政党在该议会连任执政。

en.s: Elections for London Borough of Redbridge Council were held on Thursday 4 May 2006. The whole council was up for election. Redbridge is divided into 21 wards, each electing 3 councilors, so a total of 63 seats were up for election.

zh.t: 2006年雷德布里奇自治市议会选举
zh.s: 伦敦雷德布里奇自治市议会选举于2006年5月4日星期四举行，全部议席改选。雷德布里奇分为21个选区，每个选区选出3名议员，共改选63席。

en.s: Elections to Lambeth London Borough Council were held on 4 May 2006. The whole council was up for election with no boundary changes since the last election in 2002. The Labour Party gained control of the council, replacing the Liberal Democrat and Conservative coalition that had run the council since the previous election.

zh.s: 兰贝斯自治市议会选举于2006年5月4日举行，全部议席改选，与2002年上届选举相比没有选区边界变化。工党从自上届选举以来执政的自由民主党与保守党联合政府手中取得议会控制权。

en.t: 2006 Richmond upon Thames London Borough Council election
en.s: Elections to the Richmond upon Thames London Borough Council were held on 4 May 2006. The whole council was up for election for the first time since the 2002 election. The Liberal Democrats regained control of the council which had been Conservative run from 2002.

zh.t: 2006年泰晤士河畔里士满自治市议会选举
zh.s: 泰晤士河畔里士满自治市议会选举于2006年5月4日举行，全部议席首次自2002年选举以来一并改选。自由民主党重新取得议会控制权；此前议会自2002年以来由保守党执政。

en.s: Elections to Lewisham London Borough Council were held on 4 May 2006. The whole council was up for election for the first time since the 2002 election. Lewisham local elections are held every four years, with the next due in 2010.

zh.t: 2006年刘易舍姆自治市议会选举
zh.s: 刘易舍姆自治市议会选举于2006年5月4日举行，全部议席首次自2002年选举以来一并改选。刘易舍姆每四年举行一次地方选举，下一次定于2010年举行。

en.s: Elections to Daventry District Council were held on 4 May 2006. One third of the council was up for election and the Conservative Party stayed in overall control of the council.

zh.s: 达文特里区议会选举于2006年5月4日举行，改选三分之一席位。保守党继续控制议会。

en.s: Elections to Bromley Council were held on 4 May 2006. The whole council was up for election and the council was held by the Conservatives, with their net gains putting them in their best state for over twenty years.

zh.t: 2006年布罗姆利自治市议会选举
zh.s: 布罗姆利议会选举于2006年5月4日举行，全部议席改选。保守党继续控制议会，并净增席位，使其在该议会的席位优势达到20多年来最佳水平。

en.s: Elections to Haringey Council were held on 4 May 2006. The whole council was up for election for the first time since the 2002 election. Haringey local elections are held every four years, with the next in 2010.

zh.s: 哈林盖自治市议会选举于2006年5月4日举行，全部议席首次自2002年选举以来一并改选。哈林盖每四年举行一次地方选举，下一次于2010年举行。

en.s: Elections to Southwark Council were held on 4 May 2006. The whole council was up for election for the first time since the 2002 election. Southwark local elections are held every four years, with the next due in 2010. The council remained in no overall control.

zh.s: 萨瑟克自治市议会选举于2006年5月4日举行，全部议席首次自2002年选举以来一并改选。萨瑟克每四年举行一次地方选举，下一次定于2010年举行。选后议会仍没有任何政党占多数。

en.s: Elections to Greenwich Council were held on 4 May 2006. The whole council was up for election for the first time since the 2002 election.

zh.t: 2006年格林威治自治市议会选举
zh.s: 格林威治议会选举于2006年5月4日举行，全部议席首次自2002年选举以来一并改选。

en.t: 2006 Hammersmith and Fulham London Borough Council election
en.s: Elections to Hammersmith and Fulham Council were held on 4 May 2006. The whole council was up for election for the first time since the 2002 election.

zh.t: 2006年哈默史密斯-富勒姆自治市议会选举
zh.s: 哈默史密斯-富勒姆议会选举于2006年5月4日举行，全部议席首次自2002年选举以来一并改选。

en.s: In the evening hours of Friday, May 4, 2007, amid a severe weather outbreak across the central United States, a massive and violent tornado moved through Kiowa County in southwest Kansas, before impacting the city of Greensburg and causing widespread devastation. The tornado, known as the Greensburg tornado, tracked 28.8 miles (46.3 km) through the area, killing 10 to 13 people and injuring 63.

zh.s: 2007年5月4日（星期五）晚间，美国中部遭遇严重风暴期间，一场强大而猛烈的龙卷风穿过堪萨斯州西南部基奥瓦县，随后袭击格林斯堡市并造成大范围破坏。这场龙卷风被称为格林斯堡龙卷风，路径长达28.8英里（46.3公里），造成10至13人死亡、63人受伤。

en.s: K-1 Fighting Network Romania 2007 was a kickboxing event held by the K-1 organization in association with the Local Kombat promotion on Friday, May 4, 2007 at the Sala Polivalentă in Bucharest, Romania.

en.s: The Granai airstrike, sometimes called the Granai massacre, refers to the killing of approximately 86 to 147 Afghan civilians by an airstrike by a US Air Force B-1 Bomber on May 4, 2009, in the village of Granai (sometimes spelled Garani or Gerani) in Farah Province, south of Herat, Afghanistan.

zh.s: 格拉奈空袭有时也称格拉奈屠杀。2009年5月4日，美国空军一架B-1轰炸机对阿富汗赫拉特以南法拉省的格拉奈村（也拼作Garani或Gerani）实施空袭，造成约86至147名阿富汗平民死亡。

en.s: The 2009 FA Women's Cup Final was the 39th final of the FA Women's Cup, England's primary cup competition for women's football teams. It was the 16th final to be held under the direct control of the Football Association (FA). The final was contested between Arsenal and Sunderland at Pride Park Stadium in Derby on 4 May 2009.

zh.s: 2009年英格兰足总女子杯决赛是该项女子足球主要杯赛的第39届决赛，也是英格兰足球总会直接管理下的第16届决赛。决赛于2009年5月4日在德比的骄傲公园球场举行，由阿森纳对阵桑德兰。

en.s: St. Andrews Brawl was a professional wrestling pay-per-view produced by Juggalo Championship Wrestling (JCW), which was only available online. It took place on May 4, 2011 at St. Andrews Hall in Detroit, Michigan. Professional wrestling is a type of sports entertainment in which theatrical events are combined with a competitive sport. The buildup to the matches and the scenarios that took place before, during, and after the event, were planned by JCW's script writers. The event starred wrestlers from Juggalo Championship Wrestling's bi-weekly internet wrestling show. Seven matches were held on the event's card.

zh.s: “圣安德鲁斯混战”是由摔角联盟“丑角冠军摔角”（JCW）制作的职业摔角付费直播节目，只能在线收看。节目于2011年5月4日在密歇根州底特律的圣安德鲁斯大厅举行。职业摔角是一种体育娱乐表演，将戏剧化节目与竞技体育结合起来；比赛前后发生的剧情和场景均由JCW编剧设计。节目由JCW每两周播出的网络摔角节目中的选手出演，共安排了7场比赛。

en.s: Operation Lyari (Urdu: جرّاحت لیاری, romanized: Jarr'āhat Lyāri) was a Pakistani government crackdown against crime syndicates, terrorist groups and other local gangs based in the town of Lyari within Karachi in the 2010s and early 2020s, and part of the greater Karachi Operation.
en.n: This entry records the listed event date, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 利亚里行动是巴基斯坦政府于 2010 年代及 2020 年代初在卡拉奇利亚里镇针对犯罪集团、恐怖组织和其他当地帮派开展的打击行动，也是更大规模卡拉奇行动的一部分。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件日期。

en.s: The parliamentary election for the 9th Islamic Consultative Assembly, or Majlis, were held in Iran on Friday, 2 March 2012 with a second round on 4 May 2012 in those 65 districts where no candidate received 25% or more of the votes cast. More than 5,000 candidates registered but more than a third were disqualified by the Guardian Council leaving about 3,400 candidates to run for the 290 seat representing the 31 provinces.
en.n: This entry records the listed event date, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 伊朗于2012年3月2日星期五举行第九届伊斯兰议会选举。在没有候选人获得25%或以上选票的65个选区，第二轮投票于2012年5月4日举行。超过5,000名候选人登记参选，但监护委员会取消了三分之一以上候选人的资格，最后约有3,400人角逐来自31个省的290个席位。
zh.n: 本条采用源信息框所列的事件日期。

en.s: This is an overview of the 2012 Iranian legislative election in Tehran, Rey, Shemiranat and Eslamshahr electoral district.

zh.t: 2012 年伊朗议会选举（德黑兰、雷伊、舍米拉纳特和埃斯兰沙赫尔选区）
zh.s: 本文概述 2012 年伊朗议会选举中德黑兰、雷伊、舍米拉纳特和埃斯兰沙赫尔选区的情况。

en.s: Border Wars (2013) was a professional wrestling internet pay-per-view (iPPV) event co-produced by Ring of Honor (ROH) and Japanese wrestling promotion Pro Wrestling Noah. It took place on May 4, 2013, at the Ted Reeve Arena in Toronto, Ontario, Canada.

zh.s: 2013年“边境战争”是由美国职业摔角联盟荣誉之环（ROH）和日本摔角联盟职业摔角诺亚联合制作的网络付费赛事。比赛于2013年5月4日在加拿大安大略省多伦多的泰德·里夫竞技场举行。

en.s: The 2013 FA Vase final was the 39th final of the Football Association's cup competition for teams below level 8 of the English football league system. It was the 30th FA Vase Final. It was contested by Northern Football League team Spennymoor Town and Kent League team Tunbridge Wells. The match was played at Wembley Stadium in London on 4 May 2013.

zh.s: 2013年足总瓶决赛是英格兰足球联赛第八级别以下球队参加的足总杯赛第39届决赛，也是足总瓶第30届决赛。参赛双方是北方足球联赛球队斯宾尼莫尔镇和肯特联赛球队滕布里奇韦尔斯。比赛于2013年5月4日在伦敦温布利球场举行。

en.s: The Battle of Hamakouladji was a skirmish fought between a unit of the Malian army and MOJWA jihadists that took place in the Malian village of Hamakouladji, located 40 km (25 miles) north of Gao, in the municipality of Tilemsi.

zh.s: 哈马库拉吉战斗是马里军队一支部队与“圣战与布道统一运动”（MOJWA）武装分子之间的一次小规模交战，发生在马里村庄哈马库拉吉。该村位于加奥以北40公里（25英里），属于蒂莱姆西市镇。

loc: 美国新泽西州东卢瑟福

en.s: Extreme Rules (2014) was a professional wrestling pay-per-view event produced by WWE which took place on May 4, 2014 at the Izod Center in East Rutherford, New Jersey. It was the sixth event in the history of the show. Eight professional wrestling matches took place at the event. In the main event, Daniel Bryan successfully defended the WWE World Heavyweight Championship against Kane. Also, The Shield (Dean Ambrose, Seth Rollins and Roman Reigns) managed to overcome the reunited Evolution (Triple H, Randy Orton and Batista) in a six-man tag team match. The event received 108,000 buys (excluding WWE Network views), down from the previous year's 231,000 buys.

zh.s: WWE制作的付费摔角赛事“极限规则”（Extreme Rules）于2014年5月4日在新泽西州东卢瑟福的伊佐德中心举行，这是该系列第六届赛事。现场共进行了8场职业摔角比赛。主赛中，丹尼尔·布莱恩成功卫冕WWE世界重量级冠军，击败凯恩；“盾牌”组合（迪安·安布罗斯、塞斯·罗林斯和罗曼·雷恩斯）也在六人团体赛中击败重新组合的“进化”组合（Triple H、兰迪·奥顿和巴蒂斯塔）。赛事付费点播购买量为108,000次（不包括WWE网络观看量），低于上一年的231,000次。

en.s: General elections were held in Panama on 4 May 2014. Due to constitutional term limits, Incumbent President Ricardo Martinelli was ineligible for a second consecutive term. Incumbent Vice President Juan Carlos Varela of the Partido Panameñista was declared the victor with 39% of the votes counted.

zh.s: 巴拿马于2014年5月4日举行大选。根据宪法任期限制，现任总统里卡多·马蒂内利不能连续第二次竞选总统。现任副总统、巴拿马主义党候选人胡安·卡洛斯·巴雷拉获宣布胜选，得票率为39%。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The Rey del Ring (2014) show (Spanish for "King of the Ring") was an annual professional wrestling major event produced by Mexican professional wrestling promotion International Wrestling Revolution Group (IWRG), and took place on May 4, 2014 in Arena Naucalpan, Naucalpan, State of Mexico, Mexico. The main event was the Eponymous IWRG Rey del Ring tournament, the twelfth annual version of the tournament, which is IWRG's version of WWE's Royal Rumble event.

zh.s: “摔角之王”（西班牙语意为“擂台之王”）是墨西哥摔角联盟国际摔角革命集团（IWRG）每年举办的一场大型职业摔角赛事，2014年5月4日在墨西哥州瑙卡尔潘的瑙卡尔潘竞技场举行。主赛为同名IWRG“摔角之王”锦标赛，这是该赛事第12届，也是IWRG版的WWE“皇家大战”。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: On 4 May 2014, two improvised explosive devices exploded on buses in Nairobi, Kenya, killing three people and injuring sixty-two. Both of the bombs exploded northeast of Nairobi on the Thika Road, an eight-lane controlled-access highway, and detonated 1 kilometre (0.62 mi) apart. Twenty of the wounded were in critical condition after the blast.

zh.s: 2014年5月4日，肯尼亚内罗毕两辆公交车上发生简易爆炸装置爆炸，造成3人死亡、62人受伤。两枚炸弹都在内罗毕东北部的蒂卡公路上爆炸。这条八车道公路设有出入管制，两处爆炸点相距1公里（0.62英里）。爆炸后有20名伤者伤势危重。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 2014 A-League Grand Final was the ninth A-League Grand Final, and was played on 4 May 2014, at Suncorp Stadium, Brisbane. The match was contested by the two winning semi-finalists, Brisbane Roar and Western Sydney Wanderers, who finished first and second respectively in the 2013–14 A-League regular season. The match was won by Brisbane Roar, who beat Western Sydney Wanderers 2–1 in extra time, after the game was drawn at 1–1 at full-time.

zh.s: 2014年澳大利亚A联赛总决赛是该联赛第九届总决赛，于2014年5月4日在布里斯班的桑科普体育场举行。参赛双方是两支半决赛胜队：布里斯班狮吼和西悉尼流浪者；两队在2013—14赛季常规赛中分别排名第一和第二。双方在常规时间战成1比1，布里斯班狮吼在加时赛以2比1获胜。

en.t: 2014 British Columbia New Democratic Party leadership election
en.s: In 2014, the British Columbia New Democratic Party scheduled a leadership election to select a new leader. The contest was called following Adrian Dix's resignation announcement on September 18, 2013, several months after the party's unexpected defeat in the 2013 election after pre-campaign polls had shown the NDP ahead by as much as 20 points.

zh.t: 2014 年不列颠哥伦比亚新民主党领袖选举
zh.s: 2014 年，不列颠哥伦比亚新民主党安排了一场领袖选举，以选出新任党魁。此次选举因阿德里安·迪克斯于 2013 年 9 月 18 日宣布辞职而举行；此前数月，该党在 2013 年选举中意外落败，而竞选前民调曾显示新民主党领先多达 20 个百分点。

en.t: Tripura Tribal Areas Autonomous District Council election, 2015
en.s: Elections to the Tripura Tribal Areas Autonomous District Council (TTAADC) were held on May 4, 2015. 25 of the 28 elected seats in the Autonomous District Council are reserved for Scheduled Tribes. There were 638,060 eligible votes cast in the elections. The electoral turnout stood at 83%. The votes were counted on May 6, 2015. The election result was a landslide victory for the Left Front. The Left Front, with 48.88% of the votes cast, won all 28 seats that were up for election. 25 seats went to the Communist Party of India (Marxist), one seat to the Communist Party of India, one seat to the RSP and one seat to the All India Forward Bloc.

zh.t: 2015年特里普拉部落地区自治委员会选举
zh.s: 特里普拉部落地区自治委员会选举于2015年5月4日举行。自治委员会28个民选席位中，有25席为表列部落保留席位。共有638,060张有效选票，投票率为83%；选票于5月6日统计。左翼阵线大获全胜，得票率为48.88%，赢下本次改选的全部28席。其中，印度共产党（马克思主义）赢得25席，印度共产党、革命社会党和全印前进集团各赢得1席。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 2015 Prince Edward Island general election was held on May 4, 2015, to elect members of the 65th General Assembly of Prince Edward Island. Under amendments passed by the Legislative Assembly of Prince Edward Island in 2008, Prince Edward Island elections are usually held on the first Monday of October in the fourth calendar year, unless it is dissolved earlier by the lieutenant governor of Prince Edward Island due to a motion of no confidence, or at the request of the premier.

zh.s: 爱德华王子岛于2015年5月4日举行大选，选出该省第65届议会成员。根据该省立法议会2008年通过的修正案，选举通常安排在第四个日历年的10月第一个星期一举行；若省督因不信任动议或应省长请求提前解散议会，则例外。

en.s: The 2016 Armenian Cup final was the 25th Armenian Cup Final, and the final match of the 2015–16 Armenian Cup. It was played at the Republican Stadium in Yerevan, Armenia, on 4 May 2016, and was contested by Banants and Mika. It was both Banants and Mika's eighth cup final appearance, with Mika suffering defeat in the previous years final to Pyunik, with Banants last appearance coming in 2010 and also ending in defeat to Pyunik.

zh.s: 2016年亚美尼亚杯决赛是第25届亚美尼亚杯的决赛，也是2015—16赛季赛事的最后一场比赛。决赛于2016年5月4日在亚美尼亚埃里温的共和国体育场举行，由班南特斯对阵米卡。两队此前都曾八次闯入杯赛决赛。米卡在前一年的决赛中负于皮尤尼克；班南特斯上一次进入决赛是在2010年，当时也负于皮尤尼克。

en.s: The 2017 Hertfordshire County Council election took place on 4 May 2017 as part of the 2017 local elections in the United Kingdom. All 78 councillors were elected from electoral divisions which returned one county councillor each by first-past-the-post voting for a four-year term of office. Boundary changes to the electoral divisions took effect at this election after a review of the county by the Local Government Boundary Commission for England increasing the number of seats on the council from 77 to 78.

zh.s: 2017年赫特福德郡议会选举于5月4日举行，是2017年英国地方选举的一部分。全部78名议员均以简单多数制选出，代表63个选区；每名议员任期四年。英格兰地方政府边界委员会审查该郡后调整了选区边界，本次选举起生效，议会席位因此从77席增至78席。

en.s: Local elections in Wales were held on 4 May 2017 to elect members to the twenty-two local authorities. They were held alongside other local elections in the United Kingdom. This included the Isle of Anglesey, which was previously up for election in 2013 due to having its elections delayed for a year. Community council elections also took place on the same day.

zh.s: 威尔士地方选举于2017年5月4日举行，选出22个地方当局的议员，与英国其他地方选举同期进行。安格尔西岛也在本次选举中改选；该岛原定于2013年选举，后因选举延期一年而调整。本日还举行了社区议会选举。

en.s: The 2017 Gwynedd Council election took place on 4 May 2017 to elect members of Gwynedd Council in Wales. Seventy five council seats were up for re-election. In twenty one seats, the candidates were elected unopposed. The Gwynedd election was on the same day as other 2017 Welsh local elections. The May 2017 election in the Hendre ward resulted in a "historic" tie, with the Plaid Cymru and Independent candidates each winning 132 votes.

zh.s: 2017年圭内斯议会选举于5月4日举行，选出威尔士圭内斯议会议员。75个席位改选，其中21个选区的候选人未经竞争当选。选举与威尔士其他地方选举同日举行。2017年5月亨德雷选区出现一场被称为“历史性”的平票：威尔士党候选人和独立候选人各获132票。

en.s: The 2017 elections to Inverclyde Council were held on 4 May 2017, on the same day as the 31 other local authorities in Scotland. It was the third successive Local Council election to run under the STV Electoral System. The election used seven wards created under the Local Governance (Scotland) Act 2004, with 22 Councillors being elected, an increase of 2 from 2012 and an additional ward.

zh.s: 因弗克莱德议会选举于2017年5月4日举行，与苏格兰其他31个地方当局同日选举。这是连续第三届采用单记可让渡投票制的地方议会选举。选举采用《2004年苏格兰地方治理法》设立的7个选区，共选出22名议员，比2012年增加2人，并新增一个选区。

en.s: The 2017 Shropshire Council election took place on 4 May 2017 as part of the 2017 local elections in the United Kingdom. All 74 councillors were elected from 63 electoral divisions which return either one, two or three councillors each by first-past-the-post voting for a four-year term of office.

zh.s: 2017年什罗普郡议会选举于5月4日举行，是2017年英国地方选举的一部分。全部74名议员以简单多数制选出，代表63个选区，各选区选出一至三名议员；议员任期四年。

en.s: The 2017 Stirling Council election was held on 4 May 2017, the same day as the 31 other local authorities in Scotland. The election used the seven wards created under the Local Governance (Scotland) Act 2004, with 23 councillors being elected, an increase of 1 from 2012. Each ward elected either 3 or 4 members, using the STV electoral system.

zh.s: 斯特灵议会选举于2017年5月4日举行，与苏格兰其他31个地方当局同日。选举采用《2004年苏格兰地方治理法》设立的7个选区，共选出23名议员，比2012年增加1人。各选区选出3至4名议员，采用单记可让渡投票制。

en.s: As part of the 2017 local elections in Wales on 4 May 2017, the 54 seats of Bridgend County Borough Council were up for election. Labour lost 13 seats, losing control of the council, while remaining the largest party.

zh.t: 2017年布里真德郡自治市议会选举
zh.s: 作为2017年5月4日威尔士地方选举的一部分，布里真德郡自治市议会54个席位全部改选。工党失去13席和议会控制权，但仍是第一大党。

en.s: The 2017 East Sussex County Council election took place on 4 May 2017 as part of the 2017 local elections in the United Kingdom. All councillors were to be elected from electoral divisions by first-past-the-post voting for a four-year term of office. Boundary changes to the electoral divisions will take effect at this election after a review of the county by the Local Government Boundary Commission for England.

zh.s: 2017年东萨塞克斯郡议会选举于5月4日举行，是2017年英国地方选举的一部分。所有议员均通过简单多数制选出，任期四年。英格兰地方政府边界委员会审查该郡后调整了选区边界，相关调整于本次选举起生效。

en.s: The 2017 Cambridgeshire County Council election was held on 4 May 2017 as part of the 2017 local elections in the United Kingdom. All 61 councillors were elected from 59 electoral divisions, which returned either one or two county councillors each by first-past-the-post voting for a four-year term of office.

zh.s: 剑桥郡议会选举于2017年5月4日举行，是2017年英国地方选举的一部分。59个选区共选出61名议员，各选区选出一至两名郡议员，采用简单多数制，议员任期四年。

en.t: 2017 Blaenau Gwent County Borough Council election
en.s: As part of the 2017 local elections in Wales on 4 May 2017, the 42 seats of Blaenau Gwent County Borough Council were up for election. The majority of members elected were independents, replacing the previous Labour administration.

zh.t: 2017年布莱瑙格温特郡自治市议会选举
zh.s: 作为2017年5月4日威尔士地方选举的一部分，布莱瑙格温特郡自治市议会42个席位全部改选。多数当选议员为独立人士，取代了此前的工党政府。

en.s: The 2017 Isle of Wight Council election took place on 4 May 2017 as part of the 2017 local elections in the United Kingdom. All 40 Councillors were elected from 39 electoral divisions, which each returned either one or two Councillors by first-past-the-post voting for a four-year term of office. The result of the election saw the Isle of Wight Conservatives re-take majority control of the Isle of Wight Council after electing 25 Councillors.

zh.s: 怀特岛议会选举于2017年5月4日举行，是2017年英国地方选举的一部分。全部40名议员均通过简单多数制选出，来自39个选区，每区选出一至两人，任期四年。保守党赢得25席，重新取得怀特岛议会多数控制权。

en.s: The 2017 Oxfordshire County Council election took place on 4 May 2017 as part of the 2017 local elections in the United Kingdom. All 63 councillors were elected from 61 electoral divisions which returned either one or two county councillors each by first-past-the-post voting for a four-year term of office.

zh.s: 2017年牛津郡议会选举于5月4日举行，是2017年英国地方选举的一部分。全部63名议员通过简单多数制选出，来自61个选区；各选区选出一至两名郡议员，任期四年。

en.s: As part of the 2017 local elections in Wales on 4 May 2017, the 40 seats of Torfaen County Borough Council were up for election. There were 113 candidates. The Labour Party retained overall control of the council.

zh.t: 2017年托法恩郡自治市议会选举
zh.s: 作为2017年5月4日威尔士地方选举的一部分，托法恩郡自治市议会40个席位全部改选。共有113名候选人参选，工党继续控制议会。

en.s: The 2017 Wiltshire Council election took place on 4 May 2017 as part of the 2017 local elections in the United Kingdom. All 98 councillors were elected from electoral divisions which returned one councillor each by first-past-the-post voting for a four-year term of office.

zh.s: 2017年威尔特郡议会选举于5月4日举行，是2017年英国地方选举的一部分。全部98名议员均以简单多数制选出，每个选区选出一名议员，任期四年。

en.s: An election for the Northumberland County Council took place on 4 May 2017 as part of the 2017 local elections in the United Kingdom. All 67 councillors were elected from 66 electoral divisions which returned either one or two county councillors each by first-past-the-post voting for a four-year term of office. The results saw the Conservative Party win 33 seats, one short of a majority.

zh.s: 诺森伯兰郡议会选举于2017年5月4日举行，是2017年英国地方选举的一部分。全部67名议员均以简单多数制选出，来自66个选区，各选区选出一至两名郡议员，任期四年。保守党赢得33席，距离多数席位还差1席。

en.s: Elections to Aberdeenshire Council were held on 4 May 2017, on the same day as the other Scottish local government elections. The election used the 19 wards created as a result of the Local Governance (Scotland) Act 2004, with each ward electing three or four councillors using the single transferable vote system form of proportional representation, with 70 councillors being elected, an increase of two members compared to 2012.

zh.s: 阿伯丁郡议会选举于2017年5月4日举行，与苏格兰其他地方政府选举同日。选举采用《2004年苏格兰地方治理法》设立的19个选区，各选区选出3至4名议员，采用比例代表制的单记可让渡投票制。共选出70名议员，比2012年增加2人。

en.s: Elections to Dundee City Council were held on 4 May 2017 on the same day as the other Scottish local government elections. The election used the eight wards created as a result of the Local Governance (Scotland) Act 2004, with each ward electing three or four Councillors using the single transferable vote system (a form of proportional representation). A total of 29 Councillors were elected.

zh.s: 邓迪市议会选举于2017年5月4日举行，与苏格兰其他地方政府选举同日。选举采用《2004年苏格兰地方治理法》设立的8个选区，各选区选出3至4名议员，采用比例代表制的单记可让渡投票制。共选出29名议员。

en.s: The Glasgow City Council election of 2017 was held on 4 May 2017, the same day as the 31 other Scottish local government elections. The election was the first to use 23 new wards, created as a result of the Local Government Boundary Commission for Scotland's 5th Review. Each ward elected three or four councillors using the single transferable vote system, a form of proportional representation used since the 2007 election and according to the Local Governance (Scotland) Act 2004.

zh.s: 格拉斯哥市议会选举于2017年5月4日举行，与苏格兰其他31个地方政府选举同日。这是首次使用新的23个选区进行选举。苏格兰地方政府边界委员会第五次审查后设立了这些选区。各选区选出3至4名议员，采用自2007年选举以来使用、并依据《2004年苏格兰地方治理法》的单记可让渡投票制。

en.s: The 2017 Caerphilly County Borough Council election was held on 4 May 2017 as part of the national 2017 Welsh local elections. The election was preceded by the 2012 CCBC election and was followed by the 2022 CCBC election.

zh.t: 2017年卡菲利郡自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2017年卡菲利郡自治市议会选举于5月4日举行，是威尔士2017年地方选举的一部分。上届选举于2012年举行，下一届于2022年举行。

en.s: The inaugural Tees Valley mayoral election was held on 4 May 2017 to elect the mayor of the Tees Valley Combined Authority in North West England. The mayor was elected by the supplementary vote system. Subsequent elections were held in May 2021 and every four years after 2024. North East England was considered a Labour stronghold and prior to the election, the Labour candidate Sue Jeffrey was considered the overwhelming favourite.

zh.s: 2017年5月4日举行了首届蒂斯河谷市长选举，选出蒂斯河谷联合管理局的市长。投票采用补充投票制。此后，选举于2021年5月举行，并从2024年起每四年举行一次。英格兰东北部被视为工党票仓，选前工党候选人苏·杰弗里被认为胜算极大。

en.s: The sixth election to Carmarthenshire County Council was held on 4 May 2017 as part of wider local elections across Wales. The election was preceded by the 2012 election. It was followed by the 2022 election Plaid Cymru narrowly missed out in forming the first majority administration in Carmarthenshire Council's history, despite gaining eight seats in the election.

zh.s: 卡马森郡议会第六届选举于2017年5月4日举行，是威尔士各地地方选举的一部分。上届选举于2012年举行，下一届于2022年举行。威尔士党尽管在本次选举中增加8席，仍以微弱差距未能在卡马森郡议会历史上首次取得多数。

en.s: The 2017 Staffordshire County Council election took place on 4 May 2017 as part of 2017 local elections in the UK. All 62 councillors were elected from electoral divisions (two of which serve dual-councillor electoral divisions) for a four-year term of office. The system used is first-past-the-post voting. The result was Conservative councillors formed an increased majority on the council.

zh.s: 2017年斯塔福德郡议会选举于5月4日举行，是2017年英国地方选举的一部分。全部62名议员均通过简单多数制选出，任期四年；其中两个选区各选出两名议员。选后保守党议员在议会中的多数优势扩大。

en.s: An election to Derbyshire County Council took place on 4 May 2017 as part of the 2017 United Kingdom local elections. 64 councillors were elected from 61 electoral divisions which returned either one or two county councillors each by first-past-the-post voting for a four-year term of office. No elections were held in the City of Derby, which is a unitary authority outside the area covered by the County Council.

zh.s: 德比郡议会选举于2017年5月4日举行，是2017年英国地方选举的一部分。61个选区共选出64名议员，各选区选出一至两名郡议员，采用简单多数制，任期四年。德比市没有举行选举，因为该市属于德比郡议会辖区以外的单一管理区。

en.s: The 2017 Highland Council election was held on 4 May 2017 to elect members of the Highland Council. The election used the 21 wards created under the Local Governance (Scotland) Act 2004; each ward elected three or four councillors using the single transferable vote system (a form of proportional representation). A total of 74 councillors were elected, six less than in 2012.

zh.s: 高地议会选举于2017年5月4日举行。选举采用《2004年苏格兰地方治理法》设立的21个选区，各选区选出3至4名议员，采用比例代表制的单记可让渡投票制。共选出74名议员，比2012年少6人。

en.s: The 2017 election to Ceredigion County Council was held on 4 May 2017 when local elections took place across Wales. It was preceded by the 2012 election and followed by the 2022 election.

zh.s: 锡尔迪金郡议会选举于2017年5月4日举行，当天威尔士各地举行地方选举。上届选举于2012年举行，下一届于2022年举行。

en.s: The 2017 Kent County Council election was held on 4 May 2017 as part of the 2017 local elections in the United Kingdom. All 81 councillors were elected from 72 electoral divisions, each of which returned either one or two county councillors by first-past-the-post voting for a four-year term of office. The Conservative Party retained control. UKIP, previously the second-largest party on the council, lost all their seats.

zh.s: 肯特郡议会选举于2017年5月4日举行，是2017年英国地方选举的一部分。全部81名议员均通过简单多数制选出，来自72个选区，各选区选出一至两名郡议员，任期四年。保守党继续控制议会。原本是议会第二大党的英国独立党失去全部席位。

en.s: The 2017 Orkney Islands Council election took place on 4 May 2017 to elect members of Orkney Islands Council. The election used the six wards created as a result of the Local Governance (Scotland) Act 2004, with each ward electing three or four Councillors using the single transferable vote system form of proportional representation, with 21 councillors being elected.

zh.s: 奥克尼群岛议会选举于2017年5月4日举行，选出奥克尼群岛议会议员。选举采用《2004年苏格兰地方治理法》设立的6个选区，各选区选出3至4名议员，采用比例代表制的单记可让渡投票制，共选出21名议员。

en.s: The 2017 United Kingdom local elections were held on Thursday 4 May 2017. Local elections were held across Great Britain, with elections to 35 English local authorities and all councils in Scotland and Wales. Newly created combined authority mayors were directly elected in six areas of England: Cambridgeshire and Peterborough, Greater Manchester, the Liverpool City Region, Tees Valley, the West Midlands, and the West of England.

zh.s: 2017年英国地方选举于2017年5月4日星期四举行。大不列颠各地举行地方选举，包括英格兰35个地方当局，以及苏格兰和威尔士的全部地方议会。英格兰六个地区还直接选举了新设立的联合管理局市长：剑桥郡与彼得伯勒、大曼彻斯特、利物浦城市区域、蒂斯河谷、西米德兰兹和英格兰西部。

en.s: An election to Lancashire County Council took place on 4 May 2017 as part of the 2017 local elections across the UK. All 84 councillors were elected for single-member and dual-member divisions for a four-year term of office. The system of voting used is first-past-the-post. Elections are held in all electoral divisions across the present ceremonial county, excepting Blackpool and Blackburn with Darwen which are unitary authorities.

zh.s: 兰开夏郡议会选举于2017年5月4日举行，是英国2017年地方选举的一部分。全部84名议员均通过简单多数制选出，各选区选出一至两名议员，任期四年。选举覆盖现今礼仪郡内所有选区，但不包括布莱克浦和布莱克本与达文；这两地属于单一管理区。

en.s: The 2017 West Dunbartonshire Council election was held on 4 May 2017, on the same day as the 31 other local authorities in Scotland. The election used the six wards created under the Local Governance (Scotland) Act 2004, with 22 Councillors being elected. Each ward will elect either 3 or 4 members, using the STV electoral system. Following the 2012 election a Labour majority administration was formed.

zh.s: 西邓巴顿郡议会选举于2017年5月4日举行，与苏格兰其他31个地方当局同日。选举采用《2004年苏格兰地方治理法》设立的6个选区，共选出22名议员。各选区选出3至4名议员，采用单记可让渡投票制。2012年选举后，工党组成多数派政府。

en.s: Elections to Essex County Council took place on 4 May 2017 as part of the 2017 local elections. All 75 councillors were elected from 70 electoral divisions, which each returned either one or two councillors by first-past-the-post voting for a four-year term of office. The electoral divisions were the same as those used at the previous elections in 2009 and 2013.

zh.s: 埃塞克斯郡议会选举于2017年5月4日举行，是2017年地方选举的一部分。全部75名议员通过简单多数制选出，来自70个选区，每区选出一至两名议员，任期四年。选区划分与2009年和2013年上届选举相同。

en.s: The 2017 Buckinghamshire County Council election took place on 4 May 2017 as part of the 2017 local elections in the United Kingdom. All 49 councillors were elected from electoral divisions which returned one county councillor each by first-past-the-post voting for a four-year term of office, due to expire in 2021. The Conservative Party retained an overall control on the council, winning 41 of the 49 seats on the council.

zh.s: 白金汉郡议会选举于2017年5月4日举行，是2017年英国地方选举的一部分。全部49名议员均通过简单多数制选出，每个选区选出一名议员，任期四年，到2021年届满。保守党赢得49席中的41席，继续控制议会。

en.s: The 2017 Nottinghamshire County Council election took place on 4 May 2017 as part of the 2017 local elections in the United Kingdom. The whole council of 66 councillors was elected for a four-year term spanning 56 electoral divisions, a minority of which return two councillors. The voting system used is first-past-the-post. The result was no overall party group of candidates formed a majority.

zh.s: 诺丁汉郡议会选举于2017年5月4日举行，是2017年英国地方选举的一部分。议会66名议员全部改选，任期四年，来自56个选区；其中少数选区选出两名议员。选举采用简单多数制，选后没有任何政党或团体取得多数。

en.s: The 2017 Devon County Council election took place on 4 May 2017 as part of the 2017 local elections in the United Kingdom. All 60 councillors were elected from 58 electoral divisions, which returned either one or two county councillors each by first-past-the-post voting for a four-year term of office. Boundary changes to the electoral divisions took effect at this election after a review of the county by the Local Government Boundary Commission for England.

zh.s: 德文郡议会选举于2017年5月4日举行，是2017年英国地方选举的一部分。全部60名议员通过简单多数制选出，来自58个选区，各选区选出一至两名郡议员，任期四年。英格兰地方政府边界委员会审查该郡后调整了选区边界，本次选举起生效。

en.s: The Clackmannanshire Council election of 2017 was held on 4 May 2017, on the same day as the 31 other local authorities in Scotland. It was the third successive election to run under the STV electoral system and used the five wards created under the Local Governance (Scotland) Act 2004, with 18 councillors being elected.

zh.s: 克拉克曼南郡议会选举于2017年5月4日举行，与苏格兰其他31个地方当局同日。这是连续第三届采用单记可让渡投票制的议会选举。选举采用《2004年苏格兰地方治理法》设立的5个选区，共选出18名议员。

en.s: The 2017 Northamptonshire County Council election took place on 4 May 2017 as part of the 2017 local elections in the United Kingdom. County councillors were elected from all 57 electoral divisions which returned one county councillor to Northamptonshire County Council by first-past-the-post voting for a four-year term of office. These elections were the last held for Northamptonshire County Council before its dissolution in 2021.

zh.s: 北安普敦郡议会选举于2017年5月4日举行，是2017年英国地方选举的一部分。全部57个选区均选出一名郡议员，采用简单多数制，任期四年。这是北安普敦郡议会在2021年解散前举行的最后一次选举。

en.s: The 2017 North Yorkshire County Council election was held on 4 May 2017 as part of the 2017 local elections in the United Kingdom. All 72 councillors were elected from 68 electoral divisions which each returned either one or two county councillors by first-past-the-post voting for a four-year term of office.

zh.s: 北约克郡议会选举于2017年5月4日举行，是2017年英国地方选举的一部分。68个选区共选出72名议员，各选区选出一至两名郡议员，采用简单多数制，任期四年。

en.s: The 2017 Norfolk County Council election took place on 4 May 2017 as part of the 2017 local elections in the United Kingdom. The Conservative Party won control of the council from No Overall Control. All three major parties made gains at the expense of the UK Independence Party and the Green Party of England and Wales, both of which lost all their seats.

zh.s: 诺福克郡议会选举于2017年5月4日举行，是2017年英国地方选举的一部分。保守党从原先无多数党控制的议会手中取得控制权。三大党都从英国独立党和英格兰及威尔士绿党手中赢得席位；这两个党失去了全部议席。

en.t: 2017 Merthyr Tydfil County Borough Council election
en.s: The 2017 Merthyr Tydfil County Borough Council election took place on Thursday 4 May 2017 to elect the 33 members of Merthyr Tydfil County Borough Council in Wales. This was on the same day as other 2017 United Kingdom local elections. The Council shifted back from Labour to Independent control.

zh.t: 2017年梅瑟蒂德菲尔郡自治市议会选举
zh.s: 梅瑟蒂德菲尔郡自治市议会选举于2017年5月4日星期四举行，改选威尔士梅瑟蒂德菲尔郡自治市议会33名议员，与英国其他地方选举同日。议会控制权由工党转到独立议员手中。

en.s: The 2017 Doncaster Metropolitan Borough Council election took place on 4 May 2017 as part of the 2017 local elections in the United Kingdom. The election of the Mayor of Doncaster also took place on the same day. All 55 councillors were elected from 21 wards which returned either two or three councillors each by first-past-the-post voting for a four-year term of office.

zh.t: 2017年唐卡斯特都市自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2017年唐卡斯特都市自治市议会选举于5月4日举行，是2017年英国地方选举的一部分。同一天还举行了唐卡斯特市长选举。21个选区共选出55名议员，各选区选出两至三名议员，采用简单多数制，任期四年。

en.s: Elections to Fife Council were held on 4 May 2017, the same day as the other Scottish local government elections. The election used the 22 wards created as a result of the Local Government Commission for Scotland's 5th review which was published in September 2016, with each ward electing three or four councillors using the single transferable vote system form of proportional representation, with 75 councillors elected; a decrease of three seats from 2012 as one ward, The Lochs, was abolished.

zh.s: 法夫议会选举于2017年5月4日举行，与苏格兰其他地方政府选举同日。选举采用苏格兰地方政府边界委员会第五次审查后设立的22个选区；该审查报告于2016年9月公布。各选区选出3至4名议员，采用比例代表制的单记可让渡投票制，共选出75名议员，比2012年减少3席，因为洛赫斯选区被撤销。

en.s: The 2017 Cumbria County Council election took place on 4 May 2017 as part of the 2017 local elections in the United Kingdom. All 84 Cumbria county councillors were elected from electoral divisions which returned one county councillor each by first-past-the-post voting for a four-year term of office.

zh.s: 坎布里亚郡议会选举于2017年5月4日举行，是2017年英国地方选举的一部分。全部84名坎布里亚郡议员均通过简单多数制选出，每个选区选出一名议员，任期四年。

en.s: The 2017 Gloucestershire County Council election took place on 4 May 2017 as part of the 2017 local elections in the United Kingdom. All 53 councillors were elected from electoral divisions which returned one county councillor each by first-past-the-post voting for a four-year term of office. Control of the council went from a Conservative Party minority to a majority administration.

zh.s: 格洛斯特郡议会选举于2017年5月4日举行，是2017年英国地方选举的一部分。全部53名议员均通过简单多数制选出，每个选区选出一名议员，任期四年。议会由保守党少数派政府转为多数派政府。

en.s: The 2017 Dorset County Council election took place on 4 May 2017 as part of the 2017 local elections in the United Kingdom. All 46 councillors were elected from 40 electoral divisions, which returned either one or two county councillors each by first-past-the-post voting for a four-year term of office.

zh.s: 多塞特郡议会选举于2017年5月4日举行，是2017年英国地方选举的一部分。40个选区共选出46名议员，各选区选出一至两名郡议员，采用简单多数制，任期四年。

en.s: The 2017 East Renfrewshire Council elections took place on 4 May 2017 to elect members of East Renfrewshire Council. Five wards were used to elect eighteen councillors, a reduction of two from 2012. After the election, SNP and Labour formed a coalition with independent Danny Devlin.

zh.s: 东伦弗鲁郡议会选举于2017年5月4日举行，选出东伦弗鲁郡议会议员。选举设5个选区，共选出18名议员，比2012年减少2人。选后，苏格兰民族党和工党与独立议员丹尼·德夫林组成联合政府。

en.s: The 2017 Leicestershire County Council election took place on 4 May 2017 as part of the 2017 local elections in the United Kingdom. All councillors were elected from electoral divisions by first-past-the-post voting for a four-year term of office. The Local Government Boundary Commission for England has undertaken a review of the county and has recommended a change to the boundaries of the electoral divisions.

zh.s: 莱斯特郡议会选举于2017年5月4日举行，是2017年英国地方选举的一部分。所有议员均通过简单多数制选出，任期四年。英格兰地方政府边界委员会审查该郡后，建议调整各选区边界。

en.s: The sixth election to the Powys County Council since local government reorganization in Wales in 1995 was held on 4 May 2017, along with other local government elections. It was preceded by the 2012 election and was followed by the 2022 election.

zh.s: 威尔士地方政府于1995年重组后，波伊斯郡议会第六届选举于2017年5月4日与其他地方政府选举一同举行。上届选举于2012年举行，下一届于2022年举行。

en.s: 2017 Elections to Scottish Borders Council were held on 4 May 2017, the same day as the other Scottish local government elections. The election used the 11 wards created as a result of the Local Governance (Scotland) Act 2004, with each ward electing three or four Councillors using the single transferable vote system, a form of proportional representation, with 34 councillors elected.

zh.s: 苏格兰边境议会选举于2017年5月4日举行，与苏格兰其他地方政府选举同日。选举采用《2004年苏格兰地方治理法》设立的11个选区，各选区选出3至4名议员，采用比例代表制的单记可让渡投票制，共选出34名议员。

en.t: 2017 Isle of Anglesey County Council election
en.s: The 2017 Isle of Anglesey County Council election, to the Isle of Anglesey County Council was held on 4 May 2017 as part of the 2017 United Kingdom local elections. All 30 council seats were up for election. The previous full election took place in 2013 and the following one in 2022.

zh.s: 安格尔西岛郡议会选举于2017年5月4日举行，是2017年英国地方选举的一部分。议会全部30席改选。上一次全体选举于2013年举行，下一次于2022年举行。

en.s: The 2017 Suffolk County Council election took place on 4 May 2017 as part of the 2017 local elections in the United Kingdom. All 75 councillors were elected from 63 electoral divisions, which returned either one or two county councillors each, by first-past-the-post voting, for a four-year term of office.

zh.s: 萨福克郡议会选举于2017年5月4日举行，是2017年英国地方选举的一部分。63个选区共选出75名议员，各选区选出一至两名郡议员，采用简单多数制，任期四年。

en.s: The 2017 Cornwall Council election was held on 4 May 2017 as part of the 2017 local elections in the United Kingdom. 122 councillors were elected from the 121 electoral divisions of Cornwall Council, which returned either one or two councillors each by first-past-the-post voting for a four-year term of office.

zh.s: 康沃尔议会选举于2017年5月4日举行，是2017年英国地方选举的一部分。121个选区共选出122名康沃尔议会议员，各选区选出一至两名议员，采用简单多数制，任期四年。

en.s: Elections to Moray Council took place on 4 May 2017, on the same day as the 31 other Scottish local government elections. The election used the eight wards created under the Local Governance (Scotland) Act 2004, with 26 Councillors being elected. Each ward elected either 3 or 4 members, using the STV electoral system - a form of proportional representation.

zh.s: 马里议会选举于2017年5月4日举行，与苏格兰其他31个地方政府选举同日。选举采用《2004年苏格兰地方治理法》设立的8个选区，共选出26名议员。各选区选出3至4名议员，采用比例代表制的单记可让渡投票制。

en.s: The 2017 Midlothian Council election took place on 4 May 2017 to elect members of Midlothian Council. The election used the six wards created as a result of the Local Governance (Scotland) Act 2004, with each ward electing three Councillors using the single transferable vote system form of proportional representation, with 18 Councillors being elected. It was the first time that the Conservative party had won council seats in Midlothian since the 1995 election.

zh.s: 中洛锡安议会选举于2017年5月4日举行，选出中洛锡安议会议员。选举采用《2004年苏格兰地方治理法》设立的6个选区，各选区选出3名议员，采用比例代表制的单记可让渡投票制，共选出18名议员。这是自1995年选举以来保守党首次在中洛锡安赢得议席。

en.s: 2017 Elections to North Lanarkshire Council were held on 4 May 2017, on the same day as the 31 other local authorities in Scotland. The election utilised twenty-one wards with 77 Councillors being elected. This represented an increase of 7 seats and 1 additional ward when compared to 2012. Each ward elected either 3 or 4 members, using the STV electoral system.

zh.s: 北拉纳克郡议会选举于2017年5月4日举行，与苏格兰其他31个地方当局同日。选举使用21个选区，共选出77名议员，比2012年增加7席和1个选区。各选区选出3至4名议员，采用单记可让渡投票制。

en.s: 2017 Elections to East Lothian Council were held on 4 May 2017 on the same day as the other Scottish local government elections. The election consisted of 6 wards electing three or four councillors using the single transferable vote system form of proportional representation, with 22 councillors elected. This election featured revised ward boundaries to three wards resulting in the reduction of the number of East Lothian councillors from 23 to 22.

zh.s: 东洛锡安议会选举于2017年5月4日举行，与苏格兰其他地方政府选举同日。6个选区各选出3至4名议员，采用比例代表制的单记可让渡投票制，共选出22名议员。3个选区的边界经过调整，因此议员人数从23人减至22人。

en.s: The 2017 Somerset County Council election took place on 4 May 2017 as part of the 2017 local elections in the United Kingdom. All 55 councilors were elected from 54 electoral divisions, which each returned either one or two county councilors by first-past-the-post voting for a four-year term of office.

zh.s: 萨默塞特郡议会选举于2017年5月4日举行，是2017年英国地方选举的一部分。全部55名议员通过简单多数制选出，来自54个选区，各选区选出一至两名郡议员，任期四年。

en.s: The 2017 West Lothian Council election took place on 4 May 2017. The election used the 9 wards created as a result of the Local Governance (Scotland) Act 2004, with each ward electing three or four Councillors using the single transferable vote system form of proportional representation, with 33 Councillors being elected. The election resulted in no overall party majority, leading to the Labour Party and the Conservative Party forming a coalition administration.

zh.s: 西洛锡安议会选举于2017年5月4日举行。选举采用《2004年苏格兰地方治理法》设立的9个选区，各选区选出3至4名议员，采用比例代表制的单记可让渡投票制，共选出33名议员。选后没有任何政党占多数，工党和保守党组成联合政府。

en.t: 2017 Council of the Isles of Scilly election
en.s: The 2017 Council of the Isles of Scilly election took place on 4 May 2017 as part of the 2017 local elections in the United Kingdom. The council is a sui generis unitary authority within the ceremonial county of Cornwall. The whole council of 16 members was up for election, with twelve members elected in the St Mary's electoral division and another four from the 'Off Islands'; one each from Bryher, St Martin's, St Agnes and Tresco.

zh.s: 2017年锡利群岛议会选举于5月4日举行，是2017年英国地方选举的一部分。该议会是康沃尔礼仪郡内独立设置的单一管理区。议会16个席位全部改选：圣玛丽岛选区选出12人，“外岛”选区选出4人，分别来自布雷赫岛、圣马丁岛、圣艾格尼丝岛和特雷斯科岛，各选出一人。

en.s: The 2017 Durham County Council election was held on 4 May 2017 as part of the 2017 local elections in the United Kingdom. All 126 councillors were elected from 63 electoral divisions which returned either one, two or three county councillors each by first-past-the-post voting for a four-year term of office. The Statement of Persons Nominated was published on 5 April 2017.

zh.s: 达勒姆郡议会选举于2017年5月4日举行，是2017年英国地方选举的一部分。63个选区共选出126名议员，各选区选出一至三名郡议员，采用简单多数制，任期四年。提名候选人名单于2017年4月5日公布。

en.s: The 2017 Lincolnshire County Council election took place in non-metropolitan Lincolnshire on 4 May 2017 as part of the 2017 local elections in the United Kingdom. A total of 70 councillors were elected across the seven non-metropolitan districts that make up the administrative county of Lincolnshire from 70 single member electoral divisions by first-past-the-post voting for a four-year term of office.

zh.s: 非都市区林肯郡的郡议会选举于2017年5月4日举行，是2017年英国地方选举的一部分。林肯郡行政区内七个非都市区共选出70名议员，来自70个单议员选区，采用简单多数制，任期四年。

en.s: The 2017 Hampshire County Council election took place on 4 May 2017 as part of the 2017 local elections in the United Kingdom. All councillors were elected from electoral divisions by first-past-the-post voting for a four-year term of office. The electoral divisions were somewhat changed from the previous election, with some being split, merged or with boundary changes.

zh.s: 汉普郡议会选举于2017年5月4日举行，是2017年英国地方选举的一部分。所有议员均通过简单多数制选出，任期四年。与上届选举相比，选区划分有所调整，部分选区被拆分、合并或修改边界。

en.s: The 2017 Worcestershire County Council election took place on 4 May 2017 as part of the 2017 local elections in the United Kingdom. All 57 councillors were elected from 53 electoral divisions which returned either one or two county councillors each by first-past-the-post voting for a four-year term of office.

zh.s: 伍斯特郡议会选举于2017年5月4日举行，是2017年英国地方选举的一部分。53个选区共选出57名议员，各选区选出一至两名郡议员，采用简单多数制，任期四年。

en.s: 2017 Elections to Falkirk Council were held on 4 May 2017, the same day as the 31 other local authorities in Scotland. The election used the nine wards created under the Local Governance (Scotland) Act 2004, with 30 councillors being elected, a reduction of 2 members from 2012. Each ward elected either 3 or 4 members, using the STV electoral system.

zh.s: 福尔柯克议会选举于2017年5月4日举行，与苏格兰其他31个地方当局同日。选举采用《2004年苏格兰地方治理法》设立的9个选区，共选出30名议员，比2012年减少2人。各选区选出3至4名议员，采用单记可让渡投票制。

en.s: The 2017 Aberdeen City Council election took place on 4 May 2017 to elect members of Aberdeen City Council. The election used the 13 wards created as a result of the Local Governance (Scotland) Act 2004, with each ward electing three or four Councillors using the single transferable vote system form of proportional representation, with a total of 45 Councillors elected, an increase in two members from 2012.

zh.s: 阿伯丁市议会选举于2017年5月4日举行，选出阿伯丁市议会议员。选举采用《2004年苏格兰地方治理法》设立的13个选区，各选区选出3至4名议员，采用比例代表制的单记可让渡投票制，共选出45名议员，比2012年增加2人。

en.s: The 2017 Cardiff Council election was held on 4 May 2017 as part of the national 2017 Welsh local elections. The elections were preceded by the 2012 elections and were followed by the 2022 elections.

zh.s: 2017年卡迪夫议会选举于5月4日举行，是威尔士2017年地方选举的一部分。上届选举于2012年举行，下一届于2022年举行。

en.s: The 2017 Argyll and Bute Council elections took place on 4 May 2017 alongside local elections across Scotland. This was the third local election to take place using the Single Transferable Vote electoral system.

zh.s: 阿盖尔-比特议会选举于2017年5月4日举行，与苏格兰各地地方选举同期举行。这是第三届采用单记可让渡投票制的地方选举。

en.s: The elections to the City of Edinburgh Council were held on Thursday 4 May 2017, on the same day as the 31 other local authorities in Scotland. It was the third successive Local Council election to run under the single transferable vote (STV) electoral system. The election saw the SNP become the largest party on the council for the first time, whilst the Conservative party overcame Labour to become the second largest party.

zh.s: 爱丁堡市议会选举于2017年5月4日星期四举行，与苏格兰其他31个地方当局同日。这是连续第三届采用单记可让渡投票制的地方选举。苏格兰民族党首次成为议会第一大党，保守党则超过工党，成为第二大党。

en.s: The 2017 Perth and Kinross Council election was held on 4 May 2017, the same day as the other Scottish local government elections. The election covered the twelve wards created as a result of the Local Governance (Scotland) Act 2004, with each ward electing three or four councillors using the single transferable vote system form of proportional representation, with 40 Councillors being elected, a reduction of 1 member compared to 2012.

zh.s: 珀斯-金罗斯议会选举于2017年5月4日举行，与苏格兰其他地方政府选举同日。选举采用《2004年苏格兰地方治理法》设立的12个选区，各选区选出3至4名议员，采用比例代表制的单记可让渡投票制，共选出40名议员，比2012年减少1人。

en.s: Elections to Angus Council were held on 4 May 2017, the same day as the other Scottish local government elections. The election used the eight wards, created under the Local Governance (Scotland) Act 2004, with each ward electing three or four councillors using the single transferable vote system, form of proportional representation. A total of 28 councillors were elected, one less than in 2012.

zh.s: 安格斯议会选举于2017年5月4日举行，与苏格兰其他地方政府选举同日。选举采用《2004年苏格兰地方治理法》设立的8个选区，各选区选出3至4名议员，采用比例代表制的单记可让渡投票制。共选出28名议员，比2012年少1人。

en.s: Elections to North Ayrshire Council took place on 4 May 2017 on the same day as the 31 other Scottish local government elections. The election used the ten wards created as a result of the Fifth Statutory Review of Electoral Arrangements, with each ward electing three or four councillors using the single transferable vote system, a form of proportional representation, with 33 councillors being elected.

zh.s: 北艾尔郡议会选举于2017年5月4日举行，与苏格兰其他31个地方政府选举同日。选举采用第五次法定选区安排审查设立的10个选区，各选区选出3至4名议员，采用比例代表制的单记可让渡投票制，共选出33名议员。

en.s: Elections to Shetland Islands Council were held on 4 May 2017 on the same day as the other Scottish local government elections. The election was the third using seven wards created as a result of the Local Governance (Scotland) Act 2004, each ward electing three or four Councillors using the single transferable vote system form of proportional representation, with 22 Councillors elected.

zh.s: 设得兰群岛议会选举于2017年5月4日举行，与苏格兰其他地方政府选举同日。这是该议会第三次使用依据《2004年苏格兰地方治理法》设立的7个选区进行选举，各选区选出3至4名议员，采用比例代表制的单记可让渡投票制，共选出22名议员。

en.s: An election to Monmouthshire County Council took place on 4 May 2017 as part of the 2017 Welsh local elections. 43 councillors were to be elected from both single-member and dual-member electoral divisions by first-past-the-post for a five-year term of office. The elections were preceded by the 2012 elections and followed by the 2022 elections.

zh.s: 蒙茅斯郡议会选举于2017年5月4日举行，是威尔士2017年地方选举的一部分。单议员和双议员选区共选出43名议员，采用简单多数制，任期五年。上届选举于2012年举行，下一届于2022年举行。

en.s: The inaugural Greater Manchester mayoral election was held on 4 May 2017 to elect the Mayor of Greater Manchester. The next successive election was due to be held on 7 May 2020, but due to that year's outbreak of the novel Coronavirus, the election was postponed until May 2021. Subsequent elections are legislatively required to be held every four years thereafter.

zh.s: 大曼彻斯特首次市长选举于2017年5月4日举行，选出大曼彻斯特市长。下一届选举原定于2020年5月7日举行，但因当年新冠疫情而推迟至2021年5月。法律规定，此后每四年举行一次选举。

en.s: The inaugural West Midlands mayoral election was held on 4 May 2017 to elect the Mayor of the West Midlands, with subsequent elections to be held every four years from May 2020. The election took place alongside five elections for English metro mayors and other local elections, and ahead of the general election on 8 June 2017.

zh.s: 西米德兰兹首次市长选举于2017年5月4日举行，选出西米德兰兹市长。此后选举原定于2020年5月起每四年举行一次。本次选举与英格兰另外五场都市区市长选举及其他地方选举同日举行，早于2017年6月8日的大选。

en.s: The 2017 South Ayrshire Council election took place on 4 May 2017 on the same day as the 31 other Scottish local government elections. As with other Scottish council elections, it was held using single transferable vote (STV) – a form of proportional representation – in which multiple candidates are elected in each ward and voters rank candidates in order of preference.

zh.s: 南艾尔郡议会选举于2017年5月4日举行，与苏格兰其他31个地方政府选举同日。与苏格兰其他地方议会选举一样，本次采用单记可让渡投票制，这种比例代表制在每个选区选出多名议员，选民按偏好顺序排列候选人。

en.s: The 2017 Dumfries and Galloway Council election took place on 4 May 2017 to elect members of Dumfries and Galloway Council. The election used the twelve wards created as a result of the Local Governance (Scotland) Act 2004, with each ward electing three or four councillors using the single transferable vote system form of proportional representation, with 43 councillors being elected, a reduction of 4 members and 1 ward since 2012.

zh.t: 2017年邓弗里斯-盖洛韦议会选举
zh.s: 邓弗里斯-盖洛韦议会选举于2017年5月4日举行，选出邓弗里斯-盖洛韦议会议员。选举采用《2004年苏格兰地方治理法》设立的12个选区，各选区选出3至4名议员，采用比例代表制的单记可让渡投票制，共选出43名议员。相比2012年，议会减少4名议员和1个选区。

en.s: The 2017 Liverpool City Region mayoral election was held on 4 May 2017 to elect the Liverpool City Region Combined Authority and won by Steve Rotheram. Subsequent elections were planned for May 2020 but were postponed until May 2021 due to the covid pandemic with subsequent elections due every four years.

zh.t: 2017年利物浦城市区域市长选举
zh.s: 2017年5月4日举行利物浦城市区域联合管理局市长选举，史蒂夫·罗瑟勒姆当选。原定于2020年5月举行的下届选举因新冠疫情推迟至2021年，此后每四年举行一次。

en.s: Elections to East Ayrshire Council took place on 4 May 2017 on the same day as the 31 other Scottish local government elections. As with other Scottish council elections, it was held using single transferable vote (STV) – a form of proportional representation – in which multiple candidates are elected in each ward and voters rank candidates in order of preference.

zh.s: 东艾尔郡议会选举于2017年5月4日举行，与苏格兰其他31个地方政府选举同日。与苏格兰其他地方议会选举一样，本次采用单记可让渡投票制，这种比例代表制在每个选区选出多名议员，选民按偏好顺序排列候选人。

en.s: Elections to South Lanarkshire Council took place on 4 May 2017 on the same day as the 31 other Scottish local government elections. As with other Scottish council elections, it was held using single transferable vote (STV) – a form of proportional representation – in which multiple candidates are elected in each ward and voters rank candidates in order of preference.

zh.s: 南拉纳克郡议会选举于2017年5月4日举行，与苏格兰其他31个地方政府选举同日。与苏格兰其他地方议会选举一样，本次采用单记可让渡投票制，这种比例代表制在每个选区选出多名议员，选民按偏好顺序排列候选人。

en.s: Elections to Comhairle nan Eilean Siar (Scottish Gaelic for 'Council of the Western Isles') were held on 4 May 2017, the same day as the 31 other Scottish local government elections. As with other Scottish council elections, it was held using single transferable vote (STV) – a form of proportional representation – in which multiple candidates are elected in each ward and voters rank candidates in order of preference.

zh.s: 西部群岛议会选举于2017年5月4日举行，与苏格兰其他31个地方政府选举同日。议会的苏格兰盖尔语名称Comhairle nan Eilean Siar意为“西部群岛议会”。与苏格兰其他地方议会选举一样，本次采用单记可让渡投票制，这种比例代表制在每个选区选出多名议员，选民按偏好顺序排列候选人。

en.s: 2017 Elections to East Dunbartonshire Council were held on Thursday 4 May, the same day as the 31 other local authorities in Scotland. The election used seven wards created under the Local Governance (Scotland) Act 2004, a reduction of one from 2012, with 22 Councillors being elected, 2 fewer overall. Each ward elected either 3 or 4 members, using the STV electoral system.

zh.s: 东邓巴顿郡议会选举于2017年5月4日星期四举行，与苏格兰其他31个地方当局同日。选举采用《2004年苏格兰地方治理法》设立的7个选区，比2012年减少1个，共选出22名议员，比上届少2人。各选区选出3至4名议员，采用单记可让渡投票制。

en.s: The 2017 West Sussex County Council election took place as part of the 2017 local elections in the UK. All councillors were elected for single-member electoral divisions for a four-year term. The voting system used was first-past-the-post. Boundary changes to the electoral divisions took effect following a review by the Local Government Boundary Commission for England.

zh.s: 西萨塞克斯郡议会选举是英国2017年地方选举的一部分。所有议员均从单议员选区选出，任期四年，采用简单多数制。英格兰地方政府边界委员会审查后调整了选区边界，本次选举起生效。

en.s: The 2017 Surrey County Council election took place as part of the 2017 local elections in the UK to elect all 81 councillors to Surrey County Council for single-member electoral divisions for a four-year term. The electoral system used was first-past-the-post voting. The result was that Conservative councillors formed an increased majority on the council, having won back all three of the divisions gained from them by UKIP at the previous election in 2013.

zh.s: 萨里郡议会选举是英国2017年地方选举的一部分，改选全部81名议员。所有议员均从单议员选区选出，任期四年，采用简单多数制。保守党扩大了议会多数优势，并从英国独立党手中赢回2013年上届选举中输掉的3个选区。

en.s: The 2017 Scottish local elections were held on Thursday 4 May, in all 32 local authorities. The SNP retained its position as the largest party in terms of votes and councillors, despite suffering minor losses. The Conservatives made gains and displaced Labour as the second largest party, while the Liberal Democrats suffered a net loss of councillors despite increasing their share of the vote.

zh.s: 苏格兰地方选举于2017年5月4日星期四在全部32个地方当局举行。苏格兰民族党虽略有失利，但按得票数和议员人数计算，仍是第一大党。保守党赢得席位，超过工党成为第二大党。自由民主党的得票率有所提高，但议员人数净减少。

en.s: The 2017 Warwickshire County Council election took place as part of the 2017 local elections in the UK. All 57 councillors were elected for single-member electoral divisions for a four-year term. The voting system used was first-past-the-post. Boundary changes took effect at this election after a review by the Local Government Boundary Commission for England.

zh.s: 沃里克郡议会选举是英国2017年地方选举的一部分。全部57名议员均从单议员选区选出，任期四年，采用简单多数制。英格兰地方政府边界委员会审查后调整了选区边界，本次选举起生效。

en.s: The inaugural Cambridgeshire and Peterborough mayoral election was held on 4 May 2017 to elect the Mayor of Cambridgeshire and Peterborough.

zh.s: 剑桥郡与彼得伯勒首次市长选举于2017年5月4日举行，选出剑桥郡与彼得伯勒市长。

en.s: The inaugural West of England mayoral election was held on 4 May 2017 to elect the Mayor of the West of England metropolitan area.
