en.s: The Torneo Gran Alternativa 2018 was a professional wrestling tournament event produced by the Mexican wrestling promotion Consejo Mundial de Lucha Libre (CMLLl; Spanish "World Wrestling Council") that began on May 4, 2018 and ran over the course of three of CMLL's Friday night shows in Arena México through May 18. The Torneo Gran Alternativa (Great alternative tournament) concept sees a Novato or rookie team up with an experienced wrestler for a tag team tournament.

zh.s: 2018年“新星与传奇”摔角锦标赛是由墨西哥摔角联盟世界摔角理事会（CMLL）主办的职业摔角赛事，于5月4日开赛，并在墨西哥城竞技场举行的三场周五晚间赛事中进行，最后一场于5月18日举行。该锦标赛的赛制是由一名新秀与一名经验丰富的摔角选手组成双打队伍参赛。

en.s: On May 4, 2019, the city of Dallas, Texas, held an election to choose the next Mayor of Dallas. The election began as a nonpartisan blanket primary, no candidate took a majority of over 50% of the total vote so the two top vote-earners Eric Johnson and Scott Griggs advanced to a runoff election on June 8. Incumbent mayor Mike Rawlings was unable to run for reelection due to term limits.

zh.s: 2019年5月4日，得克萨斯州达拉斯市举行选举，选出下一任市长。本次选举采用不分党派的无差别初选；由于没有候选人获得超过总票数50%的多数票，得票最高的两名候选人埃里克·约翰逊和斯科特·格里格斯进入6月8日举行的决选。受任期限制，现任市长迈克·罗林斯不能竞选连任。

en.s: The 2019 Plano municipal election was an election to the Plano City Council in the city of Plano, Texas on May 4, 2019. Seats were contested for Places 1, 3, 5, and 7. Since no candidate received more than 50% of the vote in Places 5 and 7, a runoff was held on June 8, 2019, for these races.

zh.s: 2019年普莱诺市政选举于5月4日举行，选出得克萨斯州普莱诺市议会议员。第1、3、5和7号席位进行选举。第5号和第7号席位没有候选人获得超过50%的选票，因此这两个席位于2019年6月8日举行决选。

en.s: The 2019 Dallas municipal election was an election to determine the mayor and all 14 city council members in Dallas, Texas. The election day was May 4, 2019 If no candidate takes a majority of over 50% of the total vote, the two top vote-earners will advance to a runoff election on June 8. Incumbent mayor Mike Rawlings is unable to run for reelection due to term limits.

zh.s: 2019年达拉斯市政选举将选出达拉斯市长和全部14名市议员。投票日为2019年5月4日。如果没有候选人获得超过总票数50%的多数票，得票最高的两名候选人将进入6月8日的决选。现任市长迈克·罗林斯因任期限制不能竞选连任。

en.t: UFC Fight Night: Iaquinta vs. Cowboy
en.s: UFC Fight Night: Iaquinta vs. Cowboy (also known as UFC Fight Night 151 or UFC on ESPN+ 9) was a mixed martial arts event produced by the Ultimate Fighting Championship held on May 4, 2019 at the Canadian Tire Centre in Ottawa, Ontario, Canada.

zh.t: UFC格斗之夜：亚昆塔对阵“牛仔”
zh.s: 综合格斗赛事“UFC格斗之夜：亚昆塔对阵‘牛仔’”也称UFC格斗之夜151或UFC ESPN+ 9，由终极格斗冠军赛主办，于2019年5月4日在加拿大安大略省渥太华的加拿大轮胎中心举行。

en.s: The 2019 Women's FA Cup final (known as the SSE Women's FA Cup Final for sponsorship reasons) was the 49th final of the Women's FA Cup, England's primary cup competition for women's football teams. The showpiece event was the 26th to be played directly under the auspices of the Football Association (FA). The final was contested between Manchester City and West Ham United on 4 May 2019 at Wembley in London.

zh.s: 2019年女子足总杯决赛因赞助原因也称SSE女子足总杯决赛，是女子足总杯第49届决赛。女子足总杯是英格兰女子足球队的主要杯赛。本届是足总协会直接主办的第26届决赛。2019年5月4日，曼彻斯特城与西汉姆联在伦敦温布利球场争夺冠军。

en.s: The 2019 Fort Worth mayoral election took place on May 4, 2019, to elect the mayor of Fort Worth, Texas. The election was officially non-partisan. Betsy Price, who was serving her fourth term, ran for reelection. Deborah Peoples, the chair of the Tarrant County Democratic Party, ran as a challenger. Price handily won re-election with just under 56% of the vote.

zh.s: 2019年沃思堡市长选举于5月4日举行，选出得克萨斯州沃思堡市长。本次选举不分党派。时任市长贝琪·普莱斯已连任四届，并再次参选；塔兰特县民主党主席黛博拉·皮普尔斯作为挑战者参选。普莱斯以略低于56%的得票率轻松连任。

en.s: On May 4, 2019, the city of San Antonio, Texas held an election to choose the next mayor of San Antonio. The election was a nonpartisan blanket primary. As no candidate secured a majority of the vote (50% of all votes cast +1), a runoff was held on June 8, 2019, between the two top candidates, incumbent mayor Ron Nirenberg and San Antonio City Councilman Greg Brockhouse.

zh.s: 得克萨斯州圣安东尼奥市于2019年5月4日举行选举，选出下一任市长。本次选举采用不分党派的无差别初选。由于没有候选人获得过半选票（占全部选票50%再加1票），得票最高的两名候选人——现任市长罗恩·尼伦伯格和圣安东尼奥市议员格雷格·布罗克豪斯——于2019年6月8日参加决选。

en.s: Periodic elections for the Tasmanian Legislative Council were held on 4 May 2019. The three seats up for election were Montgomery, Nelson and Pembroke. Montgomery and Nelson were previously contested in 2013. Pembroke was won by the Labor Party in a 2017 by-election, following the resignation of the sitting member, Vanessa Goodwin of the Liberal Party.

zh.t: 2019年塔斯马尼亚立法委员会定期选举
zh.s: 塔斯马尼亚立法委员会定期选举于2019年5月4日举行，改选蒙哥马利、纳尔逊和彭布罗克三个席位。蒙哥马利和纳尔逊选区上一次选举于2013年举行。彭布罗克席位由工党在2017年补选中赢得；该补选是在自由党议员瓦妮莎·古德温辞职后举行的。

en.t: The inaugural all-female motorsport series, W Series, takes place at Hockenheimring. The race was won by Jamie Chadwick, who would go on to become the inaugural series champion
en.s: W Series was an all-female single-seater racing championship. It was held over a total of three seasons in 2019, 2021 and 2022 before the championship fell into administration and later liquidated, with a planned season in 2020 cancelled due to the COVID-19 pandemic. All three editions were won by Jamie Chadwick.

zh.t: 首届女子赛车系列赛W Series在霍根海姆赛道举行，杰米·查德威克赢得比赛，并成为该系列赛首位总冠军
zh.s: W Series是一项女子单座赛车锦标赛，共举办三届，分别在2019年、2021年和2022年举行。该赛事后来进入破产管理程序，随后清算；原定于2020年举办的一季因新冠疫情取消。三届比赛均由杰米·查德威克获胜。

en.s: On May 4, 2020, fighters from Kyini ya kilima ambushed Congolese soldiers (FARDC) in Marabho, near Bunia, Ituri Province.

zh.s: 2020年5月4日，基尼亚基利马武装人员在刚果民主共和国伊图里省布尼亚附近的马拉博伏击刚果士兵（FARDC）。

en.s: This article uses Spanish naming customs: the paternal surname is first, and the maternal surname is second. Operation Gideon (Spanish: Operación Gedeón) was an unsuccessful attempt by the Active Coalition of the Venezuelan International Reserve, Venezuelan dissidents, and a private security firm, Jordan Goudreau's Silvercorp USA, to infiltrate Venezuela by sea and remove Nicolás Maduro from power.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 本文采用西班牙语姓名习俗，父姓在前，母姓在后。基甸行动（西班牙语：Operación Gedeón）是一次失败的海上渗透行动，参与者包括委内瑞拉国际预备役积极联盟、委内瑞拉异议人士和私人安保公司Silvercorp USA（由乔丹·古德罗经营），目标是推翻尼古拉斯·马杜罗。
zh.n: 本条采用源信息框所列的事件结束日期。

en.s: A regional election was held in the Community of Madrid on 4 May 2021 to elect the 12th Assembly of the autonomous community. All 136 seats in the Assembly were up for election. This marked the first time that a regional premier in Madrid made use of the presidential prerogative to call an early election.

zh.s: 马德里自治区于2021年5月4日举行选举，选出该自治区第12届议会。议会136个席位全部改选。这是马德里自治区首长首次行使解散议会、提前举行选举的权力。

en.s: The 2021 East Sussex County Council election took place alongside the other local elections. All 50 seats to East Sussex County Council were up for election.

zh.s: 2021年东萨塞克斯郡议会选举与其他地方选举同期举行，议会全部50个席位改选。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: On the evening of 4 May 2023, a shooting spree occurred in the villages of Dubona and Malo Orašje, between Mladenovac and Smederevo, Serbia. Armed with an automatic assault rifle, the shooter opened fire from a car, resulting in the deaths of nine individuals, including an off-duty police officer, and leaving thirteen others injured. The perpetrator, 20-year-old Uroš Blažić, fled the scene but was apprehended the next day near Kragujevac.

zh.t: 姆拉德诺瓦茨和斯梅代雷沃枪击事件
zh.s: 2023年5月4日晚，塞尔维亚姆拉德诺瓦茨和斯梅代雷沃之间的杜博纳与马洛奥拉什耶村发生连环枪击。枪手持自动步枪从车内开火，造成9人死亡，其中包括一名休班警察，另有13人受伤。20岁的嫌疑人乌罗什·布拉日奇逃离现场，次日在克拉古耶瓦茨附近被捕。

en.s: The 2023 Tewkesbury Borough Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect members for the 20 wards of the Tewkesbury Borough Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections taking place in England.

zh.t: 2023年蒂克斯伯里自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2023年蒂克斯伯里自治市议会选举于5月4日举行，选出英格兰蒂克斯伯里自治市议会20个选区的议员，与英格兰其他地方选举同日举行。

en.s: The 2023 Stockton-on-Tees Borough Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect all 56 members of Stockton-on-Tees Borough Council, a unitary authority which straddles the ceremonial counties of County Durham and North Yorkshire in England. This was on the same day as other local elections across England. The council remained under no overall control after the election, being led by a Labour minority administration.

zh.t: 2023年滨海斯托克顿自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2023年滨海斯托克顿自治市议会选举于5月4日举行，选出英格兰跨达勒姆郡和北约克郡两个礼仪郡的滨海斯托克顿单一管理区议会全部56名议员，与英格兰其他地方选举同日。选后议会仍无多数党控制，由工党少数派政府执政。

en.s: The 2023 East Hertfordshire District Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect members of East Hertfordshire District Council in Hertfordshire, England. This was on the same day as other local elections. The council had been under Conservative majority control since 1999. The incumbent leader of the council, Conservative councillor Linda Haysey, chose not to stand for re-election, having been leader since 2015.

zh.t: 2023年东赫特福德郡区议会选举
zh.s: 2023年东赫特福德郡区议会选举于5月4日举行，选出英格兰赫特福德郡东赫特福德郡区议会议员，与其他地方选举同日举行。保守党自1999年以来一直在议会占多数。议会现任领袖、保守党议员琳达·海西自2015年起任职，她决定不再竞选连任。

en.s: The 2023 Canterbury City Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect members of Canterbury City Council in Kent, England. This was on the same day as other local elections in England. The Conservatives held a majority on the council from 2005 until April 2023, less than a month before the election, when four Conservatives left the party to form the "Independent Serve to Lead Group".

zh.s: 2023年坎特伯雷市议会选举于5月4日举行，选出英格兰肯特郡坎特伯雷市议会议员，与英格兰其他地方选举同日。保守党曾自2005年起在议会占多数，但在选举前不到一个月的2023年4月，4名保守党议员退党并成立“独立服务与领导小组”，保守党因此失去多数。

en.s: The 2023 Preston City Council election took place on 4 May 2023, to elect 17 members of Preston City Council in Lancashire, England, being the usual third of the council plus a by-election in Preston Rural East ward. Labour retained its majority on the council.

zh.s: 2023年普雷斯顿市议会选举于5月4日举行，选出英格兰兰开夏郡普雷斯顿市议会17名议员，包括按惯例改选的三分之一席位，以及普雷斯顿乡村东区的一场补选。工党继续在议会占多数。

en.s: The 2023 Dacorum Borough Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect members of Dacorum Borough Council in Hertfordshire, England. This was the same day as other local elections. The election resulted in the Liberal Democrats gaining control of the council from the Conservatives At the subsequent annual council meeting on 17 May 2023 the Liberal Democrat leader Ron Tindall was appointed leader of the council, replacing Conservative leader Andrew Williams who had held the post since 1999.

zh.t: 2023年戴科勒姆自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2023年戴科勒姆自治市议会选举于5月4日举行，选出英格兰赫特福德郡戴科勒姆自治市议会议员，与其他地方选举同日举行。自由民主党从保守党手中取得议会控制权。在随后于2023年5月17日举行的年度议会会议上，自由民主党领袖罗恩·廷德尔获任议会领袖，接替自1999年以来一直任职的保守党领袖安德鲁·威廉斯。

en.s: The 2023 Chelmsford City Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect members of Chelmsford City Council in Essex, England. This was on the same day as other local elections across England. The Liberal Democrats retained their majority on the council.

zh.s: 2023年切姆斯福德市议会选举于5月4日举行，选出英格兰埃塞克斯郡切姆斯福德市议会议员，与英格兰其他地方选举同日。自由民主党继续在议会占多数。

en.s: The 2023 Cheshire East Council election took place on Thursday 4 May 2023 to elect all 82 members of Cheshire East Council in Cheshire, England. This was on the same day as other local elections across England. The council had been under no overall control prior to the election, being run by a Labour minority administration with support from independent councillors.

zh.s: 东柴郡议会选举于2023年5月4日星期四举行，选出英格兰柴郡东柴郡议会全部82名议员，与英格兰其他地方选举同日。选举前，议会没有任何政党占多数，由工党少数派政府执政，并得到独立议员支持。

en.s: The 2023 Stoke-on-Trent City Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect members of Stoke-on-Trent City Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections. New ward boundaries took effect for this election, although the number of councillors stayed the same at 44. Prior to the election the council was under no overall control, being led by a Conservative minority administration.

zh.t: 2023年特伦特河畔斯托克市议会选举
zh.s: 2023年特伦特河畔斯托克市议会选举于5月4日举行，选出英格兰特伦特河畔斯托克市议会议员，与其他地方选举同日。选区边界有所调整，但议员人数仍为44人。选举前，议会没有任何政党占多数，由保守党少数派政府执政。

en.s: The 2023 Mid Suffolk District Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect members of Mid Suffolk District Council in Suffolk, England. This was on the same day as other local elections across England.

zh.s: 2023年中萨福克区议会选举于5月4日举行，选出英格兰萨福克郡中萨福克区议会议员，与英格兰其他地方选举同日。

en.s: The 2023 Bromsgrove District Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect members of the Bromsgrove District Council in England. It was held on the same day as other local elections across England.

zh.t: 2023年布罗姆斯格罗夫区议会选举
zh.s: 2023年布罗姆斯格罗夫区议会选举于5月4日举行，选出英格兰布罗姆斯格罗夫区议会议员，与英格兰其他地方选举同日。

en.s: The 2023 Harborough District Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect members of the Harborough District Council in Leicestershire, England. It was held on the same day as other local elections across England. The Conservative Party lost control of the council after losing seven seats in the election. After the elections the Conservative leader Phil King resigned.

zh.s: 2023年哈伯勒区议会选举于5月4日举行，选出英格兰莱斯特郡哈伯勒区议会议员，与英格兰其他地方选举同日。保守党失去7席和议会控制权。选举后，保守党领袖菲尔·金辞职。

en.s: The 2023 Gravesham Borough Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect members of Gravesham Borough Council in Kent, England. This was on the same day as other local elections in England. New ward boundaries came into force for this election, reducing the number of councillors from 44 to 39. Cllr Gurdip Bungar was elected as Mayor of Gravesham for the year 2023-2024.

zh.t: 2023年格雷夫舍姆自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2023年格雷夫舍姆自治市议会选举于5月4日举行，选出英格兰肯特郡格雷夫舍姆自治市议会议员，与英格兰其他地方选举同日。选举采用新选区边界，议员人数从44人减至39人。古尔迪普·邦加尔议员当选格雷夫舍姆市长，任期为2023至2024年。

en.s: The 2023 West Devon Borough Council election took place on 4 May 2023, to elect members of West Devon Borough Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections across England. The election for Burrator ward was delayed until 15 June 2023 following the death of one of the original candidates. Prior to the election the council was under Conservative majority control.

zh.s: 2023年西德文自治市议会选举于5月4日举行，选出英格兰西德文自治市议会议员，与英格兰其他地方选举同日。原定于巴拉托尔选区举行的选举因一名原候选人去世，推迟至2023年6月15日。选举前，保守党在议会占多数。

en.s: The 2023 Maldon District Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect members of Maldon District Council in Essex, England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.s: 2023年马尔登区议会选举于5月4日举行，选出英格兰埃塞克斯郡马尔登区议会议员，与英格兰其他地方选举同日。

en.s: The 2023 Tamworth Borough Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect 10 of the 30 councillors on Tamworth Borough Council in Staffordshire, England. This was on the same day as other local elections across England. The council was under Conservative majority control prior to the election. They remained the largest party after the election but made a net loss of five seats, whilst Labour won most votes and took eight of the ten available seats.

zh.t: 2023年塔姆沃思自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2023年塔姆沃思自治市议会选举于5月4日举行，改选英格兰斯塔福德郡塔姆沃思自治市议会30席中的10席，与英格兰其他地方选举同日。选举前，保守党在议会占多数。选后保守党仍是第一大党，但净失去5席；工党得票最多，赢得10个改选席位中的8席。

en.s: The 2023 South Hams District Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect all 31 members of South Hams District Council in Devon, England. This was on the same day as other local elections across England. All 20 wards were up for election, each with either one, two or three councillors to be elected.

zh.s: 2023年南哈姆斯区议会选举于5月4日举行，选出英格兰德文郡南哈姆斯区议会全部31名议员，与英格兰其他地方选举同日。20个选区全部改选，各区选出一至三名议员。

en.s: The 2023 Central Bedfordshire Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect members of Central Bedfordshire Council in Bedfordshire, England. This was on the same day as other local elections. New ward boundaries increased the number of seats on the council by four. Ahead of the election, the Conservative administration had frozen council tax at a time when most councils were raising it to cover the increased cost of delivering public services.

zh.s: 2023年中贝德福德郡议会选举于5月4日举行，选出英格兰贝德福德郡中贝德福德郡议会议员，与其他地方选举同日。选区边界调整使议会席位增加4席。选举前，保守党政府冻结了市政税；当时多数地方议会都在加税，以应对提供公共服务的成本上升。

en.s: The 2023 Darlington Borough Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect all 50 members of Darlington Borough Council in County Durham, England. This was at the same time as other local elections across England. The council was under no overall control prior to the election, being led by a Conservative minority administration.

zh.s: 2023年达灵顿自治市议会选举于5月4日举行，选出英格兰达勒姆郡达灵顿自治市议会全部50名议员，与英格兰各地其他地方选举同期进行。选举前，议会没有任何政党占多数，由保守党少数派政府执政。

en.t: 2023 North West Leicestershire District Council election
en.s: The 2023 North West Leicestershire District Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect all 38 members of North West Leicestershire District Council in Leicestershire, England. This was on the same day as other local elections across England.

zh.t: 2023年西北莱斯特郡区议会选举
zh.s: 2023年西北莱斯特郡区议会选举于5月4日举行，选出英格兰莱斯特郡西北莱斯特郡区议会全部38名议员，与英格兰其他地方选举同日。

en.s: The 2023 Stafford Borough Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect members of Stafford Borough Council in Staffordshire, England. This was on the same day as other local elections across England. The council remained under no overall control, but went from being run by a Conservative minority administration to being run by a coalition of Labour, local party the Stafford Borough Independents, and the Greens.

zh.t: 2023年斯塔福德自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2023年斯塔福德自治市议会选举于5月4日举行，选出英格兰斯塔福德郡斯塔福德自治市议会议员，与英格兰其他地方选举同日。选后议会仍无多数党控制，但执政安排从保守党少数派政府转为工党、地方政党斯塔福德自治市独立党和绿党组成的联合政府。

en.s: The Municipal Corporation election held in Lucknow City on 4 May 2023 for electing the members (corporators) and mayor of Lucknow Municipal Corporation which governs Lucknow, the capital and the largest city of the Indian state of Uttar Pradesh. The votes were counted and the result was declared on 13 May 2023 in which the BJP again won the simple majority and formed the gorvenment in the city with Shushma Kharakwal as mayor.

zh.s: 勒克瑙市政公司选举于2023年5月4日举行，选出勒克瑙市政公司的议员和市长。该公司负责管理印度北方邦首府、也是该邦最大城市勒克瑙。选票于5月13日统计并公布结果，印度人民党再次赢得简单多数，并由舒什玛·卡拉克瓦尔出任市长。

en.s: The 2023 Halton Borough Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect 18 members (one-third) of Halton Borough Council in Cheshire, England. This was on the same day as other local elections across England. Labour retained its majority on the council.

zh.s: 2023年哈尔顿自治市议会选举于5月4日举行，改选英格兰柴郡哈尔顿自治市议会18名议员，即三分之一席位，与英格兰其他地方选举同日。工党继续在议会占多数。

en.t: 2023 Redcar and Cleveland Borough Council election
en.s: The 2023 Redcar and Cleveland Borough Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect members of Redcar and Cleveland Borough Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections in England. All 59 seats were up for election. Redcar and Cleveland Borough Council's elections are held every four years.

zh.t: 2023年雷德卡-克利夫兰自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2023年雷德卡-克利夫兰自治市议会选举于5月4日举行，选出英格兰雷德卡-克利夫兰自治市议会议员，与英格兰其他地方选举同日。全部59席改选。该议会每四年举行一次选举。

en.s: The 2023 Dartford Borough Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect all 42 members of Dartford Borough Council in Kent, England. This election took place alongside other local elections across England. The council remained under Conservative majority control after the election.

zh.t: 2023年达特福德自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2023年达特福德自治市议会选举于5月4日举行，选出英格兰肯特郡达特福德自治市议会全部42名议员，与英格兰各地其他地方选举同期举行。保守党继续在议会占多数。

en.t: 2023 St Albans City and District Council election
en.s: The 2023 St Albans City and District Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect members of St Albans City and District Council in Hertfordshire, England. This was on the same day as other local elections across England. Eighteen members of the council were up for election. The Liberal Democrats obtained 15 seats, the Green Party obtained 2 seats (including winning one from the Liberal Democrats in Clarence ward), and the Conservatives obtained 1 seat (in Harpenden South).

zh.t: 2023年圣奥尔本斯市与区议会选举
zh.s: 2023年圣奥尔本斯市与区议会选举于5月4日举行，选出英格兰赫特福德郡圣奥尔本斯市与区议会议员，与英格兰其他地方选举同日。议会有18席改选。自由民主党赢得15席，绿党赢得2席（其中1席在克拉伦斯选区从自由民主党手中夺得），保守党赢得1席（哈彭登南选区）。

en.s: The 2023 Ipswich Borough Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect members of Ipswich Borough Council in Suffolk, England. This was on the same day as other local elections in England. Labour retained control of the council. The incumbent leader of the council, David Ellesmere, had announced ahead of the election that he would not continue as leader after the election.

zh.t: 2023年伊普斯威奇自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2023年伊普斯威奇自治市议会选举于5月4日举行，选出英格兰萨福克郡伊普斯威奇自治市议会议员，与英格兰其他地方选举同日。工党继续控制议会。选举前，现任议会领袖戴维·埃尔斯米尔已宣布选后不再担任领袖。

en.s: The 2023 Chorley Borough Council election was held on 4 May 2023 to elect councillors to Chorley Council in Lancashire, England. This was on the same day as other local elections across England. A third of the council was up for election. Ahead of the election the council was under Labour control. Labour won 13 of the 14 seats available, increasing their majority on the council.

zh.s: 2023年乔利自治市议会选举于5月4日举行，选出英格兰兰开夏郡乔利议会议员，与英格兰各地其他地方选举同日。议会三分之一席位改选。选举前，工党控制议会。本次改选的14席中，工党赢得13席，扩大了多数优势。

en.s: The 2023 Broadland District Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect members of Broadland District Council in Norfolk, England. This was on the same day as other local elections. The council was under Conservative majority control prior to the election. They remained the largest party after the election but lost their majority, leaving the council under no overall control.

zh.s: 2023年布罗德兰区议会选举于5月4日举行，选出英格兰诺福克郡布罗德兰区议会议员，与其他地方选举同日。选举前，保守党在议会占多数。选后保守党仍是第一大党，但失去多数席位，议会转为无多数党控制。

en.s: The 2023 Sefton Metropolitan Borough Council election was held on 4 May 2023 to elect members of Sefton Metropolitan Borough Council in England. Labour retained and increased its majority on the council.

zh.t: 2023年塞夫顿都市自治市议会选举
zh.s: 塞夫顿都市自治市议会选举于2023年5月4日举行，选出英格兰塞夫顿都市自治市议会议员。工党继续执政，并扩大了多数优势。

en.s: The 2023 Solihull Metropolitan Borough Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect members of the Solihull Metropolitan Borough Council in West Midlands, England. This was on the same day as other local elections. There were 17 of the council's 51 seats up for election, being the usual third of the council. The Conservatives retained their majority on the council.

zh.t: 2023年索利哈尔都市自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2023年索利哈尔都市自治市议会选举于5月4日举行，选出英格兰西米德兰兹郡索利哈尔都市自治市议会议员，与其他地方选举同日。议会51席中有17席改选，即按惯例改选三分之一席位。保守党继续在议会占多数。

en.s: The 2023 Lancaster City Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect members of Lancaster City Council in Lancashire, England. This was on the same day as other local elections in England. New ward boundaries took effect for this election, increasing the number of seats from 60 to 61.

zh.s: 2023年兰开斯特市议会选举于5月4日举行，选出英格兰兰开夏郡兰开斯特市议会议员，与英格兰其他地方选举同日。新的选区边界于本次选举起生效，议席从60席增至61席。

en.s: The 2023 Derbyshire Dales District Council election was held on 4 May 2023 to elect all 34 councillors for Derbyshire Dales District Council. This was on the same day as other local elections. For the first time since 1995, the Conservative Party failed to win a majority of seats.

zh.s: 德比郡谷区议会选举于2023年5月4日举行，改选全部34名议员，与其他地方选举同日。保守党自1995年以来首次未能赢得议会多数席位。

en.s: The 2023 South Staffordshire District Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect all 42 councillors on South Staffordshire District Council in Staffordshire, England. This was on the same day as other local elections across England. New ward boundaries came into effect for this election, reducing the number of seats from 49 to 42.

zh.t: 2023年南斯塔福德郡区议会选举
zh.s: 2023年南斯塔福德郡区议会选举于5月4日举行，选出英格兰斯塔福德郡南斯塔福德郡区议会全部42名议员，与英格兰各地其他地方选举同日。新选区边界于本次选举起生效，议席从49席减至42席。

en.t: 2023 Oadby and Wigston Borough Council election
en.s: The 2023 Oadby and Wigston Borough Council election was held on 4 May 2023 to elect all 28 members of Oadby and Wigston Borough Council in Leicestershire, England. This was on the same day as other local elections across England. All wards were up for election, each with 2 or 3 councillors to be elected. The Liberal Democrats were defending control of the council, having won 24 of 26 seats at the previous election.

zh.t: 2023年奥德比-威格斯顿自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2023年奥德比-威格斯顿自治市议会选举于5月4日举行，改选英格兰莱斯特郡奥德比-威格斯顿自治市议会全部28名议员，与英格兰其他地方选举同日。所有选区都改选，每区选出2至3名议员。自由民主党在上届选举赢得26席中的24席，本次力保议会控制权。

en.t: 2023 Bath and North East Somerset Council election
en.s: The 2023 Bath and North East Somerset Council election was held on 4 May 2023 to elect members of Bath and North East Somerset Council in England The Liberal Democrats maintained control of the council in 2023, increasing their majority winning forty-one seats. The Conservative leader lost his seat.

zh.t: 2023年巴斯和东北萨默塞特议会选举
zh.s: 巴斯和东北萨默塞特议会选举于2023年5月4日举行，选出英格兰巴斯和东北萨默塞特议会议员。自由民主党继续控制议会，并扩大多数优势，赢得41席。保守党领袖失去自己的议席。

en.s: The 2023 East Staffordshire Borough Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect all 37 members of East Staffordshire Borough Council in Staffordshire, England. This was on the same day as other local elections across England. New ward boundaries took effect at this election, reducing the number of councillors from 39 to 37. The council was under Conservative majority control prior to the election.

zh.t: 2023年东斯塔福德郡自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2023年东斯塔福德郡自治市议会选举于5月4日举行，选出英格兰斯塔福德郡东斯塔福德郡自治市议会全部37名议员，与英格兰其他地方选举同日。新选区边界于本次选举起生效，议员人数从39人减至37人。选举前，保守党在议会占多数。

en.s: The 2023 Exeter City Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect members of Exeter City Council in Devon, England. This was on the same day as other local elections in England. Labour retained its majority of the seats on the council.

zh.s: 2023年埃克塞特市议会选举于5月4日举行，选出英格兰德文郡埃克塞特市议会议员，与英格兰其他地方选举同日。工党继续在议会占多数。

en.s: The 2023 Uttlesford District Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect members of Uttlesford District Council in Essex, England. This was on the same day as other local elections across England. Prior to the election the residents' association 'Residents for Uttlesford' held a majority. The election saw Residents for Uttlesford retain their majority. The Conservative and Liberal Democrat group leaders both lost their seats.

zh.s: 2023年厄特福德区议会选举于5月4日举行，选出英格兰埃塞克斯郡厄特福德区议会议员，与英格兰其他地方选举同日。选举前，居民组织“厄特福德居民”在议会占多数。该组织继续保持多数席位。保守党和自由民主党团体领袖都失去了议席。

en.s: The 2023 New Forest District Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect members of New Forest District Council in Hampshire, England. This was on the same day as other local elections in England. Prior to the election the council was under Conservative majority control. New ward boundaries came into effect for this election, reducing the number of seats on the council from 60 to 48.

zh.s: 2023年新森林区议会选举于5月4日举行，选出英格兰汉普郡新森林区议会议员，与英格兰其他地方选举同日。选举前，保守党在议会占多数。新选区边界于本次选举起生效，议员人数从60人减至48人。

en.s: The 2023 Luton Borough Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect members of Luton Borough Council in Luton, Bedfordshire, England. This was on the same day as other local elections across England. Labour retained its majority on the council.

zh.s: 2023年卢顿自治市议会选举于5月4日举行，选出英格兰贝德福德郡卢顿自治市议会议员，与英格兰各地其他地方选举同日。工党继续在议会占多数。

en.s: The 2023 Hart District Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect members of Hart District Council in Hampshire, England. This was on the same day as other local elections across England.

zh.s: 2023年哈特区议会选举于5月4日举行，选出英格兰汉普郡哈特区议会议员，与英格兰各地其他地方选举同日。

en.s: The 2023 Tendring District Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect all 48 members of Tendring District Council in Essex, England. This would be on the same day as other local elections across England and parish council elections in the district. The council was under no overall control prior to the election, being led by Conservative councillor Neil Stock, who had been leader of the council since 2015.

zh.s: 2023年5月4日举行滕德林区议会选举，选出区议会全部48名成员。选举与英格兰其他地方选举及区内教区议会选举在同一天举行。选举前，议会没有任何政党或团体取得过半席位，由保守党议员尼尔·斯托克领导；他自2015年起担任议会领袖。

en.s: The 2023 South Oxfordshire District Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect members of South Oxfordshire District Council in Oxfordshire, England. This was on the same day as other local elections across England. Prior to the election the council was under no overall control, being run by a Liberal Democrat and Green coalition.

zh.s: 2023年南牛津郡区议会选举于5月4日举行，选出英格兰牛津郡南牛津郡区议会议员，与英格兰各地其他地方选举同日。选举前，议会没有任何政党占多数，由自由民主党和绿党组成联合政府。

en.s: The 2023 Eastleigh Borough Council election took place on 4 May 2023, to elect 13 members (one-third) of Eastleigh Borough Council in Hampshire, England.

zh.t: 2023年伊斯特利自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2023年伊斯特利自治市议会选举于5月4日举行，改选英格兰汉普郡伊斯特利自治市议会13名议员，即三分之一席位。

en.s: The 2023 Broxbourne Borough Council election took place on 4 May 2023, to elect 10 members (one-third) of Broxbourne Borough Council in Hertfordshire, England. All contested seats were held by the original party.

zh.t: 2023年布罗克斯本自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2023年布罗克斯本自治市议会选举于5月4日举行，改选英格兰赫特福德郡布罗克斯本自治市议会10名议员，即三分之一席位。所有改选席位均由原有政党保住。

en.s: The 2023 Mid Sussex District Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect members of Mid Sussex District Council in West Sussex, England. This was on the same day as other local elections in England. New ward boundaries were drawn up for this election, with the number of seats on the council reducing from 54 to 48.

zh.s: 2023年中萨塞克斯区议会选举于5月4日举行，选出英格兰西萨塞克斯郡中萨塞克斯区议会议员，与英格兰其他地方选举同日。新选区边界于本次选举起生效，议席从54席减至48席。

en.s: The 2023 Peterborough City Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect members of Peterborough City Council in Cambridgeshire, England. There were 21 of the 60 seats on the council contested. The election took place alongside other local elections across England. The council remained under no overall control, being led by a Conservative minority administration.

zh.s: 2023年彼得伯勒市议会选举于5月4日举行，选出英格兰剑桥郡彼得伯勒市议会议员。议会60席中有21席改选，与英格兰其他地方选举同期进行。选后议会仍无多数党控制，由保守党少数派政府执政。

en.t: 2023 Newark and Sherwood District Council election
en.s: The 2023 Newark and Sherwood District Council election took place on 4 May 2023, to elect all 39 members of Newark and Sherwood District Council in Nottinghamshire, England. Prior to the election the council had been under Conservative majority control, being led by David Lloyd. Following the results, the Conservatives lost the council to no overall control, and David Lloyd lost his seat.

zh.t: 2023年纽瓦克与舍伍德区议会选举
zh.s: 2023年纽瓦克与舍伍德区议会选举于5月4日举行，改选英格兰诺丁汉郡纽瓦克与舍伍德区议会全部39名议员。选举前，保守党在议会占多数，由戴维·劳埃德领导。选后保守党失去议会控制权，议会转为无多数党控制，劳埃德也失去了自己的议席。

en.s: The 2023 Staffordshire Moorlands District Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect all 56 members of Staffordshire Moorlands District Council in Staffordshire, England. This was on the same day as other local elections across England. The Conservatives lost their majority at this election, with the council going under no overall control and Labour overtaking the Conservatives to become the largest party.

zh.t: 2023年斯塔福德郡荒原区议会选举
zh.s: 2023年斯塔福德郡荒原区议会选举于5月4日举行，选出英格兰斯塔福德郡斯塔福德郡荒原区议会全部56名议员，与英格兰各地其他地方选举同日。保守党失去多数席位，议会转为无多数党控制，工党超过保守党成为第一大党。

en.s: The 2023 Arun District Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect members of Arun District Council in West Sussex, England. This was on the same day as other local elections in England. The council was under no overall control prior to the election, being led by a Conservative minority administration.

zh.s: 2023年阿伦区议会选举于5月4日举行，选出英格兰西萨塞克斯郡阿伦区议会议员，与英格兰其他地方选举同日。选举前，议会没有任何政党占多数，由保守党少数派政府执政。

en.s: The 2023 Portsmouth City Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect members of Portsmouth City Council in Hampshire, England. This was on the same day as other local elections across England. The council remained under no overall control, being led by a Liberal Democrat minority administration. Immediately after the election the Liberal Democrat leader of the council, Gerald Vernon-Jackson, announced he was stepping down from the role.

zh.s: 2023年朴茨茅斯市议会选举于5月4日举行，选出英格兰汉普郡朴茨茅斯市议会议员，与英格兰各地其他地方选举同日。选后议会仍无多数党控制，由自由民主党少数派政府执政。选举结束后不久，自由民主党议会领袖杰拉尔德·弗农-杰克逊宣布辞职。

en.s: The 2023 Tunbridge Wells Borough Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect members of Tunbridge Wells Borough Council in Kent, England. This was on the same day as other local elections across England. The council's detailed declarations recorded 26,575 ballot papers issued from an electorate of 71,657, an overall turnout of 37.1%.

zh.t: 2023年滕布里奇韦尔斯自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2023年滕布里奇韦尔斯自治市议会选举于5月4日举行，选出英格兰肯特郡滕布里奇韦尔斯自治市议会议员，与英格兰各地其他地方选举同日。选举记录显示，共发出26,575张选票，登记选民为71,657人，整体投票率为37.1%。

en.s: The 2023 Crawley Borough Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect members of Crawley Borough Council in West Sussex, England. This was on the same day as other local elections across England.

zh.s: 2023年克劳利自治市议会选举于5月4日举行，选出英格兰西萨塞克斯郡克劳利自治市议会议员，与英格兰各地其他地方选举同日。

en.s: The 2023 Derby City Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect all 51 members of Derby City Council in Derbyshire, England. This was on the same day as other local elections across England. New ward boundaries were drawn up for this election, although the number of councillors remained 51. This election also marked a change in the electoral pattern for the city council.

zh.s: 2023年德比市议会选举于5月4日举行，选出英格兰德比郡德比市议会全部51名议员，与英格兰各地其他地方选举同日。选举采用新选区边界，但议员人数仍为51人。本次选举也标志着市议会选举轮换安排发生变化。

en.s: The 2023 North Kesteven District Council election took place on 4 May 2023, to elect all 43 members of North Kesteven District Council in Lincolnshire, England. The Conservatives won a majority of the seats on the council, which had previously been under no overall control being led by an administration of Conservatives and independent councillors.

zh.s: 2023年北凯斯蒂文区议会选举于5月4日举行，改选英格兰林肯郡北凯斯蒂文区议会全部43名议员。保守党赢得议会多数席位；此前议会没有任何政党占多数，由保守党和独立议员组成的政府执政。

en.t: 2023 King's Lynn and West Norfolk Borough Council election
en.s: The 2023 King's Lynn and West Norfolk Borough Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect members of King's Lynn and West Norfolk Borough Council in Norfolk, England. This was on the same day as other local elections in England. Prior to the election the council was under Conservative majority control. Following the election the Conservatives remained the largest party but lost their majority, leaving the council under no overall control.

zh.t: 2023年金斯林与西诺福克自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2023年金斯林与西诺福克自治市议会选举于5月4日举行，选出英格兰诺福克郡金斯林与西诺福克自治市议会议员，与英格兰其他地方选举同日。选举前，保守党在议会占多数。选后保守党仍是第一大党，但失去多数席位，议会转为无多数党控制。

en.s: The 2023 Maidstone Borough Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect members of Maidstone Borough Council in Kent, England. This was on the same day as other local elections in England. Two weeks before the election, the council went into no overall control when the Conservatives lost their majority due to the resignation of Robert Eves, leaving them with 27 out of the 54 occupied seats.

zh.t: 2023年梅德斯通自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2023年梅德斯通自治市议会选举于5月4日举行，选出英格兰肯特郡梅德斯通自治市议会议员，与英格兰其他地方选举同日。选举前两周，保守党议员罗伯特·伊夫斯辞职，保守党席位降至已填补的54席中的27席，议会因此转为无多数党控制。

en.s: The 2023 South Norfolk District Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect members of South Norfolk District Council in Norfolk, England. This was on the same day as other local elections across England.

zh.s: 2023年南诺福克区议会选举于5月4日举行，选出英格兰诺福克郡南诺福克区议会议员，与英格兰各地其他地方选举同日。

en.s: The 2023 Swindon Borough Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect councillors to Swindon Borough Council in Wiltshire, England. This was on the same day as other local elections across England. There were 19 of the 57 seats on the council up for election. Prior to the election the Conservatives held a majority of the seats on the council.

zh.s: 2023年斯温顿自治市议会选举于5月4日举行，选出英格兰威尔特郡斯温顿自治市议会议员，与英格兰各地其他地方选举同日。议会57席中有19席改选。选举前，保守党在议会占多数。

en.s: The 2023 Mansfield District Council election took place on 4 May 2023, to elect all 36 members of Mansfield District Council in England and the directly-elected Mayor of Mansfield. This was on the same day as the 2023 local elections in England. The council was under no overall control prior to the election, with Labour being the largest party and Labour's Andy Abrahams serving as mayor.

zh.s: 2023年曼斯菲尔德区议会选举于5月4日举行，选出英格兰曼斯菲尔德区议会全部36名议员和直选市长，与英格兰地方选举同日。选举前，议会没有任何政党占多数，工党是第一大党，工党的安迪·亚伯拉罕斯担任市长。

en.s: The 2023 Ribble Valley Borough Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect all 40 members of Ribble Valley Borough Council in Lancashire, England. This was on the same day as other local elections across England.

zh.t: 2023年里布尔谷自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2023年里布尔谷自治市议会选举于5月4日举行，选出英格兰兰开夏郡里布尔谷自治市议会全部40名议员，与英格兰各地其他地方选举同日。

en.s: The 2023 Rossendale Borough Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect 12 members (one-third) of Rossendale Borough Council in Lancashire, England. This was on the same day as other local elections across England.

zh.t: 2023年罗森代尔自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2023年罗森代尔自治市议会选举于5月4日举行，改选英格兰兰开夏郡罗森代尔自治市议会12名议员，即三分之一席位，与英格兰各地其他地方选举同日。

en.s: The 2023 Reading Borough Council election was held on 4 May 2023 to elect members of Reading Borough Council in Berkshire, England. It coincided with local elections across England. There were 17 of the 48 seats on the council up for election, being the usual third of the council plus a by-election in Park ward following the resignation of Green councillor Brenda McGonigle.

zh.s: 2023年雷丁自治市议会选举于2023年5月4日举行，选出英格兰伯克郡雷丁自治市议会议员，与英格兰各地地方选举同期进行。雷丁自治市议会48席中有17席改选，包括按惯例改选的三分之一席位，以及帕克选区的一席补选。该补选因绿党议员布伦达·麦格尼戈尔辞职而举行。

en.t: 2023 Bournemouth, Christchurch and Poole Council election
en.s: The 2023 Bournemouth, Christchurch and Poole Council election took place on 4 May 2023, to elect all 76 members of Bournemouth, Christchurch and Poole Council in Dorset, England. The council stayed with no overall control but the Liberal Democrats became the largest single party. As no one party controlled a majority of the council the Liberal Democrats, Christchurch Independents, Poole People Party and The Bournemouth Independent Group subsequently formed a coalition administration known as the "Three Towns Alliance."

zh.t: 2023年伯恩茅斯、克赖斯特彻奇和普尔议会选举
zh.s: 2023年伯恩茅斯、克赖斯特彻奇和普尔议会选举于5月4日举行，选出英格兰多塞特郡该议会全部76名议员。选后议会仍无多数党控制，但自由民主党成为单一第一大党。自由民主党、克赖斯特彻奇独立党、普尔人民党和伯恩茅斯独立团体随后组成名为“三镇联盟”的联合政府。

en.s: The 2023 Worthing Borough Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect members of Worthing Borough Council in West Sussex, England. This was on the same day as other local elections in England. There were twelve seats up for election, being the usual nominal third of the council plus a by-election in Central ward.

zh.s: 2023年沃辛自治市议会选举于5月4日举行，选出英格兰西萨塞克斯郡沃辛自治市议会议员，与英格兰其他地方选举同日。12席改选，包括名义上按惯例改选的三分之一席位，以及中央选区的一席补选。

en.s: The 2023 Wakefield Metropolitan District Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect members of Wakefield Council in West Yorkshire, England. This was on the same day as other local elections across England. There were 21 of the 63 seats up for election, being the usual third of the council. Labour retained its majority on the council.

zh.t: 2023年韦克菲尔德都市区议会选举
zh.s: 2023年韦克菲尔德都市区议会选举于5月4日举行，选出英格兰西约克郡韦克菲尔德议会议员，与英格兰各地其他地方选举同日。议会63席中有21席改选，即按惯例改选三分之一席位。工党继续在议会占多数。

en.s: The 2023 Mid Devon District Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect members of Mid Devon District Council in Devon, England. It was held on the same day as other local elections in the United Kingdom. The Liberal Democrats took control of the council for the first time since 1999.

zh.s: 2023年中德文区议会选举于5月4日举行，选出英格兰德文郡中德文区议会议员，与英国其他地方选举同日。自由民主党自1999年以来首次取得议会控制权。

en.s: An election was held on 4 May 2023, to elect all 41 members of Gedling Borough Council in England. This took place as part of the 2023 United Kingdom local elections. The council was under Labour majority control prior to the election. This election saw the Conservatives and the Liberal Democrats making some gains, but Labour retained its majority with 28 of the 41 seats on the council.

zh.s: 格德灵自治市议会选举于2023年5月4日举行，改选英格兰格德灵自治市议会全部41名议员，是2023年英国地方选举的一部分。选举前，工党在议会占多数。本次选举中，保守党和自由民主党都赢得了一些席位，但工党赢得41席中的28席，继续占多数。

en.s: The 2023 North Somerset Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect all 50 councillors to the North Somerset Council in England. It was conducted on the same day as the other local elections across England. Prior to the election the council was under no overall control, being run by a 'rainbow coalition' of Liberal Democrats, Labour, Greens and independent councillors, led by independent councillor Steve Bridger.

zh.s: 2023年北萨默塞特议会选举于2023年5月4日举行，选出英格兰北萨默塞特议会全部50名议员，与英格兰各地其他地方选举同日。选举前，议会没有任何政党占多数，由自由民主党、工党、绿党和独立议员组成的“彩虹联合政府”执政，领袖为独立议员史蒂夫·布里杰。

en.s: The 2023 Liverpool City Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect members of Liverpool City Council.

zh.s: 2023年利物浦市议会选举于5月4日举行，选出利物浦市议会议员。

en.s: The 2023 Sheffield City Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect members of Sheffield City Council in England. There were 29 of the 84 seats on the council up for election, being the usual third of the seats plus a by-election in Manor Castle ward. The election took place at the same time as other local elections across England.

zh.s: 2023年谢菲尔德市议会选举于5月4日举行，选出英格兰谢菲尔德市议会议员。84席中有29席改选，包括按惯例改选的三分之一席位，以及庄园城堡选区的一席补选。选举与英格兰其他地方选举同日。

en.s: The 2023 Horsham District Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect members of Horsham District Council in West Sussex, England. It was held on the same day as other local elections in England. The Liberal Democrats gained control of the council from the Conservatives with an 8-seat majority. It was the first time since the 1995 election that the Liberal Democrats had taken control of the council.

zh.s: 2023年霍舍姆区议会选举于5月4日举行，选出英格兰西萨塞克斯郡霍舍姆区议会议员，与英格兰其他地方选举同日。自由民主党以8席多数从保守党手中取得控制权，这是自1995年以来该党首次控制议会。

en.s: The 2023 Blaby District Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect members of the Blaby District Council in England. They were held on the same day as other local elections.

zh.s: 2023年布莱比区议会选举于5月4日举行，选出英格兰布莱比区议会议员，与其他地方选举同日。

en.s: The 2023 Guildford Borough Council election was held on 4 May 2023, to elect all 48 seats to the Guildford Borough Council in Surrey, England as part of the 2023 local elections. The results saw the Liberal Democrats take overall control of Guildford Borough Council.

zh.t: 2023年吉尔福德自治市议会选举
zh.s: 吉尔福德自治市议会选举于2023年5月4日举行，改选英格兰萨里郡吉尔福德自治市议会全部48席，是2023年地方选举的一部分。自由民主党取得议会整体控制权。

en.s: The 2023 Winchester City Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect members of Winchester City Council in Hampshire, England. This was on the same day as other local elections in England. The council was under Liberal Democrat majority control prior to the election. They increased their majority on the council at the election.

zh.s: 2023年温彻斯特市议会选举于5月4日举行，选出英格兰汉普郡温彻斯特市议会议员，与英格兰其他地方选举同日。选举前，自由民主党在议会占多数，并在本次选举中扩大了多数优势。

en.s: Elections to Chichester District Council in West Sussex, United Kingdom were held on 4 May 2023. The election took place on the same day as other local elections. The whole council was up for election, having previously been under no overall control and led by a Conservative minority administration. The Conservative leader of the council prior to the election, Eileen Lintill, did not stand for re-election.

zh.s: 西萨塞克斯郡奇切斯特区议会选举于2023年5月4日举行，与英格兰其他地方选举同日。议会全部席位改选。此前议会没有任何政党占多数，由保守党少数派政府执政。保守党议会领袖艾琳·林蒂尔决定不再竞选连任。

en.t: 2023 North Tyneside Metropolitan Borough Council election
en.s: The 2023 North Tyneside Metropolitan Borough Council elections were held on 4 May 2023 alongside other local elections in the United Kingdom. One third of the seats on the council were contested at this election. Labour retained its majority on the council.

zh.t: 2023年北泰因赛德都市自治市议会选举
zh.s: 北泰因赛德都市自治市议会选举于2023年5月4日举行，与英国各地其他地方选举同期进行。议会三分之一席位改选。工党继续在议会占多数。

en.s: The 2023 Spelthorne Borough Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect members of Spelthorne Borough Council in Surrey, England. This was on the same day as other local elections across England. Prior to the election the council was under no overall control, being led by a Conservative minority administration.

zh.t: 2023年斯佩尔索恩自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2023年斯佩尔索恩自治市议会选举于5月4日举行，选出英格兰萨里郡斯佩尔索恩自治市议会议员，与英格兰其他地方选举同日。选举前，议会没有任何政党占多数，由保守党少数派政府执政。

en.s: The 2023 Watford Borough Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect members of Watford Borough Council in Hertfordshire, England. This was on the same day as other local elections across England. There were 12 of the 36 seats up for election, being the usual third of the council. The Liberal Democrats retained their majority on the council.

zh.t: 2023年沃特福德自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2023年沃特福德自治市议会选举于5月4日举行，选出英格兰赫特福德郡沃特福德自治市议会议员，与英格兰其他地方选举同日。36席中有12席改选，即按惯例改选三分之一席位。自由民主党继续在议会占多数。

en.s: Elections to City of York Council took place on 4 May 2023, as part of the United Kingdom local elections. They were held on the same day as other local elections in England. The incumbent leader of the council and leader of the Liberal Democrats, Keith Aspden did not stand for re-election, with it being announced ahead of the elections that Nigel Ayre would be the Liberal Democrats' new leader.

zh.s: 约克市议会选举于2023年5月4日举行，是英国地方选举的一部分，与英格兰其他地方选举同日。自由民主党现任议会领袖基思·阿斯普登没有竞选连任；选举前已宣布由奈杰尔·艾尔接任自由民主党领袖。

en.s: The 2023 Slough Borough Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect members of Slough Borough Council in Berkshire, England. This was on the same day as other local elections in England. Following a boundary review all 42 seats on the council were up for election and there was also a change to the electoral cycle for Slough.

zh.s: 2023年斯劳自治市议会选举于5月4日举行，选出英格兰伯克郡斯劳自治市议会议员，与英格兰其他地方选举同日。边界审查后，议会42席全部改选，斯劳的选举轮换周期也有所调整。

en.s: The 2023 South Holland District Council election took place on 4 May 2023, to elect all 37 members of South Holland District Council in Lincolnshire, England. This was on the same day as other local elections across England.

zh.s: 2023年南荷兰区议会选举于5月4日举行，选出英格兰林肯郡南荷兰区议会全部37名议员，与英格兰其他地方选举同日。

en.t: 2023 Basingstoke and Deane Borough Council election
en.s: The 2023 Basingstoke and Deane Borough Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect members of Basingstoke and Deane Borough Council in Hampshire, England. This was on the same day as other local elections in England. Prior to the election the council was under no overall control, being led by a minority Conservative administration.

zh.t: 2023年贝辛斯托克-迪恩自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2023年贝辛斯托克-迪恩自治市议会选举于5月4日举行，选出英格兰汉普郡该自治市议会议员，与英格兰其他地方选举同日。选举前，议会没有任何政党占多数，由保守党少数派政府执政。

en.t: 2023 Folkestone and Hythe District Council election
en.s: The 2023 Folkestone and Hythe District Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect members of Folkestone and Hythe District Council in Kent, England. This was on the same day as other local elections in England.

zh.t: 2023年福克斯通与海斯区议会选举
zh.s: 2023年福克斯通与海斯区议会选举于5月4日举行，选出英格兰肯特郡福克斯通与海斯区议会议员，与英格兰其他地方选举同日。

en.s: The 2023 North Devon District Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect members of North Devon District Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections in England. The Liberal Democrats retained control of the council.

zh.s: 2023年北德文区议会选举于5月4日举行，选出英格兰北德文区议会议员，与英格兰其他地方选举同日。自由民主党继续控制议会。

en.s: The 2023 Lewes District Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect members of Lewes District Council in East Sussex, England. This was on the same day as other local elections in England. Prior to the election the council was under no overall control, being run by a "co-operative alliance" comprising the Liberal Democrat, Green and Labour groups and one independent councillor, with the Liberal Democrat and Green leaders taking turns to be leader of the council in alternate years.

zh.s: 2023年刘易斯区议会选举于5月4日举行，选出英格兰东萨塞克斯郡刘易斯区议会议员，与英格兰其他地方选举同日。选举前，议会没有任何政党占多数，由自由民主党、绿党、工党和一名独立议员组成的“合作联盟”执政；自由民主党和绿党领袖每年轮流担任议会领袖。

en.s: The 2023 Three Rivers District Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect members of Three Rivers District Council in Hertfordshire, England. This was on the same day as other local elections across England. There were 14 seats up for election, being the usual third of the council plus a by-election in the Chorleywood South and Maple Cross ward.

zh.s: 2023年三河区议会选举于5月4日举行，选出英格兰赫特福德郡三河区议会议员，与英格兰各地其他地方选举同日。14席改选，包括按惯例改选的三分之一席位，以及乔利伍德南与梅普尔克罗斯选区的一席补选。

en.s: The 2023 Wyre Borough Council election took place on 4 May 2023, alongside other local elections across England. All 50 seats on the Wyre Borough Council were up for election. The election in Warren ward took place on 22 June 2023, due to the death of a candidate.

zh.s: 2023年怀尔自治市议会选举于5月4日举行，与英格兰其他地方选举同期进行。议会全部50席改选。沃伦选区选举因一名候选人去世而推迟至2023年6月22日。

en.s: The 2023 Amber Valley Borough Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect all 42 councillors for Amber Valley Borough Council. This was on the same day as other local elections in England. Following the boundary review by the Local Government Boundary Commission, this was the first election under the new boundaries.

zh.s: 2023年安伯谷自治市议会选举于5月4日举行，改选英格兰安伯谷自治市议会全部42名议员，与英格兰其他地方选举同日。英格兰地方政府边界委员会审查后调整了选区边界，本次选举首次采用新边界。

en.s: The 2023 Cotswold District Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect all 34 members of Cotswold District Council in Gloucestershire, England. It was held on the same day as other local elections in England. The Liberal Democrats won 22 seats, an increase of four, and retained control of the council. The Conservatives won nine seats, the Green Party won two and an independent won one.

zh.s: 2023年科茨沃尔德区议会选举于5月4日举行，选出英格兰格洛斯特郡科茨沃尔德区议会全部34名议员，与英格兰其他地方选举同日。自由民主党赢得22席，增加4席，并继续控制议会。保守党赢得9席，绿党2席，独立议员1席。

en.s: The 2023 West Oxfordshire District Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect members of West Oxfordshire District Council in Oxfordshire, England. This was on the same day as other local elections in England. There were 17 of the 49 seats on the council being contested, being the usual nominal third of the council.

zh.s: 2023年西牛津郡区议会选举于5月4日举行，选出英格兰牛津郡西牛津郡区议会议员，与英格兰其他地方选举同日。议会49席中有17席改选，名义上相当于三分之一席位。

en.t: 2023 South Tyneside Metropolitan Borough Council election
en.s: The 2023 South Tyneside Metropolitan Borough Council election took place on 4 May 2023, to elect members of the South Tyneside Metropolitan Borough Council in Tyne and Wear, England. This was on the same day as other local elections. Labour retained its majority on the council.

zh.t: 2023年南泰因赛德都市自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2023年南泰因赛德都市自治市议会选举于5月4日举行，选出英格兰泰恩-威尔郡南泰因赛德都市自治市议会议员，与其他地方选举同日。工党继续在议会占多数。

en.s: An election was held on 4 May 2023 to elect members of the Charnwood Borough Council in Leicestershire, England. This was on the same day as other local elections across England. Prior to the election the council had been under Conservative majority control since 2007. The leader of the council was the Conservative group leader, Jonathan Morgan, who had led the council since 2017.

zh.t: 2023年查恩伍德自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2023年5月4日，英格兰莱斯特郡举行查恩伍德自治市议会选举。选举与英格兰其他地方选举同日举行。此前，议会自2007年以来一直由保守党多数执政。议会领袖乔纳森·摩根是保守党团领袖，自2017年起担任议会领袖。

en.s: The 2023 Melton Borough Council election took place on 4 May 2023, to elect all 28 members of Melton Borough Council in Leicestershire, England.

zh.s: 2023年5月4日，英格兰莱斯特郡举行梅尔顿自治市议会选举，选出议会全部28名成员。

en.s: The 2023 Medway Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect members of Medway Council in Kent, England. This election was held on the same day as other local elections. The Labour Party won control of the council for the first time since its creation in 1998 under the Labour Co-op banner, winning 11 seats while the incumbent Conservative Party lost 13 seats.

zh.s: 2023年5月4日，英格兰肯特郡举行梅德韦议会选举，与其他地方选举同日进行。工党以工党—合作党名义参选，赢得11席，自1998年梅德韦议会成立以来首次取得控制权。原执政党保守党失去13席。

en.s: The 2023 Blackpool Council election was held on 4 May 2023 to elect members of Blackpool Council in Lancashire, England. All 42 councillors were up for election. This was at the same time as other local elections across England. Prior to the election the council was under no overall control, being led by a Labour minority administration. Labour won a majority of the seats on the council at this election.

zh.s: 2023年5月4日，英格兰兰开夏郡举行布莱克浦议会选举，选出议会全部42名议员，与英格兰其他地方选举同期举行。此前议会没有任何政党取得过半席位，由工党少数派政府执政。本次选举后，工党在议会取得多数席位。

en.s: The 2023 West Lancashire Borough Council election took place on 4 May 2023, to elect all 45 members of West Lancashire Borough Council in Lancashire, England. The council is usually elected in thirds, but the whole council was up for election in 2023 following changes to ward boundaries, which reduced the number of councillors from 54 to 45.

zh.t: 2023年西兰开夏自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2023年5月4日，英格兰兰开夏郡举行西兰开夏自治市议会选举，选出议会全部45名成员。该议会通常每次改选三分之一席位，但因选区边界调整，议员人数从54人减至45人，2023年改选全体议员。

en.s: The 2023 Chesterfield Borough Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect all 40 members of Chesterfield Borough Council in Derbyshire, England. This was on the same day as other local elections across England.

zh.t: 2023年切斯特菲尔德自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2023年5月4日，英格兰德比郡举行切斯特菲尔德自治市议会选举，选出议会全部40名成员。选举与英格兰其他地方选举同日举行。

en.s: The 2023 Havant Borough Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect members of Havant Borough Council in Hampshire, England. This was on the same day as other local elections across England.

zh.s: 2023年5月4日，英格兰汉普郡举行哈凡特自治市议会选举，与英格兰其他地方选举同日进行。

en.s: The 2023 Herefordshire Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect members of Herefordshire Council in Herefordshire, England. This was on the same day as other local elections in the UK. Prior to the election the council was under no overall control, being led by David Hitchiner of the Independents for Herefordshire group.

zh.s: 2023年5月4日，英格兰赫里福德郡举行赫里福德郡议会选举，与英国其他地方选举同日进行。此前议会没有任何政党取得过半席位，由赫里福德郡独立人士团体的戴维·希钦纳领导。

en.s: The 2023 Braintree District Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect members of Braintree District Council in Essex, England. This was on the same day as other local elections in England. The Conservatives retained control of the council, but with a reduced majority.

zh.s: 2023年5月4日，英格兰埃塞克斯郡举行布伦特里区议会选举，与英格兰其他地方选举同日进行。保守党保住了议会控制权，但多数席位减少。

en.s: The 2023 Sevenoaks District Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect members of Sevenoaks District Council in Kent, England. This was on the same day as other local elections across England.

zh.s: 2023年5月4日，英格兰肯特郡举行塞文欧克斯区议会选举，与英格兰其他地方选举同日进行。

en.s: The 2023 Bassetlaw District Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect all 48 members of Bassetlaw District Council in England. The election was held on the same day as other local elections in England as part of the 2023 United Kingdom local elections. The Labour Party retained control of the council with an increased majority, gaining one seat from the Liberal Democrats and one seat from an Independent.

zh.s: 2023年5月4日，英格兰举行巴塞特洛区议会选举，选出议会全部48名成员。选举是2023年英国地方选举的一部分，与英格兰其他地方选举同日举行。工党保住了议会控制权并扩大多数席位，分别从自由民主党和一名独立议员手中赢得一席。

en.s: The 2023 Mole Valley District Council election was held on 4 May 2023 to elect members of the Mole Valley District Council in Surrey, England. This election occurred on the same day as other local elections in England. This was the first election following the redrawing of ward boundaries, which reduced the number of councillors by two to 39. All positions were contested.

zh.s: 2023年5月4日，英格兰萨里郡举行莫尔谷区议会选举，与英格兰其他地方选举同日进行。这是选区边界重划后的首次选举，议员人数减少两人至39人，所有席位均参加改选。

en.s: The 2023 East Hampshire District Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect members of East Hampshire District Council in Hampshire, England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.s: 2023年5月4日，英格兰汉普郡举行东汉普郡区议会选举，与其他地方选举同日进行。

en.s: The 2023 Woking Borough Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect ten members (a third of the seats) of Woking Borough Council in Surrey, England. This was on the same day as other local elections in England. The election count took place on Friday 5 May 2023. The Liberal Democrats increased their majority on the council, winning four seats from the Conservatives, who did not win any of the seats contested in 2023.

zh.s: 2023年5月4日，英格兰萨里郡举行沃金自治市议会选举，改选议会30个席位中的10席，即三分之一席位。选举与英格兰其他地方选举同日举行，计票于5月5日（星期五）进行。自由民主党扩大了在议会的多数优势，从保守党手中赢得4席；保守党在本次改选的席位中一席未得。

en.s: The 2023 North Norfolk District Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect members of North Norfolk District Council in Norfolk, England. This was on the same day as other local elections across England.

zh.s: 2023年5月4日，英格兰诺福克郡举行北诺福克区议会选举，与英格兰其他地方选举同日进行。

en.s: The 2023 Wychavon District Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect members of Wychavon District Council in Worcestershire, England. This was on the same day as other local elections. New ward boundaries came into effect for this election, decreasing the number of seats from 45 to 43. The Conservatives lost seats, but retained their majority on the council.

zh.s: 2023年5月4日，英格兰伍斯特郡举行伍斯特郡区议会选举，与其他地方选举同日进行。新选区边界在本次选举中生效，席位数从45席减至43席。保守党失去部分席位，但仍保有议会多数。

en.s: The 2023 Thurrock Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect a third of the members of Thurrock Council in Essex, England. This was on the same day as other local elections across England. The Conservatives narrowly retained their majority on the council at the election, but lost three seats compared to the position immediately before the election.

zh.s: 2023年5月4日，英格兰埃塞克斯郡举行瑟罗克议会选举，改选议会三分之一席位，与英格兰其他地方选举同日进行。保守党以微弱优势保住议会多数，但相较选举前的席位情况减少了3席。

en.s: The 2023 Welwyn Hatfield Borough Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect members of Welwyn Hatfield Borough Council in Hertfordshire, England. This would be on the same day as other local elections across England. Prior to the election the Conservatives held a narrow majority of the seats on the council.

zh.t: 2023年韦尔温哈特菲尔德自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2023年5月4日举行韦尔温哈特菲尔德自治市议会选举，选出议会成员。选举与英格兰其他地方选举在同一天举行。选举前，保守党在议会仅以微弱优势占多数。

en.s: The 2023 North Hertfordshire District Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect members of North Hertfordshire District Council in Hertfordshire, England. This was on the same day as other local elections across England. The council remained under no overall control.

zh.t: 2023年北赫特福德郡区议会选举
zh.s: 2023年5月4日，英格兰赫特福德郡举行北赫特福德郡区议会选举，与英格兰其他地方选举同日进行。选举后，议会仍未有任何政党取得过半席位。

en.s: The 2023 Newcastle City Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect one third of the members of Newcastle City Council in Tyne & Wear, England. This was on the same day as other local elections in England and Wales. There were 27 of the 78 seats on the council up for election, being the usual third of the council plus a by-election in the North Jesmond ward.

zh.s: 2023年5月4日，英格兰泰恩-威尔郡举行纽卡斯尔市议会选举，改选议会三分之一席位。选举与英格兰和威尔士其他地方选举同日举行。本次共有78席中的27席参加选举，通常改选的三分之一席位之外，还包括北杰斯蒙德选区的一场补选。

en.s: The 2023 Worcester City Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect members of Worcester City Council in Worcestershire, England. This was on the same day as other local elections in England. Prior to the election the council had been under no overall control. The Conservatives were the largest party and their group leader, Chris Mitchell, was the leader of the council.

zh.s: 2023年5月4日，英格兰伍斯特郡举行伍斯特市议会选举，与英格兰其他地方选举同日进行。此前议会没有任何政党取得过半席位。保守党是议会第一大党，其党团领袖克里斯·米切尔担任议会领袖。

en.s: The 2023 Torridge District Council election took place on 4 May 2023, to elect all 36 members of Torridge District Council in Devon, England. Prior to the election the majority of the councillors were independents, with 17 of the 19 independents forming the "Independent Group" led by Ken James, who served as leader of the council. After the election the council went under no overall control.

zh.s: 2023年5月4日，英格兰德文郡举行托里奇区议会选举，改选议会全部36名成员。此前多数议员为独立人士，其中19名独立议员有17人组成由肯·詹姆斯领导的“独立人士团体”，他也担任议会领袖。选举后，议会没有任何政党取得过半席位。

en.t: 2023 Cheshire West and Chester Council election
en.s: The 2023 Cheshire West and Chester Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect members of Cheshire West and Chester Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections, including contested elections in the civil parishes of Broxton, Dutton, Great Boughton, Mouldsworth and Tarporley and the towns of Frodsham, Northwich and Winsford.

zh.t: 2023年柴郡西和切斯特议会选举
zh.s: 2023年5月4日，英格兰举行柴郡西和切斯特议会选举。选举与其他地方选举同日举行；柴郡西和切斯特辖区内的布罗克斯顿、达顿、大博顿、莫尔兹沃思和塔波利等民政教区，以及弗罗德舍姆、诺斯维奇和温斯福德等镇也举行了有竞争的选举。

en.s: Elections to Barnsley Metropolitan Borough Council took place on 4 May 2023 alongside other elections in the United Kingdom. One third of the council was up for election.

zh.t: 2023年巴恩斯利都市自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2023年5月4日，巴恩斯利都市自治市议会举行选举，与英国其他选举同期进行。本次改选议会三分之一席位。

en.t: 2023 East Riding of Yorkshire Council election
en.s: The 2023 East Riding of Yorkshire Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect all 67 members of East Riding of Yorkshire Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections across England. The Conservatives lost their majority on the council at this election, which saw the council go under no overall control.

zh.s: 2023年5月4日，英格兰举行东约克郡议会选举，选出议会全部67名成员。选举与英格兰其他地方选举同日举行。保守党在本次选举中失去多数席位，议会因此转为无单一政党控制。

en.s: The 2023 United Kingdom local elections were held on Thursday, 4 May 2023 in England and on Thursday 18 May 2023 in Northern Ireland. These included district councils, unitary authorities, and directly elected mayors in England, and included all local councils in Northern Ireland. Notably, these elections were the first to be held under the Elections Act 2022, a new voter identification law that required voters to show photo ID when attending a polling station, and was a cause for controversy.

zh.s: 2023年英国地方选举于5月4日（星期四）在英格兰举行，北爱尔兰则于5月18日（星期四）举行。选举涉及英格兰的区议会、单一管理区议会和直选市长，也包括北爱尔兰所有地方议会。这是《2022年选举法》实施后的首次选举。该法要求选民前往投票站时出示带照片的身份证件，因此引发争议。

en.t: 2023 Reigate and Banstead Borough Council election
en.s: The 2023 Reigate and Banstead Borough Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect members of Reigate and Banstead Borough Council in Surrey, England. This was on the same day as other local elections in England.

zh.t: 2023年赖盖特和班斯特德自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2023年5月4日，英格兰萨里郡举行赖盖特和班斯特德自治市议会选举，与英格兰其他地方选举同日进行。

en.s: The 2023 Hertsmere Borough Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect members of Hertsmere Borough Council in Hertfordshire, England. This was on the same day as other local elections across England. The council went under no overall control at this election, with the Conservatives losing the majority they had held since 1999.

zh.t: 2023年赫茨米尔自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2023年5月4日，英格兰赫特福德郡举行赫茨米尔自治市议会选举，与英格兰其他地方选举同日进行。保守党在本次选举中失去自1999年以来一直保持的多数席位，议会因此转为无单一政党控制。

en.s: The 2023 Ashfield District Council election took place on 4 May 2023, to elect all 35 members of Ashfield District Council in Nottinghamshire, England. This was on the same day as other local elections in England. The previous election occurred in 2019, and resulted in the Ashfield Independents winning in a landslide victory of 30 seats. The 2023 election saw the Ashfield Independents increase their majority, finishing with 32 seats.

zh.s: 2023年5月4日，英格兰诺丁汉郡举行阿什菲尔德区议会选举，改选议会全部35名成员，与英格兰其他地方选举同日进行。上次选举于2019年举行，阿什菲尔德独立人士以压倒性优势赢得30席。2023年，该党进一步扩大多数席位，最终获得32席。

en.s: The 2023 West Lindsey District Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect members of West Lindsey District Council in Lincolnshire, England. This was on the same day as other local elections in England. Prior to the election the council was under no overall control; the Conservatives had won a majority at the previous election in 2019 but had lost their majority during 2021 as a result of changes of allegiance.

zh.s: 2023年5月4日，英格兰林肯郡举行西林赛区议会选举，与英格兰其他地方选举同日进行。此前议会没有任何政党取得过半席位。保守党在2019年上次选举中获得多数，但因议员改换党籍，在2021年失去多数。

en.s: The 2023 East Lindsey District Council election took place on 4 May 2023, to elect all 55 members of East Lindsey District Council in Lincolnshire, England. This was on the same day as other local elections across England. Prior to the election the Conservatives held a majority of the seats on the council.

zh.s: 2023年5月4日，英格兰林肯郡举行东林赛区议会选举，改选议会全部55名成员，与英格兰其他地方选举同日举行。选举前，保守党在议会占多数席位。

en.s: The 2023 Rushmoor Borough Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect councillors to Rushmoor Borough Council in Hampshire, England. This was on the same date as other local elections across England. A third of the council was up for election. The council was under Conservative majority control prior to the election. The Conservatives lost five seats to Labour at the election, but retained a majority of the seats.

zh.t: 2023年拉什穆尔自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2023年5月4日，英格兰汉普郡举行拉什穆尔自治市议会选举，改选议会三分之一席位，与英格兰其他地方选举同日举行。此前保守党在议会占多数。本次选举中，保守党失去5席给工党，但仍保住多数席位。

en.s: The 2023 Telford and Wrekin Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect members of Telford and Wrekin Council in Shropshire, England. This was on the same day as other local elections across England. New ward boundaries came into effect for this election, but the number of seats remained the same at 54. Labour increased its majority on the council at the election.

zh.t: 2023年特尔福德和雷金议会选举
zh.s: 2023年5月4日，英格兰什罗普郡举行特尔福德和雷金议会选举，与英格兰其他地方选举同日进行。新选区边界在本次选举中生效，但席位总数仍为54席。工党在本次选举中扩大了多数席位。

en.s: The 2023 West Suffolk District Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect members of West Suffolk District Council in Suffolk, England. This was on the same day as other local elections in England.

zh.s: 2023年5月4日，英格兰萨福克郡举行西萨福克区议会选举，与英格兰其他地方选举同日进行。

en.t: 2023 Vale of White Horse District Council election
en.s: The 2023 Vale of White Horse District Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect members of Vale of White Horse District Council in Oxfordshire, England. This was on the same day as other local elections across England. The election saw the Liberal Democrats increase their majority on the council, as well as the defeat of all remaining Conservatives.

zh.s: 2023年5月4日，英格兰牛津郡举行白马谷区议会选举，与英格兰其他地方选举同日进行。自由民主党扩大了在议会的多数席位，所有剩余的保守党议员也都落选。

en.s: The 2023 Cherwell District Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect members of Cherwell District Council in Oxfordshire, England. This was on the same day as other local elections in England. The Conservatives lost control of the council to no overall control. Attempts to form a coalition of the other parties failed to produce an alternative administration.

zh.s: 2023年5月4日，英格兰牛津郡举行切尔维尔区议会选举，与英格兰其他地方选举同日进行。保守党失去议会控制权，议会转为无单一政党控制。其他政党曾尝试组建联合政府，但未能达成可替代原政府的方案。

en.s: The 2023 Dover District Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect members of Dover District Council in Kent, England. This was the same day as other local elections.

zh.s: 2023年5月4日，英格兰肯特郡举行多佛区议会选举，与其他地方选举同日进行。

en.s: The 2023 Malvern Hills District Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect members of Malvern Hills District Council in Worcestershire, England. This was on the same day as other local elections in England. New ward boundaries came into effect for this election, reducing the number of seats on the council from 38 to 31.

zh.t: 2023年莫尔文希尔斯区议会选举
zh.s: 2023年5月4日，英格兰伍斯特郡举行莫尔文希尔斯区议会选举，与英格兰其他地方选举同日进行。新选区边界在本次选举中生效，议会席位从38席减至31席。

en.s: The 2023 Erewash Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect all 47 members of Erewash Borough Council in Derbyshire, England. This was on the same day as other local elections across England. Following the results, the Conservatives lost control of the council to Labour for the first time in 20 years.

zh.t: 2023年埃里沃什自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2023年5月4日，英格兰德比郡举行埃里沃什自治市议会选举，改选议会全部47名成员，与英格兰其他地方选举同日进行。选举结果出炉后，保守党失去议会控制权，工党时隔20年首次执政。

en.s: The 2023 East Devon District Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect all 60 members of East Devon District Council in Devon, England. This was on the same day as other local elections across England. The council remained under no overall control, being led by an alliance of the Liberal Democrats, Greens, Labour and some of the independent councillors.

zh.s: 2023年5月4日，英格兰德文郡举行东德文区议会选举，改选议会全部60名成员，与英格兰其他地方选举同日进行。选举后，议会仍没有任何政党取得过半席位，由自由民主党、绿党、工党和部分独立议员组成的联盟执政。

en.s: The 2023 Warwick District Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect members of Warwick District Council in Warwickshire, England. This took place on the same day as other local elections in England. The council remained without control of any party.

zh.s: 2023年5月4日，英格兰沃里克郡举行沃里克区议会选举，与英格兰其他地方选举同日进行。选举后，仍没有任何政党控制议会。

en.s: The 2023 Brentwood Borough Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect members of Brentwood Borough Council in Essex, England. This was on the same day as other local elections in England. Prior to the election the Conservatives had a majority on the council. The leader of the council before the election, Chris Hossack, chose not to stand for re-election.

zh.t: 2023年布伦特伍德自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2023年5月4日，英格兰埃塞克斯郡举行布伦特伍德自治市议会选举，与英格兰其他地方选举同日进行。选举前，保守党在议会占多数。时任议会领袖克里斯·霍萨克决定不再竞选连任。

en.s: The 2023 Stockport Metropolitan Borough Council elections took place on 4 May 2023 alongside other local elections in the United Kingdom. Due to boundary changes, all 63 seats on Stockport Metropolitan Borough Council were contested. The council was under no overall control prior to the election, being led by a Liberal Democrat minority administration. The council remained under no overall control after the election, but the Liberal Democrats increased their share of the seats.

zh.t: 2023年斯托克波特都市自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2023年5月4日，英国举行地方选举，斯托克波特都市自治市议会也在当天举行选举。由于选区边界调整，议会全部63个席位均参加改选。此前议会没有任何政党取得过半席位，由自由民主党少数派政府执政。选举后议会仍没有任何政党取得过半席位，但自由民主党的席位占比有所上升。

en.t: 2023 Windsor and Maidenhead Borough Council election
en.s: The 2023 Windsor and Maidenhead Borough Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect members of Windsor and Maidenhead Borough Council in Berkshire, England. This was on the same day as other local elections. The election saw the Liberal Democrats win a majority of the seats on the council, which had previously been under Conservative control.

zh.t: 2023年温莎和梅登黑德自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2023年5月4日，英格兰伯克郡举行温莎和梅登黑德自治市议会选举，与其他地方选举同日进行。自由民主党赢得议会多数席位，此前议会由保守党控制。

en.s: The 2023 Redditch Borough Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect members of Redditch Borough Council in Worcestershire, England. This was on the same day as other local elections across England. There were 10 of the 29 seats on the council up for election, being the usual nominal third of the council. The Conservatives retained control of the council.

zh.s: 2023年5月4日，英格兰伍斯特郡举行雷迪奇自治市议会选举，与英格兰其他地方选举同日进行。议会29个席位中的10席参加改选，按常规约为三分之一席位。保守党保住了议会控制权。

en.t: 2023 Epsom and Ewell Borough Council election
en.s: The 2023 Epsom and Ewell Borough Council election took place on 4 May 2023, to elect all 35 members of Epsom and Ewell Borough Council in Surrey, England. This was on the same day as other local elections across England. New ward boundaries came into effect for this election, reducing the number of seats from 38 to 35.

zh.t: 2023年埃普瑟姆和尤厄尔自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2023年5月4日，英格兰萨里郡举行埃普瑟姆和尤厄尔自治市议会选举，改选全部35名成员，与英格兰其他地方选举同日举行。新选区边界在本次选举中生效，席位从38席减至35席。

en.s: The 2023 Wyre Forest District Council election took place on 4 May 2023, to elect all 33 members of Wyre Forest District Council in Worcestershire, England. This was on the same day as other local elections across England. Prior to the election the council was under no overall control, being run by a "progressive alliance" of Independent Health Concern, Labour, Green and independent councillors.

zh.s: 2023年5月4日，英格兰伍斯特郡举行怀尔森林区议会选举，改选全部33名成员，与英格兰其他地方选举同日举行。此前议会没有任何政党取得过半席位，由“进步联盟”执政，成员包括独立健康关注党、工党、绿党和独立议员。

en.s: The 2023 South Derbyshire District Council election took place on 4 May 2023, to elect all 36 members of South Derbyshire District Council in Derbyshire, England. This was on the same day as other local elections across England. Labour took a majority of the seats on the council, which had previously been under no overall control.

zh.s: 2023年5月4日，英格兰德比郡举行南德比郡区议会选举，改选全部36名成员，与英格兰其他地方选举同日举行。此前议会没有任何政党取得过半席位，本次选举后工党赢得多数席位。

en.s: The 2023 Stevenage Borough Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect members of Stevenage Borough Council in Stevenage, Hertfordshire, England. This was on the same day as other local elections across England. Thirteen of the 39 seats on the council were up for election. Labour retained its majority on the council.

zh.t: 2023年史蒂夫尼奇自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2023年5月4日，英格兰赫特福德郡史蒂夫尼奇举行自治市议会选举，与英格兰其他地方选举同日进行。议会39席中的13席参加改选。工党保住了多数席位。

en.s: The 2023 Swale Borough Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect members of Swale Borough Council in Kent, England. This was on the same day as other local elections across England. The council was under no overall control prior to the election. The Conservatives were the largest party, but the council was being run by a rainbow coalition of all the other main parties, led by Mike Baldock of local party the Swale Independents.

zh.s: 2023年5月4日，英格兰肯特郡举行斯韦尔自治市议会选举，与英格兰其他地方选举同日进行。此前议会没有任何政党取得过半席位。保守党是第一大党，但议会由其他主要政党组成的联合政府执政，联盟由地方政党斯韦尔独立人士党的迈克·鲍尔多克领导。

en.s: The 2023 Tameside Metropolitan Borough Council elections took place on 4 May 2023 alongside other local elections in the United Kingdom. Due to boundary changes, all 57 seats on Tameside Metropolitan Borough Council were contested. Labour retained its majority on the council.

zh.t: 2023年泰姆赛德都市自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2023年5月4日，英国举行地方选举，泰姆赛德都市自治市议会也在当天举行选举。由于选区边界调整，议会全部57席均参加改选。工党保住了多数席位。

en.s: The 2023 Castle Point Borough Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect members of Castle Point Borough Council in Essex, England. This was on the same day as other local elections across England. The coalition between The People's Independent Party and the Canvey Island Independent Party substantially increased their majority on the council at the expense of the Conservatives.

zh.t: 2023年卡斯尔波因特自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2023年5月4日，英格兰埃塞克斯郡举行卡斯尔波因特自治市议会选举，与英格兰其他地方选举同日进行。人民独立党与坎维岛独立党组成的联盟大幅扩大了在议会的多数席位，保守党因此失去席位。

en.s: The 2023 Plymouth City Council election was held on 4 May 2023 to elect members of Plymouth City Council in England. It coincided with local elections across the United Kingdom. In the previous election in 2022, both Labour and the Conservative Party gained seats, primarily due to councillors who had left their party groups standing down or unsuccessfully seeking re-election.

zh.s: 2023年5月4日，英格兰举行普利茅斯市议会选举，与英国各地的地方选举同期进行。2022年上次选举中，工党和保守党都增加了席位，主要原因是一些退出原党团的议员选择不再竞选，或竞选连任失败。

en.s: The 2023 Elmbridge Borough Council election was held on 4 May 2023 to elect members of Elmbridge Borough Council in Surrey, England. This was on the same day as other local elections across England. There were 16 out of 48 seats contested, being the usual third of the council.

zh.t: 2023年埃尔姆布里奇自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2023年5月4日，英格兰萨里郡举行埃尔姆布里奇自治市议会选举，改选48席中的16席，按常规为议会三分之一席位。选举与英格兰其他地方选举同日举行。

en.t: 2023 Tonbridge and Malling Borough Council election
en.s: An election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect councillors to Tonbridge and Malling Borough Council in Kent, England. This took place on the same day as other local elections across England. Boundary changes which took effect at this election saw the number of councillors reduced from 54 to 44 and the number of wards reduced from 24 to 19.

zh.t: 2023年汤布里奇和马灵自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2023年5月4日，英格兰肯特郡举行汤布里奇和马灵自治市议会选举，与英格兰其他地方选举同日进行。新选区边界在本次选举中生效，议员人数从54人减至44人，选区数量从24个减至19个。

en.s: The 2023 Thanet District Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect members of Thanet District Council in Kent, England. This was on the same day as other local elections across England. The council was under no overall control prior to the election, being led by Conservative councillor Ash Ashbee. Labour won a majority of the seats. Ash Ashbee lost her seat.

zh.s: 2023年5月4日，英格兰肯特郡举行萨尼特区议会选举，与英格兰其他地方选举同日进行。此前议会没有任何政党取得过半席位，由保守党议员阿什·阿什比领导。本次选举后，工党取得多数席位，阿什·阿什比也失去议席。

en.s: Local elections were held for South Ribble Borough Council on 4 May 2023. These took place on the same day as the wider local elections across England. Every multi-member ward was up for election.

zh.t: 2023年南里布尔自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2023年5月4日，南里布尔自治市议会举行地方选举，与英格兰各地的地方选举同日进行。所有多议员选区均参加改选。

en.s: The 2023 City of Lincoln Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect members of City of Lincoln Council in Lincolnshire, England. It was held on the same day as other local elections across England. This election did not result in a change of control of the council as Labour retained a majority, but did result in a doubling of the size of the Liberal Democrat council group at the expense of two Labour councillors.

zh.s: 2023年5月4日，英格兰林肯郡举行林肯市议会选举，与英格兰其他地方选举同日进行。工党保住多数席位，议会控制权没有变化。不过，自由民主党议员人数翻了一倍，新增议员来自两名落选的工党议员。

en.s: The 2023 Sunderland City Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect members of Sunderland City Council. There were 25 of the 75 seats of the council up for election, being the usual third of the council. The election took place at the same time as other local elections across England. Labour retained its majority on the council.

zh.s: 2023年5月4日举行桑德兰市议会选举，改选议会75席中的25席，按常规为三分之一席位。选举与英格兰其他地方选举同期举行。工党保住了议会多数席位。

en.s: The 2023 Basildon Borough Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect members of Basildon Borough Council in Essex, England. This was on the same day as other local elections in England. The council remained under Conservative control.

zh.t: 2023年巴西尔登自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2023年5月4日，英格兰埃塞克斯郡举行巴西尔登自治市议会选举，与英格兰其他地方选举同日进行。保守党继续控制议会。

en.s: The 2023 Gateshead Metropolitan Borough Council took place on 4 May 2023 to elect members of Gateshead Metropolitan Borough Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections across England. One third of the council was elected. One candidate was elected from each of the council's 22 wards.

zh.t: 2023年盖茨黑德都市自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2023年5月4日，英格兰举行盖茨黑德都市自治市议会选举，与英格兰其他地方选举同日进行。议会三分之一席位参加选举，22个选区各选出一名议员。

en.t: 2023 North East Derbyshire District Council election
en.s: The 2023 North East Derbyshire District Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect all 53 members of North East Derbyshire District Council in Derbyshire, England. This was on the same day as other local elections across England. Prior to the election the council was under no overall control, being led by a Conservative minority administration.

zh.s: 2023年5月4日，英格兰德比郡举行东北德比郡区议会选举，改选全部53名成员，与英格兰其他地方选举同日进行。此前议会没有任何政党取得过半席位，由保守党少数派政府执政。

en.s: The 2023 Sandwell Metropolitan Borough Council elections were held on 4 May 2023 alongside other local elections in the United Kingdom. One third of seats on Sandwell Metropolitan Borough Council are up for election. Labour retained its majority on the council. Both Labour and the Conservatives gained seats, whilst the Liberal Democrats and independents lost all their seats, leaving only two parties represented on the council after the election.

zh.t: 2023年桑德韦尔都市自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2023年5月4日，英国举行地方选举，桑德韦尔都市自治市议会也在当天举行选举。议会三分之一席位参加改选。工党保住了多数席位。工党和保守党均增加席位，自由民主党和独立议员失去全部席位，选举后议会只剩两个政党。

en.s: The 2023 Southampton City Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect members of Southampton City Council in Hampshire, England. This was on the same day as other local elections. Due to ward boundary changes all seats on the council were to be contested in this election, but due to the death of one of the candidates, the election for Coxford ward was postponed.

zh.s: 2023年5月4日，英格兰汉普郡举行南安普敦市议会选举，与其他地方选举同日进行。由于选区边界调整，原计划议会所有席位都参加改选；但一名候选人去世后，考克斯福德选区的选举延期举行。

en.s: The 2023 Runnymede Borough Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect one-third of members of the Runnymede Borough Council in Surrey, England. This was on the same day as other local elections in England. The Conservative Party lost control of the council for the second time since the first election in 1973, the first being a short period between 1996 and 1998 when it was also under no overall control.

zh.t: 2023年伦尼米德自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2023年5月4日，英格兰萨里郡举行伦尼米德自治市议会选举，改选议会三分之一席位，与英格兰其他地方选举同日进行。保守党失去议会控制权。这是该党自1973年首次选举以来第二次失去控制权；上一次是1996年至1998年间，议会也曾一度没有任何政党控制。

en.s: The 2023 Rugby Borough Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect 14 members (one-third) of Rugby Borough Council in Warwickshire, England. This was on the same day as other local elections across England.

zh.s: 2023年5月4日，英格兰沃里克郡举行拉格比自治市议会选举，改选14席，即议会三分之一席位，与英格兰其他地方选举同日举行。

en.s: The 2023 Great Yarmouth Borough Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect members of Great Yarmouth Borough Council in Norfolk, England. This was on the same day as other local elections in England. Prior to the election the council was under Conservative majority control. The Conservatives remained the largest party after the election, but lost their majority leaving the council under no overall control.

zh.t: 2023年大雅茅斯自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2023年5月4日，英格兰诺福克郡举行大雅茅斯自治市议会选举，与英格兰其他地方选举同日进行。此前保守党在议会占多数。选举后，保守党仍是第一大党，但失去多数席位，议会因此转为无单一政党控制。
