en.s: The 2023 Tandridge District Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect 14 members (one-third) of Tandridge District Council in Surrey, England. This was on the same day as other local elections across England. The council remained under no overall control, being led by an alliance of local party the Oxted and Limpsfield Residents Group and some of the independent councillors.

zh.s: 2023年5月4日，英格兰萨里郡举行坦德里奇区议会选举，改选14席，即议会三分之一席位，与英格兰其他地方选举同日举行。选举后，议会仍没有任何政党取得过半席位，由地方政党奥克斯特德和林普斯菲尔德居民团体与部分独立议员组成的联盟领导。

en.s: The 2023 High Peak Borough Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect members of High Peak Borough Council in Derbyshire, England. This was on the same day as other local elections in England. The council was under no overall control prior to the election. Labour had won a majority at the previous full council election in 2019, but lost its majority in 2022 following a by-election in Cote Heath ward.

zh.s: 2023年5月4日，英格兰德比郡举行海峰区议会选举，与英格兰其他地方选举同日进行。此前议会没有任何政党取得过半席位。工党在2019年上次全体改选中赢得多数，但在2022年科特希思选区补选后失去多数。

en.s: The 2023 Waverley Borough Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect members of Waverley Borough Council in Surrey, England. This was on the same day as other local elections across England.

zh.s: 2023年5月4日，英格兰萨里郡举行韦弗利自治市议会选举，与英格兰其他地方选举同日进行。

en.t: 2023 City of Bradford Metropolitan District Council election
en.s: The 2023 City of Bradford Metropolitan District Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect members of City of Bradford Metropolitan District Council in West Yorkshire, England. This was on the same day as other local elections across England. Labour retained its majority on the council.

zh.t: 2023年布拉德福德市都市区议会选举
zh.s: 2023年5月4日，英格兰西约克郡举行布拉德福德市都市区议会选举，与英格兰其他地方选举同日进行。工党保住了议会多数席位。

en.s: The 2023 Rushcliffe Borough Council election took place on 4 May 2023, to elect all 44 members of Rushcliffe Borough Council in Nottinghamshire, England. This was on the same day as other local elections across England. The council had been under Conservative majority control since 1999. The leader of the council prior to the election was Simon Robinson, but he chose not to stand for re-election.

zh.t: 2023年拉什克利夫自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2023年5月4日，英格兰诺丁汉郡举行拉什克利夫自治市议会选举，改选全部44名成员，与英格兰其他地方选举同日举行。保守党自1999年以来一直在议会占多数。选举前的议会领袖西蒙·罗宾逊决定不再竞选连任。

en.s: The 2023 Colchester City Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect members of Colchester City Council in Essex, England. This was on the same day as other local elections across England. There were 17 of the 51 seats on the council up for election, being the usual third of the council, with one seat available for each ward.

zh.s: 2023年5月4日，英格兰埃塞克斯郡举行科尔切斯特市议会选举，与英格兰其他地方选举同日进行。议会51席中的17席参加改选，按常规为三分之一席位，每个选区各有一席待选。

en.s: The 2023 South Kesteven District Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect all 56 members of South Kesteven District Council in Lincolnshire, England. This was on the same day as other local elections across England. The council was under Conservative majority control prior to the election. The Conservatives remained the largest party after the election but lost their majority.

zh.s: 2023年5月4日，英格兰林肯郡举行南凯斯蒂文区议会选举，改选全部56名成员，与英格兰其他地方选举同日举行。此前保守党在议会占多数。选举后，保守党仍是第一大党，但失去多数席位。

en.s: The 2023 Epping Forest District Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect members of Epping Forest District Council in Essex, England. There were 18 of the 58 seats up for election, being the usual approximate third of the council. This was on the same day as other local elections across England. The Conservatives retained their majority on the council.

zh.s: 2023年5月4日，英格兰埃塞克斯郡举行埃平森林区议会选举。58席中的18席参加改选，约为议会三分之一席位。选举与英格兰其他地方选举同日举行。保守党保住了议会多数席位。

en.s: Elections to Calderdale Metropolitan Borough Council took place on 4 May 2023 alongside other elections in the United Kingdom. Labour retained its majority on the council.

zh.t: 2023年考尔德代尔都市自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2023年5月4日，英国举行地方选举，考尔德代尔都市自治市议会也在当天举行选举。工党保住了议会多数席位。

en.s: The 2023 Wigan Metropolitan Borough Council elections took place on 4 May 2023 alongside other local elections in the United Kingdom. Due to boundary changes all 75 seats on Wigan Metropolitan Borough Council were contested. Labour retained its majority on the council.

zh.t: 2023年威根都市自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2023年5月4日，英国举行地方选举，威根都市自治市议会也在当天举行选举。由于选区边界调整，议会全部75席均参加改选。工党保住了议会多数席位。

en.s: The 2023 Hartlepool Borough Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect members of Hartlepool Borough Council in County Durham, England. This was on the same day as other local elections across England. Prior to the election the council was under no overall control, being run by a coalition of the Conservatives and Independent Union, led by Shane Moore of the Independent Union.

zh.t: 2023年哈特尔浦自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2023年5月4日，英格兰达勒姆郡举行哈特尔浦自治市议会选举，与英格兰其他地方选举同日进行。此前议会没有任何政党取得过半席位，由保守党和独立联盟组成的联合政府执政，联盟由独立联盟的肖恩·摩尔领导。

en.s: The 2023 North Lincolnshire Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect all 43 members of North Lincolnshire Council in Lincolnshire, England. This was at the same time as other local elections across England. The Conservatives retained their majority on the council.

zh.s: 2023年5月4日，英格兰林肯郡举行北林肯郡议会选举，改选全部43名成员，与英格兰其他地方选举同期举行。保守党保住了议会多数席位。

en.s: The 2023 Eastbourne Borough Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect members of Eastbourne Borough Council in East Sussex, England. This was on the same day as other local elections. The Liberal Democrats retained their majority on the council. Their leader prior to the election was David Tutt, who did not stand for re-election.

zh.t: 2023年伊斯特本自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2023年5月4日，英格兰东萨塞克斯郡举行伊斯特本自治市议会选举，与其他地方选举同日进行。自由民主党保住了议会多数席位。选举前的党领袖戴维·塔特没有竞选连任。

en.s: The 2023 Leicester City Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect all 54 members of Leicester City Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections, and the election for the directly elected Mayor of Leicester. Labour's Peter Soulsby was re-elected as mayor and the party retained its majority on the council, but with a significant loss of 22 seats compared to its position at the previous election in 2019.

zh.s: 2023年5月4日，英格兰举行莱斯特市议会选举，改选全部54名成员，与其他地方选举及莱斯特市直选市长选举同日进行。工党的彼得·索尔斯比连任市长，工党也保住了议会多数，但相比2019年上次选举时的席位减少了22席。

en.s: The 2023 Nottingham City Council election took place on 4 May 2023, to elect all 55 members of Nottingham City Council in England. It took place as part of the 2023 United Kingdom local elections. The previous election occurred in 2019, and resulted in the Labour Party retaining control with a majority of seats. Both of the city council's previous two Conservatives left the party just ahead of the election to stand as independent candidates.

zh.s: 2023年5月4日，英格兰举行诺丁汉市议会选举，改选全部55名成员，是2023年英国地方选举的一部分。2019年上次选举后，工党以多数席位继续执政。选举前不久，市议会原有的两名保守党议员都退出了保守党，并以独立候选人身份参选。

en.s: The 2023 East Suffolk District Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect members of East Suffolk District Council in Suffolk, England. This was held on the same day as other local elections. All 55 seats on the council were up for election.

zh.s: 2023年5月4日，英格兰萨福克郡举行东萨福克区议会选举，与其他地方选举同日进行。议会全部55席均参加改选。

en.s: The 2023 Walsall Metropolitan Borough Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect members of Walsall Council in the West Midlands, England. This was on the same day as other local elections. There were 21 of the 60 seats were up for election. The Conservatives retained their majority on the council.

zh.t: 2023年沃尔索尔都市自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2023年5月4日，英格兰西米德兰兹郡举行沃尔索尔议会选举，与其他地方选举同日进行。议会60席中的21席参加改选。保守党保住了多数席位。

en.s: The 2023 South Gloucestershire Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect members of South Gloucestershire Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections across England. The Conservatives lost control of the council to no overall control. A Liberal Democrat and Labour coalition subsequently formed to take control of the council.

zh.s: 2023年5月4日，英格兰举行南格洛斯特郡议会选举，与英格兰其他地方选举同日进行。保守党失去议会控制权，议会转为无单一政党控制。随后，自由民主党和工党组成联合政府执掌议会。

en.s: The 2023 Bedford Borough Council election took place on 4 May 2023, electing members of Bedford Borough Council in Bedfordshire, England. An election for the borough's directly-elected mayor took place at the same time. This was the same day as other local elections. The whole council was up for election on new ward boundaries. The total number of seats increased by 6, from 40 to 46.

zh.t: 2023年贝德福德自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2023年5月4日，英格兰贝德福德郡举行贝德福德自治市议会选举，选出议会成员。该自治市的直选市长也在同日改选。本次选举与其他地方选举同期举行。由于采用新的选区边界，议会全体议员均参加改选，席位总数增加6席，从40席增至46席。

en.s: The 2023 Wirral Metropolitan Borough Council election took place on 4 May 2023, electing members to Wirral Metropolitan Borough Council in England. This was the third election to the council where all councillors were up for election and the first in which the authority moves to a four-yearly, whole-council election system, following recommendations from a government report into the council's finances.

zh.t: 2023年威勒尔都市自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2023年5月4日，英格兰举行威勒尔都市自治市议会选举。此前已有两次全体改选，本次是第三次。政府对议会财政状况进行调查并提出建议后，威勒尔改为每四年一次全体改选，本次是改制后的首次选举。

en.t: 2023 Hinckley and Bosworth Borough Council election
en.s: The 2023 Hinckley and Bosworth Borough Council election was held on 4 May 2023, to elect members of Hinckley and Bosworth Borough Council in Leicestershire, England. This was on the same day as other local elections across England. All sixteen wards were for election, each with between one and three councillors to be elected. The Liberal Democrats retained control of the council.

zh.t: 2023年欣克利和博斯沃思自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2023年5月4日，英格兰莱斯特郡举行欣克利和博斯沃思自治市议会选举，选出议会成员，与英格兰其他地方选举同日举行。16个选区全部改选，每个选区选出1至3名议员。自由民主党保住了议会控制权。

en.s: The 2023 Lichfield District Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect members of Lichfield District Council in Staffordshire, England. This was on the same day as other English local elections. All 47 members of the council were up for election, and the Conservatives lost control of the council to no overall control. This marked the first time that the Conservatives had not held Lichfield District Council since 1999.

zh.s: 2023年5月4日，英格兰斯塔福德郡举行利奇菲尔德区议会选举，与英格兰其他地方选举同日进行。议会全部47名成员参加改选。保守党失去议会控制权，议会转为无单一政党控制。这是保守党自1999年以来首次不再控制利奇菲尔德区议会。

en.s: The 2023 Rochford District Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect members of Rochford District Council in Essex, England. This would be on the same day as other local elections in England. Less than three months before the election, three Conservative councillors left the party, putting the council under no overall control with the Conservatives becoming a minority administration.

zh.s: 2023年5月4日，英格兰埃塞克斯郡举行罗奇福德区议会选举。选举与英格兰其他地方选举同日进行。选举前三个月内，三名保守党议员退党，导致议会不再由单一政党控制，保守党成为少数派政府。

en.s: The 2023 Norwich City Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect members of Norwich City Council in Norfolk, England. This was on the same day as other local elections in England.

zh.s: 2023年5月4日，英格兰诺福克郡举行诺里奇市议会选举，与英格兰其他地方选举同日进行。

en.s: The 2023 Ashford Borough Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect members of Ashford Borough Council in Kent, England. This was on the same day as other local elections in England. At the previous election in 2019, the Conservatives had held onto a majority winning 26 seats out of the 47 up for election.

zh.t: 2023年阿什福德自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2023年5月4日，英格兰肯特郡举行阿什福德自治市议会选举，与英格兰其他地方选举同日进行。2019年上次选举时，保守党赢得47席中的26席，保住了多数。

en.s: The 2023 Surrey Heath Borough Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect 32 of 35 members of Surrey Heath Borough Council in England. It was held on the same day as other local elections. The Liberal Democrats took control of the council from a minority Conservative administration.

zh.t: 2023年萨里希思自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2023年5月4日，英格兰举行萨里希思自治市议会选举，改选35席中的32席，与其他地方选举同日进行。自由民主党从保守党少数派政府手中取得议会控制权。

en.s: The 2023 Rutland County Council election was held on 4 May 2023 to elect members of Rutland County Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections across England. Prior to the election the council was under no overall control, being run by a coalition of the Conservatives and independents. After the election the council remained under no overall control, but the Liberal Democrats became the largest party.

zh.s: 2023年5月4日，英格兰举行拉特兰郡议会选举，与英格兰其他地方选举同日进行。此前议会没有任何政党取得过半席位，由保守党和独立议员组成的联盟执政。选举后，议会仍没有任何政党取得过半席位，但自由民主党成为第一大党。

en.s: The 2023 Pendle Borough Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect a third of the council for the Borough of Pendle in Lancashire, England. This was on the same day as other local elections in England. Twelve seats across eleven wards were up for election, being the usual approximate third of the council plus a by-election in Vivary Bridge ward.

zh.s: 2023年5月4日，英格兰兰开夏郡举行彭德尔自治市议会选举，改选议会三分之一席位，与英格兰其他地方选举同日进行。11个选区共有12席参加选举，通常每次改选的三分之一席位之外，还包括维瓦里桥选区的一场补选。

en.s: The 2023 West Berkshire Council election took take place on 4 May 2023 to elect members of West Berkshire Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections across England. Prior to the election the council was under Conservative control, with the party having held a majority of the seats since 2005. The Liberal Democrats took control at the election, winning 29 of the 43 seats.

zh.s: 2023年5月4日，英格兰举行西伯克郡议会选举，与英格兰其他地方选举同日进行。此前议会由保守党控制，该党自2005年以来一直占多数。自由民主党在本次选举中取得议会控制权，赢得43席中的29席。

en.s: The 2023 Milton Keynes City Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect members of Milton Keynes City Council in the ceremonial county of Buckinghamshire, England. This was on the same day as other local elections across England. At the election, the council remained under no overall control, with the Labour Party (who topped the poll for the second consecutive year) making significant gains at the expense of the Conservatives.

zh.t: 2023年米尔顿凯恩斯市议会选举
zh.s: 2023年5月4日，英格兰白金汉郡名誉郡举行米尔顿凯恩斯市议会选举，与英格兰其他地方选举同日进行。选举后，议会仍没有任何政党取得过半席位。连续第二年得票最多的工党大幅增加席位，主要从保守党手中获得。

en.s: The 2023 Torbay Council election was held on 4 May 2023 to elect members of Torbay Council in England. It coincided with local elections across the United Kingdom. Before the election, the council was controlled by a coalition between the Liberal Democrats, with 12 seats, and Independents, with 10 seats. The largest party was the Conservatives with 13 seats.

zh.s: 2023年5月4日，英格兰举行托贝议会选举，与英国各地的地方选举同期举行。选举前，议会由自由民主党与独立议员组成的联盟控制，双方分别有12席和10席。保守党是第一大党，拥有13席。

en.s: The 2023 Babergh District Council election was held on 4 May 2023 to elect members of Babergh District Council in Suffolk, England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.s: 2023年5月4日，英格兰萨福克郡举行巴伯区议会选举，与其他地方选举同日进行。

en.s: The 2023 Fylde Borough Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect councillors to Fylde Borough Council in Lancashire, England. This was on the same day as other local elections across England. New ward boundaries took effect for this election, reducing the number of seats from 51 to 37.

zh.s: 2023年5月4日，英格兰兰开夏郡举行菲尔德自治市议会选举，与英格兰其他地方选举同日进行。新选区边界在本次选举中生效，席位数从51席减至37席。

en.s: The 2023 Breckland District Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect members of Breckland District Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections. The boundaries for this election were the same as those used in 2015 and 2019.

zh.s: 2023年5月4日，英格兰举行布雷克兰区议会选举，与其他地方选举同日进行。本次选举沿用了2015年和2019年选举时的选区边界。

en.t: 2023 Blackburn with Darwen Borough Council election
en.s: The 2023 Blackburn with Darwen Borough Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect members of Blackburn with Darwen Borough Council. It took place on the same day as other local elections. Seventeen members of the council were elected, one from each of the wards. This set of seats was last up for election in 2019. Labour retained its majority on the council, making two gains in Darwen.

zh.t: 2023年布莱克本和达尔文自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2023年5月4日举行布莱克本和达尔文自治市议会选举，与其他地方选举同日进行。议会17名成员当选，每个选区选出一人。这批席位上次于2019年改选。工党保住了议会多数席位，并在达尔文赢得两席。

en.s: The 2023 Leeds City Council election took place on Thursday 4 May 2023 to elect members of Leeds City Council in England. It was held on the same day as other local elections across the United Kingdom. The 2023 elections were the first to be held following the introduction of Voter ID requirements for those voting in person at polling stations across the entire country.

zh.s: 2023年5月4日（星期四），英格兰举行利兹市议会选举，与英国其他地方选举同日进行。这是全国投票站现场投票实施选民身份核验要求后的首次选举。

en.s: The 2023 Test Valley Borough Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect members of Test Valley Borough Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections. The whole council of 43 members was up for election across 20 wards.

zh.t: 2023年泰斯特谷自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2023年5月4日，英格兰汉普郡举行泰斯特谷自治市议会选举，与其他地方选举同日进行。全体43名议员均参加改选，分布在20个选区。

en.s: The 2023 Fenland District Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect members of Fenland District Council in Cambridgeshire, England. This was on the same day as other local elections across England. The Conservatives increased their majority on the council, against the national trend for local elections held on that day, giving the Conservative Party their largest numerical majority of any lower tier principal authority in the country.

zh.s: 2023年5月4日，英格兰剑桥郡举行芬兰区议会选举，与英格兰其他地方选举同日进行。与当天全国地方选举的整体趋势相反，保守党扩大了在议会的多数席位，也因此成为全国所有低层级主要地方政府中，数值多数席位最多的政党。

en.s: The 2023 Wokingham Borough Council election took place on Thursday 4 May 2023, to elect members of Wokingham Borough Council in Berkshire, England. This was on the same day as other local elections across England. One third of the council, 18 seats, was up for election. Prior to the election the council was under no overall control.

zh.t: 2023年沃金厄姆自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2023年5月4日（星期四），英格兰伯克郡举行沃金厄姆自治市议会选举，与英格兰其他地方选举同日进行。议会三分之一席位（18席）参加改选。选举前，议会没有任何政党取得过半席位。

en.s: The 2023 Harlow District Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect members of Harlow District Council in Essex, England. This was on the same day as other local elections across England. One third of the council was up for election. The Conservatives retained their majority on the council. Immediately after the election the Conservative leader of the council, Russell Perrin, announced his resignation as leader.

zh.s: 2023年5月4日，英格兰埃塞克斯郡举行哈洛区议会选举，改选议会三分之一席位，与英格兰其他地方选举同日进行。保守党保住了多数席位。选举结束后不久，保守党议会领袖拉塞尔·佩林宣布辞去领袖职务。

en.s: The 2023 Teignbridge District Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect members of Teignbridge District Council in Devon, England. This was on the same day as other local elections across England. The Liberal Democrats won a majority on the council, which had been under no overall control prior to the election.

zh.s: 2023年5月4日，英格兰德文郡举行廷布里奇区议会选举，与英格兰其他地方选举同日进行。此前议会没有任何政党取得过半席位。本次选举后，自由民主党在议会取得多数。

en.s: The 2023 Bolsover District Council election took place on 4 May 2023, to elect all 37 members of Bolsover District Council in Derbyshire, England. This was on the same day as other local elections across England.

zh.s: 2023年5月4日，英格兰德比郡举行博尔索弗区议会选举，改选全部37名成员，与英格兰其他地方选举同日举行。

en.s: The 2023 Rother District Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect members of Rother District Council in East Sussex, England. This would be on the same day as other local elections in England. Prior to the election the council was administered by the "Rother Alliance", being a coalition of the Rother Association of Independent Councillors, Liberal Democrats, Labour and Greens.

zh.s: 2023年5月4日举行罗瑟区议会选举。选举前，议会由“罗瑟联盟”管理，该联盟由罗瑟独立议员协会、自由民主党、工党和绿党组成。

en.s: The 2023 Broxtowe Borough Council election took place on 4 May 2023, to elect all 44 members of Broxtowe Borough Council in England. This took place as part of the 2023 United Kingdom local elections. Prior to the election the council was under no overall control, being run by a coalition of Labour, Liberal Democrats and independent councillors, led by Labour group leader Milan Radulovic.

zh.t: 2023年布罗克斯托自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2023年5月4日，英格兰举行布罗克斯托自治市议会选举，改选全部44名成员，是2023年英国地方选举的一部分。此前议会没有任何政党取得过半席位，由工党、自由民主党和独立议员组成的联盟执政，联盟由工党团领袖米兰·拉杜洛维奇领导。

en.s: The 2023 Cannock Chase District election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect 17 of the 41 councillors on Cannock Chase District Council in Staffordshire, England. on the same day as other local elections in England, including to eight parish councils in the district. The usual nominal third of the council (15 seats, one from each ward) was up for election, plus there were two vacancies to be filled, meaning a total of 17 councillors were elected.

zh.s: 2023年5月4日，英格兰斯塔福德郡举行坎诺克蔡斯区议会选举，并与英格兰其他地方选举同日举行。坎诺克蔡斯区议会41名议员中有17人当选，其中通常改选的三分之一席位共15席，每个选区各一席；此外还有两个空缺席位需要补选。该区八个民政教区议会也在同日举行选举。

en.s: The 2023 Cambridge City Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect members of Cambridge City Council in Cambridge, Cambridgeshire, England. This was on the same day as other local elections across England. A major issue was a proposed congestion charge. Labour retained its majority on the council, but replaced its leader after the election, with Mike Davey being appointed the new leader of the council at the subsequent annual council meeting on 25 May 2023.

zh.s: 2023年5月4日，英格兰剑桥郡剑桥市举行议会选举，与英格兰其他地方选举同日进行。拟议中的拥堵费是竞选中的一个重要议题。工党保住了多数席位，但在选举后更换了党团领袖；迈克·戴维于5月25日随后举行的年度议会会议上获任议会新领袖。

en.s: The 2023 Burnley Borough Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect members of Burnley Borough Council in Lancashire, England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.s: 2023年5月4日，英格兰兰开夏郡举行伯恩利自治市议会选举，与其他地方选举同日进行。

en.s: The 2023 North East Lincolnshire Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect 15 members (the usual approximate third) of North East Lincolnshire Council in Lincolnshire, England. This was on the same day as other local elections across England. The Conservatives retained their majority on the council. After the election Labour changed their group leader, with Kathryn Wheatley replacing Matthew Patrick.

zh.s: 2023年5月4日，英格兰林肯郡举行东北林肯郡议会选举，改选议会三分之一席位（15席），与英格兰其他地方选举同日进行。保守党保住了议会多数。选举后，工党更换了党团领袖，凯瑟琳·惠特利接替马修·帕特里克。

en.s: The 2023 Knowsley Metropolitan Borough Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect members of Knowsley Metropolitan Borough Council in Merseyside, England. This was on the same day as other local elections. Labour retained its majority on the council. The Green Party made two further gains from Labour to secure their status as the official opposition in the borough.

zh.t: 2023年诺斯利都市自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2023年5月4日，英格兰默西赛德郡举行诺斯利都市自治市议会选举，与其他地方选举同日进行。工党保住了多数席位。绿党又从工党手中赢得两席，成为该自治市议会的正式反对党。

en.s: The 2023 Hyndburn Borough Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect 12 of the 35 members of Hyndburn Borough Council in Lancashire, England, being the usual approximate third of the council. This was on the same day as other local elections across England. The council remained under no overall control, and the leader of the council, independent councillor Miles Parkinson, lost his seat.

zh.s: 2023年5月4日，英格兰兰开夏郡举行亨德本自治市议会选举，改选35席中的12席，约为议会三分之一席位，与英格兰其他地方选举同日进行。选举后，议会仍没有任何政党取得过半席位。议会领袖、独立议员迈尔斯·帕金森失去了议席。

en.s: The 2023 Bracknell Forest Borough Council election took place on 4 May 2023, to elect all 41 members in 15 wards for Bracknell Forest Borough Council in England. The election took place on the same day as other local elections in England as part of the 2023 United Kingdom local elections. Due to a boundary review there had been a change in ward boundaries, along with a reduction in size from 42 members elected in 2019.

zh.t: 2023年布拉克内尔森林自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2023年5月4日，英格兰举行布拉克内尔森林自治市议会选举，改选全部41名议员，分布在15个选区。这是2023年英国地方选举的一部分，与英格兰其他地方选举同日举行。经过选区边界审查后，选区边界有所调整；相比2019年选出的42名议员，议会人数减少。

en.s: The 2023 Dudley Metropolitan Borough Council election took place on 4 May 2023. One third of councillors— 24 out of 72 —on the Dudley Metropolitan Borough Council were elected. The election was held alongside other local elections across the United Kingdom. The Conservatives retained their majority on the council.

zh.t: 2023年达德利都市自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2023年达德利都市自治市议会选举于5月4日举行。议会72名议员中有三分之一，即24人改选。选举与英国其他地方选举同期举行。保守党继续在议会占多数。

en.s: The 2023 Hull City Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect members of Hull City Council. This was on the same day as other local elections in England. Hull has a mixture of two and three member wards and elections take place by thirds. This year 19 of the 21 wards held elections.

zh.s: 2023年赫尔市议会选举于5月4日举行，选出赫尔市议会议员，与英格兰其他地方选举同日。赫尔的选区有两名或三名议员，议会按三分之一席位轮换改选。本次有21个选区中的19个举行选举。

en.s: The 2023 Bury Metropolitan Borough Council elections took place on 4 May 2023 alongside other local elections across the United Kingdom. One third of seats (17) on Bury Metropolitan Borough Council were contested. The Labour Party retained its control of the council.

zh.t: 2023年伯里都市自治市议会选举
zh.s: 伯里都市自治市议会选举于2023年5月4日举行，与英国各地其他地方选举同期进行。议会51个席位中有三分之一，即17席改选。工党继续控制议会。

en.s: The 2023 City of Wolverhampton Council election took place on 4 May 2023, alongside other local elections across the United Kingdom. Due to changes in the boundaries of the wards, all 60 seats on the City of Wolverhampton Council, were up for election. All twenty wards elected three councillors. Labour increased its majority on the council.

zh.t: 2023年伍尔弗汉普顿市议会选举
zh.s: 2023年伍尔弗汉普顿市议会选举于5月4日举行，与英国各地其他地方选举同期进行。由于选区边界调整，议会全部60席改选。20个选区各选出3名议员。工党扩大了在议会中的多数优势。

en.s: The 2023 Coventry City Council election took place on 4 May 2023. One third of councillors — 18 out of 54 — on Coventry City Council was elected. The election took place alongside other local elections across the United Kingdom. The Labour Party retained its majority on the council, although it did lose one seat to the Green Party.

zh.s: 2023年考文垂市议会选举于5月4日举行。考文垂市议会54名议员中有三分之一，即18人改选，与英国各地其他地方选举同期进行。工党继续在议会占多数，但失去1席给绿党。

en.s: The 2023 Wealden District Council election was held on 4 May 2023 to elect all 45 members of Wealden District Council. This was on the same day as other local elections across England. At the first meeting of the Council on 24 May 2023, the first ever non-Conservative administration was elected in the Council's 50-year history.

zh.s: 韦尔登区议会选举于2023年5月4日举行，改选全部45名议员，与英格兰其他地方选举同日。2023年5月24日，议会首次会议选出该议会50年来首个非保守党政府。

en.s: An election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect all 35 members of the North Warwickshire Borough Council in the English Midlands. This took place on the same days as other UK local elections.

zh.t: 2023年北沃里克郡自治市议会选举
zh.s: 北沃里克郡自治市议会选举于2023年5月4日举行，选出英格兰中部北沃里克郡自治市议会全部35名议员，与英国其他地方选举同日举行。

en.s: The 2023 Manchester City Council elections took place on 4 May 2023 alongside other local elections across the United Kingdom. One third of councillors (32) on Manchester City Council were elected, along with a mid-term vacancy in the Ardwick ward. Labour retained its majority on the council.

zh.s: 曼彻斯特市议会选举于2023年5月4日举行，与英国各地其他地方选举同期进行。议会96名议员中有三分之一，即32人改选，阿德威克选区另有一个任期中途出现的空缺席位同时补选。工党继续在议会占多数。

en.t: 2023 Brighton and Hove City Council election
en.s: The 2023 Brighton and Hove City Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect members of Brighton and Hove City Council, England. This was at the same time as other local elections in England. Due to a boundary review, there was a change in ward boundaries, but the city council continued to comprise 54 members.

zh.s: 2023年布莱顿-霍夫市议会选举于5月4日举行，选出英格兰布莱顿-霍夫市议会议员，与英格兰其他地方选举同期进行。由于边界审查，选区边界有所调整，但市议会仍有54名议员。

en.s: The 2023 Salford City Council elections were held on 4 May 2023 alongside other local elections across the United Kingdom. One third of seats (20) on Salford City Council were up for election, with an additional seat being contested in a by-election in Pendlebury & Clifton. Labour retained its majority on the council.

zh.s: 索尔福德市议会选举于2023年5月4日举行，与英国各地其他地方选举同期进行。议会60个席位中有三分之一，即20席改选；彭德尔伯里-克利夫顿选区另有一席补选。工党继续在议会占多数。

en.s: The 2023 Rochdale Metropolitan Borough Council elections took place on 4 May 2023 alongside other local elections across the United Kingdom. One third of seats (20) on Rochdale Metropolitan Borough Council were contested. Labour retained its majority on the council.

zh.t: 2023年罗奇代尔都市自治市议会选举
zh.s: 罗奇代尔都市自治市议会选举于2023年5月4日举行，与英国各地其他地方选举同期进行。议会60个席位中有三分之一，即20席改选。工党继续在议会占多数。

en.s: The 2023 Bolton Metropolitan Borough Council elections took place on 4 May 2023 alongside other local elections across the United Kingdom. Due to boundary changes, all 60 seats on Bolton Metropolitan Borough Council were up for election. The council remained in no overall control following the election, however the Labour Party, with the support of Horwich and Blackrod First and One Kearsley, were able to displace the Conservative Party's minority administration and install their group leader Nick Peel as the new leader of the council.

zh.t: 2023年博尔顿都市自治市议会选举
zh.s: 博尔顿都市自治市议会选举于2023年5月4日举行，与英国各地其他地方选举同期进行。由于选区边界调整，议会全部60席改选。选后议会仍无多数党控制。不过，在霍里奇与布莱克罗德第一党及基尔斯利一党支持下，工党取代保守党少数派政府，并推举党团领袖尼克·皮尔担任新的议会领袖。

en.s: The 2023 Middlesbrough Borough Council election took place on 4 May 2023 to elect all 46 members of Middlesbrough Council and the directly-elected Mayor of Middlesbrough. This was on the same day as other local elections across England. Prior to the election the council was under no overall control and the mayor was Andy Preston, an independent.

zh.s: 2023年米德尔斯堡自治市议会选举于5月4日举行，改选米德尔斯堡议会全部46名议员和直选市长，与英格兰其他地方选举同日。选举前，议会没有任何政党占多数，市长为独立人士安迪·普雷斯顿。

en.s: The 2023 Oldham Metropolitan Borough Council elections took place on 4 May 2023 alongside other local elections across the United Kingdom. Due to boundary changes all 60 seats on Oldham Metropolitan Borough Council were contested. Labour lost seats, including that of the leader of the council, Amanda Chadderton, but retained a majority on the council.

zh.t: 2023年奥尔德姆都市自治市议会选举
zh.s: 奥尔德姆都市自治市议会选举于2023年5月4日举行，与英国各地其他地方选举同期进行。由于选区边界调整，议会全部60席改选。工党失去一些席位，其中包括议会领袖阿曼达·查德顿的席位，但仍在议会占多数。

en.s: The 2023 Kirklees Metropolitan Borough Council elections were held on 4 May 2023 alongside other elections across the United Kingdom. 24 out of the 69 seats on Kirklees Metropolitan Borough Council were contested. The Labour Party retained its majority on the council.

zh.t: 2023年柯克利斯都市自治市议会选举
zh.s: 柯克利斯都市自治市议会选举于2023年5月4日举行，与英国各地其他地方选举同期进行。议会69个席位中有24席改选。工党继续在议会占多数。

en.s: The 2023 Stratford-on-Avon District Council election took place on 4 May, the same day as other local elections in England. The election was contested on new boundaries following a review by the Local Government Boundary Commission.

zh.t: 2023年斯特拉特福德-埃文区议会选举
zh.s: 2023年斯特拉特福德-埃文区议会选举于5月4日举行，与英格兰其他地方选举同日。选举采用地方政府边界委员会审查后制定的新边界。

en.s: The 2023 Boston Borough Council election took place on 4 May, 2023, to elect all 30 members of Boston Borough Council in Lincolnshire, England. Prior to the election the council was under no overall control, being led by a minority Conservative administration with support from some of the independent councillors. Following the results, the council became under the control of local party, Boston Independent, which had only been registered as a party in March 2023.

zh.s: 2023年波士顿自治市议会选举于5月4日举行，选出英格兰林肯郡波士顿自治市议会全部30名议员。选举前，议会没有任何政党占多数，由保守党少数派政府执政，并得到部分独立议员支持。选后，议会由地方政党波士顿独立党控制；该党直到2023年3月才正式注册。

en.s: The 2023 East Cambridgeshire District Council election took place on 4 May, 2023, to elect all 28 members of East Cambridgeshire District Council in Cambridgeshire, England. The Conservative Party retained control of the Council.

zh.s: 2023年东剑桥郡区议会选举于5月4日举行，选出英格兰剑桥郡东剑桥郡区议会全部28名议员。保守党继续控制议会。

en.s: The 2023 Southend-on-Sea City Council election was held on 4 May 2023 to elect members of Southend-on-Sea City Council in England.

zh.s: 滨海绍森德市议会选举于2023年5月4日举行，选出英格兰滨海绍森德市议会议员。

en.t: 2023 Forest of Dean District Council election
en.s: The 2023 Forest of Dean District Council election was held on 4 May 2023 to elect members to the Forest of Dean District Council in Gloucestershire, England.

zh.s: 迪恩森林区议会选举于2023年5月4日举行，选出英格兰格洛斯特郡迪恩森林区议会议员。

en.s: The 2024 Backlash, also promoted as Backlash France, was a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) and livestreaming event produced by the American company WWE, held for wrestlers from the promotion's main roster brands, Raw and SmackDown. It was the 19th Backlash event and took place on May 4, 2024, at the LDLC Arena in Décines-Charpieu in the Metropolis of Lyon, France.

zh.s: 2024年《Backlash》（又称《Backlash France》）是美国职业摔角公司WWE制作的一场按次付费及网络直播赛事，参赛者来自旗下主力品牌Raw和SmackDown。这是第19届《Backlash》，于2024年5月4日在法国里昂大都会迪西讷-沙皮约的LDLC竞技场举行。

en.s: UFC 301: Pantoja vs. Erceg was a mixed martial arts event produced by the Ultimate Fighting Championship that took place on May 4, 2024, at the Farmasi Arena, in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil.

zh.s: UFC 301：潘托贾对阵埃尔塞格是终极格斗冠军赛举办的一场综合格斗赛事，于2024年5月4日在巴西里约热内卢的法马西竞技场举行。

en.s: The 2024 Tasmanian Legislative Council periodic election were held on 4 May 2024 to elect three members of the Tasmanian Legislative Council. The seats of Hobart and Prosser were up for election, with a by-election for the seat of Elwick also held concurrently. The Liberal Party retained Prosser with a swing towards them, while the Tasmanian Greens won their first upper house seat with a victory in Hobart.

zh.t: 2024年塔斯马尼亚立法委员会定期选举
zh.s: 塔斯马尼亚立法委员会定期选举于2024年5月4日举行，选出三名立法委员会成员。霍巴特和普罗瑟两个席位改选，同时还为埃尔威克席位举行补选。自由党守住普罗瑟席位，且得票有所上升；塔斯马尼亚绿党则在霍巴特获胜，首次赢得上议院席位。

en.s: The 2024 A-League Women grand final, known officially as the Liberty A-League Women grand final, was a championship soccer match between Melbourne City and Sydney FC at AAMI Park in Melbourne on 4 May 2024. It was the 15th A-League Women grand final and the culmination of the 2023–24 season. Melbourne City came into the match as premiers. The match was refereed by Casey Reibelt.

zh.s: 2024年A联赛女子总决赛官方名称为“自由保险A联赛女子总决赛”，是墨尔本城队与悉尼FC之间的冠军赛，于2024年5月4日在墨尔本的AAMI公园球场举行。这是第15届A联赛女子总决赛，也是2023—24赛季的收官之战。墨尔本城以常规赛榜首身份进入决赛，比赛由凯西·赖贝尔执法。

en.s: The 2024 Indian Super League cup final was the final match of the 2024 ISL Cup playoffs. It was played on 4 May 2024 between Mohun Bagan SG and Mumbai City at the Vivekananda Yuba Bharati Krirangan in Kolkata. Mohun Bagan SG played their third final and Mumbai City played their second final. Mumbai City won the match 3–1 to secure their second ISL Cup.

zh.s: 2024年印度超级联赛杯决赛是2024年印度超级联赛杯季后赛的最后一场比赛，于5月4日在加尔各答的维韦卡南达尤巴巴拉蒂体育场举行，参赛双方为莫亨巴甘SG和孟买城。莫亨巴甘SG第三次参加决赛，孟买城第二次参加。孟买城以3比1获胜，第二次赢得印度超级联赛杯。

en.s: ONE Fight Night 22: Sundell vs. Diachkova was a combat sport event produced by ONE Championship that took place on May 4, 2024, at Lumpinee Boxing Stadium in Bangkok, Thailand.

zh.s: 格斗赛事“ONE格斗之夜22：桑德尔对阵迪亚奇科娃”由ONE冠军赛主办，于2024年5月4日在泰国曼谷伦披尼拳击场举行。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Romania on 4 May 2025, with a second round on 18 May 2025. Nicușor Dan and George Simion were the two candidates who advanced to the second round, in which the former was victorious. Dan's term as the sixth president of Romania began on 26 May. The election was scheduled in January 2025 following the annulment of the 2024 Romanian presidential election citing alleged Russian meddling in favour of first-round winner Călin Georgescu.

zh.s: 罗马尼亚于2025年5月4日举行总统选举，第二轮投票于5月18日举行。尼库绍尔·丹和乔治·西米翁进入第二轮，丹最终胜出。他于5月26日开始担任罗马尼亚第六任总统。2024年罗马尼亚总统选举被宣布无效后，罗马尼亚于2025年1月安排了这次选举；取消上次选举的理由是有指控称俄罗斯干预并支持首轮得票第一的卡林·杰奥尔杰斯库。

en.s: Municipal elections were held in Mauritius on 4 May 2025 to determine the composition of the municipal councils of the city of Port Louis and the towns of Beau Bassin-Rose Hill, Curepipe, Quatre Bornes, and Vacoas-Phoenix. Initially planned for 2021, Prime Minister Pravind Jugnauth's government delayed the elections that year and again in 2022 due to the COVID-19 pandemic.

zh.s: 毛里求斯于2025年5月4日举行市政选举，选出路易港市以及博巴森-罗斯希尔、居尔皮普、夸特博尔纳和瓦科阿-菲尼克斯等城镇市政委员会成员。选举原定于2021年举行，但普拉温德·贾格纳特政府以新冠疫情为由将选举推迟至2022年，之后再次推迟。

en.s: The 2025 Belgian Cup final, named Croky Cup after the sponsor, was the 70th Belgian Cup final. It was played on 4 May 2025 between rivals Club Brugge and Anderlecht.

zh.s: 2025年比利时杯决赛因赞助商名称也称“Croky杯”决赛，是第70届比利时杯决赛，于2025年5月4日举行，参赛双方为宿敌布鲁日俱乐部和安德莱赫特。

en.s: The Southern Syria clashes began on 28 April 2025. The initial clashes erupted in the city of Jaramana following tensions related to the circulation of a controversial audio recording, and quickly escalated to nearby areas of Sahnaya and Ashrafiyat Sahnaya, and on 30 April to multiple villages in Suwayda Governorate. After de-escalation efforts, an agreement was reached to end the fighting on 1 May.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.t: 叙利亚南部冲突（2025年4月至5月）
zh.s: 叙利亚南部冲突于2025年4月28日爆发。最初的冲突发生在杰拉马纳市，起因是争议录音传播引发的紧张局势，随后迅速蔓延至附近的萨赫纳亚和阿什拉菲亚特·萨赫纳亚，并于4月30日扩展到苏韦达省多个村庄。经过缓和局势的努力，双方于5月1日达成停火协议。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。
